articleTitle: Simulation study on energy consumption sensitivity of typical extended range hybrid vehicles
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In response to the significant impact of environmental factors on the energy consumption of extended range hybrid vehicles, this paper proposes a vehicle modeling method based on environmental factors. The temperature, road, weather and other information in the actual environment are introduced into the simulation model, and the driver model, vehicle model, engine model, generator model, drive motor model, battery model, etc. are modified. The model is used to continuously analyze typical routes in a city for a long period of time, and the impact of scene factors such as temperature, travel time, and average speed on vehicle energy consumption is analyzed, providing a basis for optimizing the energy consumption of actual vehicle operating conditions.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Base Power Transmission Reliability Evaluation Method Considering Power Balance and Wind Power Output Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The application of large-capacity ultra-high voltage direct current (UHVDC) transmission greatly improves the large-scale resource allocation capability. The randomness and intermittency of renewable energy power generation often lead to power deviations of up to millions of kilowatts. This poses great challenges for the electricity consumption within the sending-end system, satisfying large-scale external transmission, and ensuring the reliability of system power supply. Based on the historical data and the wind turbine output coefficient calculated by power grid planners according to work experience, the probability that the output system coefficient calculated by historical data is greater than or less than the wind turbine output coefficient calculated by experience is analyzed. Next, the 95% confidence interval is considered to ensure that the output coefficient corresponding to more than 95% of the data point satisfies the requirements and that the corresponding wind turbine output coefficient is obtained. The change of the system power surplus caused by the empirical value and the newly obtained value of the output coefficient is calculated. Then, the power balance evaluation index is defined to characterize the judgment of power surplus by selecting a new wind turbine output coefficient. Finally, the effectiveness and adaptability of the proposed method are verified by a provincial power grid.

articleTitle: Super-resolution of Aerial Images Based on Global Dependency Transformer
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the problem of global feature extraction difficulty in the super-resolution task of aerial images, a super-resolution reconstruction model for aerial images based on global dependence transformer is proposed. The proposed model innovatively introduces a Re-parameterized Spatial Frequency Block (RSFB) with global feature extraction capability, which compensates for the defect of the original model's weak global information perception capability. In addition, the proposed model also constructs a Dual-channel Residual Group (DARG) with the ability of spatial and channel dual-channel feature aggregation, which substantially improves the model's reliance on global information. Experimental results on the aerial image dataset NWPU-RESISC45 show that the proposed model has obvious advantages in PSNR and SSIM metrics.

articleTitle: Research on resource scheduling method based on Kubernetes
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of cloud computing, the demand for cloud services in all walks of life is increasing. The scale of cloud computing services based on container technology is constantly growing, and Kubernetes has been widely used as a mainstream tool for container orchestration. It supports functions such as automatic deployment and service discovery, dramatically simplifies the container deployment process, and improves the availability and reliability of applications in cloud environments. However, the default scheduling strategy of Kubernetes adopts the greedy idea of first-come-first-served when facing multi-pod tasks, and schedules Pods to working nodes one by one. This scheduling scheme will lead to unbalanced cluster load and low resource utilization. To solve this problem, this paper introduces the selection, crossover, and mutation ideas in genetic algorithms into the artificial fish school algorithm, improves the foraging behavior in the artificial fish school algorithm, and constructs a custom scheduling strategy based on the enhanced artificial fish school algorithm. Experiments have shown that compared with the default scheduling strategy of Kubernetes, the customized scheduling strategy in this paper can effectively improve the load balancing of the cluster and improve the utilization of cluster hardware resources in the scenario of multi-pod scheduling.

articleTitle: A radar behavior mode recognition method with Bayesian inference
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the increasingly complex electromagnetic signal environment, the traditional radar signal behavior mode recognition method for phased array and radar seeker of this kind of special multi-mode radar mode recognition is more difficult, this paper proposes a based on Bayesian inference, combined with the radar signal pulse stream sliding window processing mechanism, can effectively make up for the traditional radar signal behavior pattern recognition on the shortcomings of the mechanism for phased array and guide head of this kind of special body multi-mode radar pattern recognition method is proposed accordingly. Under this mechanism, a corresponding radar behavior mode recognition method is proposed for the special multi-mode radar of phased array and radar seeker.

articleTitle: Study on safety risk estimation technology based on stratified indicators
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Effective security monitoring in the power distribution Internet of Things (IoT) requires thorough vulnerability analysis. This paper presents a risk assessment method based on hierarchical indicators, integrating real-time threat capture through IoT terminals and cloud platforms. The system uses multiple algorithms to evaluate security indicators, applying a layered approach for comprehensive risk assessment. By analyzing each risk layer, it offers an accurate and dynamic evaluation of security threats across the IoT network. This method enhances risk assessment precision, improves system security, and facilitates quicker recovery from threats. The proposed model strengthens security measures, contributing to enhanced reliability and risk mitigation in power distribution IoT systems.

articleTitle: A cross-network integration scheduling mechanism for high-concurrency transmission tasks in computing power networks
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The digital age has promoted the growth of the demand for a large number of computing resources, and the computing power network was born. Through distributed architecture, the computing power network can cover clouds, edges, and terminals to meet different levels of computing needs. Then, in reality, the network resources are complex, and there are many high-concurrent transmission tasks in the computing network. The OSPF routing algorithm adopted in the traditional network only supports multiple transmission tasks to seize the bandwidth resources of a single link, so it is difficult for users to flexibly choose computing resources according to the task requirements. Therefore, in order to achieve the heterogeneity of network resources, we propose a cross-network fusion scheduling mechanism for high-concurrent transmission tasks in the computing network. By sensing the performance parameters of multi-link heterogeneous networks, we assign a link with relatively abundant bandwidth and relatively short time to complete all transmission tasks to the new task flow for transmission, so as to ensure the bandwidth demand of high concurrent transmission tasks. Finally, the test results show that this method can make full use of network resources, and the throughput of each task flow is improved by more than 100 Mbps, and the transmission time of each task is reduced by more than 5 s.

articleTitle: A Fuzz Testing Method for Smart Grid Terminals Based on the Isolation Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart grid infrastructure, the proliferation of networked and intelligent devices in power systems has introduced significant cybersecurity challenges. Traditional security approaches, while essential, focus primarily on perimeter defenses and are limited in detecting vulnerabilities within firmware. This paper presents a fuzz testing method enhanced by the Isolation Forest algorithm, designed specifically for identifying security vulnerabilities in smart grid terminal firmware. By combining real-time monitoring, encrypted data transmission, and adaptive feedback, the proposed method provides robust anomaly detection and dynamic test case generation. Experimental results indicate that this approach significantly improves detection accuracy and efficiency, demonstrating its suitability for the rigorous security demands of smart grid environments.

articleTitle: Power allocation optimization and location deployment strategy of STAR-RIS based on DDPG
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Simultaneously transmitting and reflecting reconfigurable intelligent surface is a new type of intelligent reflector that has both reflection and refraction functions, thereby improving the transmission performance of wireless communication systems. This paper first proposes a wireless communication system assisted by STAR-RIS carried by drones, and then combines the base station beamforming and STAR-RIS phase vector to maximize the user weighted sum rate. Finally, a deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm is proposed to solve the non-convex problem of the joint optimization problem. The simulation results show that the proposed joint beamforming and phase vector algorithm based on DDPG has better performance than the random algorithm and DQN algorithm, and is closer to the performance of the WMMSE algorithm.

articleTitle: PPG blood pressure prediction technology based on convolutional neural network during wartime
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This article proposes a lightweight residual network model PPG light by obtaining and preprocessing PPG signals through equipment. This network is based on the UNet network model, using specialized 1D segmentation and combining MobileNet's lightweight and moderate depth with the UNet network to transform the two-dimensional model into a one-dimensional model. The input value is the processed PPG signal, and the output is an approximate blood pressure waveform. Experimental results show that this network model has a significant lightweight effect.

articleTitle: ResNet-Enhanced TD3-Based Coordinated Control and Transformer-Based Online Fault Detection System
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Rocket attitude and trajectory control has long been a key topic in the field of control systems due to the harsh working environments of rockets and the stringent demands for control responsiveness and robustness. These challenges make stabilizing rocket attitude and trajectory particularly difficult. This paper proposes a multi-thruster coordinated control method for rocket attitude and trajectory based on the TD3 architecture, incorporating ResNet into the reinforcement learning framework, achieving superior results compared to traditional models. Furthermore, to enhance system robustness and provide real-time status updates for operators, the paper introduces an online fault detection system based on a transformer network. This system quantitatively assesses the operational status of each thruster in a short time, offering additional insights for system control and enabling operators to monitor the system’s status more accurately and promptly.

articleTitle: Research on the coordinated scheduling strategy of multilevel charging and discharging resources under heavy load scenario in station area
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The large-scale integration of electric vehicles poses significant challenges to the safe and stable operation of distribution network substations. This article analyzes the impact of disorderly charging and discharging of electric vehicles on heavy overload in the substation area. Propose a multi-level charging and discharging resource coordination and scheduling strategy of "pile station network". And build a multi-level coordination and optimization framework for charging and discharging resources. The case analysis shows that the model and algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively alleviate the problem of heavy overload in the substation caused by disordered charging and discharging.

Author Keywords: Heavy overload in the distribution network substation area

articleTitle: Multi-Path Transmission for Parameter Synchronization in Distributed Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The increasing scale of deep learning models requires widespread adoption of distributed training using the Ring-AllReduce (RAR) architecture. However, existing multi-path transmission mechanisms are infeasible to satisfy the high bandwidth requirements of RAR parameter synchronization, which exhibits unique traffic characteristic that the parameter synchronization latency of each batch depends on the slowest communication delay between task nodes. To address this issue, this paper proposes RingMP, which selects multiple paths for parameter transmission by comprehensively considering the characteristics of RAR parameter synchronization traffic and network conditions to reduce network congestion. Experimental results show that compared to existing approaches, RingMP achieves higher network throughput, lower packet loss rate, and lower bandwidth wastage for RAR parameter synchronization.

articleTitle: Research of Commercial Aircraft IMA-Resident Distributed Control Panel Assembly Architecture
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the field of commercial aircraft, Control panel assembly are the direct interface between pilots and aircraft systems. Well-designed Control panel assembly can reduce the workload of pilots and improve operational efficiency. Considering the limitations of traditional architecture, such as independent wiring, poor maintainability, and the potential for catastrophic consequences from core equipment failure, this paper explores the potential application of IMA-resident technology and integrated software and hardware technology in enhancing the performance of control panel assembly system. This paper proposes a distributed control panel assembly architecture design based on IMA residency, aiming to improve system reliability, reduce maintenance costs, and enhance the competitiveness of the aircraft's main manufacturer's products. The paper further elaborates on the performance optimization analysis of this architecture and looks forward to the future development trends of Control panel assembly and potential challenges.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data Empowering the Internet of Things Data Collection in Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the context of the digital economy era, smart agriculture represents a crucial direction for agricultural modernization, with its core lying in the utilization of information technologies such as big data, cloud computing, and the Internet of Things (IoT) to achieve intelligent and precise management of agricultural production. Guangdong Province, as a major agricultural province in China, has vigorously promoted the development of smart agriculture in recent years by implementing a series of policies and projects, such as the key special project on "Precision Agriculture and Ecological Green Technologies" and the "Action Plan for Digital Agricultural and Rural Development," significantly enhancing the level of intelligence in agricultural production. Based on big data and IoT technologies, this study comprehensively analyzes the current development status, experimental results, and policy support for smart agriculture in Guangdong Province, aiming to explore how big data empowers IoT data acquisition in smart agriculture and thus contributes more significantly to agricultural modernization in Guangdong and even nationwide. The research results indicate that the system can effectively elevate the level of intelligence in agricultural production, reduce production costs, increase crop yields and quality, providing robust technical support for agricultural modernization.

articleTitle: Corpus Construction for Etiquette Entity and Relation Extraction in Ancient Chinese Texts Assisted by Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To address the issue of data scarcity in entity relationship extraction tasks within the domain of ancient texts and meet the needs of researchers in digital humanities, this paper proposes an automated data annotation method based on the large language model ChatGPT and prompt engineering. By treating the large language model as a “data annotator,” we developed an entity relationship extraction dataset tailored to ritual scenarios in ancient texts for the natural language processing field. This dataset includes five entity types and ten relationship types, characterized by precise labeling. To verify the robustness and versatility of the dataset, comprehensive experiments were conducted on three pre-trained language models. The results demonstrate that pre-trained models based on prompt learning achieve the best performance in entity relationship extraction tasks. This study shows that the data annotation method leveraging large language models provides a feasible solution for automated data annotation, and the corpus of etiquette entity relationship extraction lays an important foundation for the construction of etiquette question answering system and knowledge graph of ancient books.

articleTitle: Moving Object Detection in High Dynamic Scene for Visual Prosthesis
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Visual prosthesis that applies electrical stimulation to restore functional vision has a promising prospect. However, visual percepts generated by current visual prosthesis are low resolution with unruly color and restricted grayscale. This severely restricts the ability of prosthetic implant to complete visual tasks in daily scenes. At present, some studies use existing image processing techniques to improve the perceptions of objects in prosthetic vision. However, most of these studies detect the static objects and optimize the visual percepts in general dynamic scenes. This greatly limits the application of visual prosthesis in high dynamic scenes. In this study, a novel moving object detection model is proposed to automatically extract the moving objects in high dynamic scene. In this model, the optical flow, color and luminance are applied to form different dimensional feature space, and construct the moving object map according to the visual saliency in different feature channel. The proposed method can uniformly highlight the moving object and keep good boundaries in high dynamic scene. The simulation results indicate that the proposed moving object model can effectively detect the moving object.

articleTitle: Structural Design and Mechanical Simulation on the Array Base
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The installation of the array structure on various platforms is of crucial importance in engineering practice. It is not only related to the long-term safety of the array structure, but also affects the pointing accuracy of the array. In this paper, for the array that is floor-mounted on a certain platform, according to the installation requirements, a bearing base with light weight and high strength has been designed. This base meets the requirements of suitability for installation and the pointing accuracy of the array. For the bearing capacity, static analysis of the base is carried out by using mechanical simulation software, and the simulation results show that the base meets the equipment bearing requirements. For the harsh environment where the platform is located, random vibration and anti-shock strength analysis of the base are carried out by using mechanical simulation software, and the simulation results show that the base meets the requirements of equipment anti-vibration and anti-shock.

articleTitle: Automatic Pricing And Replenishment Decision of Vegetable Products
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, the 2023 China Higher Education Cup National College Students Mathematical Contest in Modeling is used as the theme to study the automatic pricing and replenishment decisions of vegetable products. Because the shelf life of vegetable products in fresh supermarkets is relatively short, and the quality will deteriorate with the increase of sales time, most vegetable varieties cannot be sold the next day if they are not sold on the same day. This requires a reasonable and efficient analysis and identification system, and builds a model based on the category of dishes sold, the sales volume, and the total sales, and generates automatic pricing and replenishment decisions. In this paper, linear regression, kendall consistency test, cost-plus pricing (P=c × (1+r)) method, and genetic algorithm are used to establish a mathematical model to obtain automatic pricing and replenishment decisions.

articleTitle: Construction of College English Teaching Evaluation System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, many college English teaching evaluation systems focus on a single dimension and ignore the evaluation of students’ comprehensive abilities. This study aims to build a college English teaching evaluation system based on deep learning, extract key features from students’ submitted learning outcomes (such as homework, papers, lecture videos, classroom interaction records, etc.) through convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and comprehensively evaluate teaching quality and students’ language ability. The study uses multi-layer convolution and pooling operations to extract local and global features, and integrates and makes decisions through fully connected layers, and finally unifies various teaching evaluation indicators through the Softmax function. In order to optimize the performance of the model, the study implemented a variety of evaluation and optimization methods such as loss function optimization, cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, regularization technology, and early stopping strategy. In addition, combined with the multi-head self-attention mechanism in the Transformer framework, the model can adjust the attention weight of the input data according to the context information, further improving the accuracy of teaching evaluation and the generalization ability of the model. By comparing with traditional evaluation methods, the effectiveness and advantages of the deep learning model in comprehensively evaluating students’ learning outcomes are verified. The experimental results show that the evaluation system based on deep learning can not only provide a more comprehensive evaluation but also outperform traditional methods in accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Target Matching Method for Radar Emitter Based on Sequence Similarity
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For cooperative combat scenarios involving electronic countermeasure platforms, a method is proposed to perform target matching and association of radar emitters at the scale of hundreds of milliseconds or seconds. Due to the different fields of view of the platforms, the received radar emitter signal sequences are incomplete. The method uses Levenshtein distance to calculate the distance between parameter sequences within a tolerance range, thereby computing the similarity of the parameter sequences. It then uses empirical factors to weight and obtain the target similarity, completing the target matching. The method is simple to implement and convenient for equipment application, and the matching results can be directly used for the fusion of identification results, such as model recognition, in subsequent collaborative processing.

articleTitle: DRL-Driven Adaptive SFC Deployment with GCN in Distributed Cloud Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As cross-domain cloud networks become increasingly dynamic and complex, the deployment of service function chain (SFC) must adapt to varying quality of service (QoS) requirements and unpredictable traffic demands. In this paper, we propose an adaptive SFC deployment approach driven by deep reinforcement learning (DRL) integrated with graph convolutional network (GCN). By modeling the network as a markov decision process (MDP), the method captures dynamic state transitions and optimizes deployment strategies. Our approach incorporates advanced features such as a GCN-based encoder for network topology modeling, an LSTM for capturing sequential dependencies, and a customized reward function that balances latency minimization and resource utilization. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, achieving higher success rates, reduced latency, and improved system efficiency compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: An Integrated Control Method for Flexible Components and Spacecraft Body
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an integrated control method that encompasses both the flexible components and the spacecraft body to address the challenge of high-precision attitude control for spacecraft utilizing the motion of flexible components connected to the spacecraft body. The design of a feedback control law is conducted without increasing the complexity of the spacecraft. This approach leverages the rotary motion at the root of the flexible component to achieve effective attitude control for the spacecraft body, thereby facilitating integrated control between these elements. The efficiency of the proposed method is validated through numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent vehicle collision avoidance control considering road adhesion coefficient
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To improve collision avoidance and stability of intelligent driving vehicles in emergencies, a control method considering road adhesion is proposed. First, a Kalman filter estimates the road adhesion coefficient in real time based on tire-road interaction. Then, a lateral and longitudinal controller is designed to track the optimal collision avoidance trajectory by applying brakes and generating the optimal steering angle. The controller includes constraints for low-adhesion surfaces to reduce instability. Finally, a joint simulation platform using Prescan, CarSim, and Simulink validates the system. Results show that, compared with the other two control strategies, the designed control strategy can reduce the vehicle's peak sideslip angle by 7.14% and 32.08% respectively in emergency situations, thus enhancing the vehicle's collision avoidance ability and driving stability.

articleTitle: Simulation and optimization of full nucleic acid detection service under epidemic prevention and control situation
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a queuing model of nucleic acid detection service is established according to the randomness of the arrival rate of the personnel to be tested and the randomness of the detection service time. The arrival rate and detection service time of the personnel to be tested are randomly simulated, and the nucleic acid detection is dynamically simulated. Get the arrival rate of different people to be tested and the queuing time of nucleic acid detection under different detection service time, the busy rate of each detection service desk and other factors. Considering the waiting cost of the personnel to be tested, the requirement of interval distance, the operation efficiency of the detection service desk and the allocation of medical resources, and effectively combining the safety distance requirements of epidemic prevention and control, the risk of secondary infection caused by aggregation is reduced, and the optimal number of detection service desks and the guidance of the personnel to be tested are obtained. An optimization scheme is proposed for the scientific safety of nucleic acid detection, and feasible suggestions are provided for reasonable queuing and epidemic prevention and control command.

articleTitle: Research on News Text Entity Recognition Technology Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, the volume of news text data has grown explosively, making it a key research focus to efficiently and accurately extract valuable information from this vast amount of news text. To address the challenges in entity recognition within news texts, this paper proposes a deep learning-based Named Entity Recognition (NER) method — the BERT-BiLSTM-MSConvAttn-CRF model. This model first uses the BERT pre-trained language model to obtain high-quality word embedding vectors, which can capture rich semantic and syntactic information of words in specific contexts. Then, these word embedding vectors are processed through the BiLSTM layer, effectively capturing long-distance dependencies in the text, thereby enhancing the understanding of sentence structure. To further improve the model's ability to identify key entity features, we introduce the MSConvAttn layer, which combines multi-scale spatial and channel information through a multi-scale convolutional attention mechanism, allowing for more precise capture of important details in the text. Finally, the CRF layer is used to globally optimize the entire sequence, ensuring that the output label sequence is both coherent and accurate. The proposed model was validated using a named entity recognition dataset for news texts, and experimental results show that the model outperforms existing models in NER tasks, providing a new solution for information extraction from news texts.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Assessment Method for Power Grid Data Security Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Developing the digital economy is a strategic choice to seize the new opportunities of the new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation. This choice requires promoting the deep integration of energy technology with modern information, new materials, and advanced manufacturing technology, and exploring new modes of energy production and consumption. With the deepening of digital transformation of power enterprises and the iterative application of new digital technologies, data security has become the cornerstone of the safe operation of new power systems. The article proposes a set of power grid data security risk assessment methods based on the security risks faced by power grid data. This method accurately evaluates the security risks of power grid data through the Analytic Hierarchy Process, constructs a judgment matrix for quantitative analysis, and further improves the accuracy and effectiveness of power grid data security risk assessment.

articleTitle: Mango Sorting Mechanism Design and Experimental Research Based on Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of manual sorting and packaging of mango, such as sorting errors, time-consuming and labor-consuming, a mango sorting device was designed based on image processing, and a robust mango surface detection algorithm based on frequency domain filtering was proposed. Firstly, a machine vision image acquisition system is designed to obtain mango images with surface defects. The image is divided into R, G and B color channels, and the R channel is selected for mean filtering, noise reduction and Emphasize enhancement. Then, the preprocessed image is converted into spectrum image by FFT, and then transformed into spatial image by IFFT after removing the components representing texture details, which is different from B color channel to obtain a strong contrast image. Image segmentation based on Otsu method, morphological processing of segmented region, to obtain ideal segmentation results. Analysis results show that the detection accuracy is 84.9%, the accuracy rate is 92.3%, the recall rate is 91.4%, and the F1 score is 0.918. After processing mango images, mango images are classified according to the size of surface defect area, so as to finally realize mango sorting.

articleTitle: Ultra Wide-band Polyphase Channelized Spectrum Sensing System Design Based on RFSoC
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a channelized spectrum sensing system design and implementation based on AMD RFSoC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>, enabling a 5-Gsps, full-band acquisition at a quantization of 16 bits through dual-channel RF-ADC. To address the issue of post-processing and transmission difficulties caused by time domain aliasing in wide-band signals, a 16-channel, 20-tap polyphase channelizer is implemented, with a fixed-point parallel FFT module included. The channelized samples are subsequently packaged and transmitted to the backend server via QSFP28 optical modules and a PCIE acquisition card. The frontend implemented on RFSoC utilizes 13% of the LUTs, 37% of the DSP48s and 33% of the BRAMs available on the device, and achieves timing closure at 500MHz. Evaluation test presented shows the capability of the channelized spectrum sensing system towards the complex electromagnetic environment.

articleTitle: Research on Text-to-Image Generation Model Based on Spatial Transformer Network Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The challenges of text-guided image generation technology mainly involve ensuring the semantic consistency of images and their visual realism, as well as enhancing the accuracy and trustworthiness of image generation. In view of the quality limitations exhibited by single - stage models during the image generation process, this paper presents a method to boost the semantic consistency between text descriptions and generated images. By incorporating the attention mechanism, the integration of cross - modal features between text and images is realized. Through the introduction of the spatial transform network model into the discriminator, the model only needs to concentrate on the image regions that are highly relevant to the text description, instead of all regions, thereby avoiding resource waste. By transforming and adjusting the local regions of the input image, it becomes possible to process and represent the spatial information of the image more precisely. Through experimental verification, the model proposed in this paper shows an improvement in the quality of generating complex scene images based on text descriptions. On the COCO dataset, the Inception Score (IS) has increased by 1.2%, and the Frechet Inception Distance (FID) has decreased by 0.61%. This result clearly demonstrates that the single - stage generation model integrated with the spatial transform network mechanism can generate more diverse images that are closer to real -world scenes.

articleTitle: Research on Non Direct Sight Infrared Laser Scattering Communication Technology in IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This study delves into non line of sight (NLoS) infrared laser atmospheric scattering communication technology in the Internet of Things (IoT) environment. By constructing precise signal transmission models and developing efficient signal encoding and decoding techniques, efficient and stable data transmission under non line of sight conditions has been achieved. This article also discusses the potential applications of this technology in IoT fields such as smart cities and emergency rescue, providing new communication solutions for it.

articleTitle: A Dual-scale Low-voltage Distribution Network Topology Identification Method Based on AMI Data Driving
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To improve the operational stability of distribution grids and solve the increasingly serious topology error problem in low-voltage distribution, this paper proposes a dual-scale low-voltage distribution network topology identification method based on AMI data driving. Firstly, an improved K-means algorithm is proposed, combining the first-order derivatives and the original data, and a new idea of distance calculation is adopted to cluster and analyze the user appliance data collected by AMI. Then, according to the principle of correlation of electrical data, the results of the analysis are compared with the topology information recorded in the station archives, and the topological connections with possible errors are searched out. Finally, the validity of the method proposed in this paper is verified after relevant case analysis. Unlike traditional topology identification methods, this method not only reduces labor and hardware costs, but also has higher applicability and can better cope with the dynamic changes and complexity of power system topology.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Grain collecting and Bagging Machine Based on 51 series Single chip Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Grain harvest at the time of grain maturity, grain drying and dehydration after the collection and packaging and timely return to storage is particularly important, China's intensive tanning farms are mostly, the design of a new type of grain collection and bagging equipment to realize the rapid collection and packaging of grains. Using a combination of theoretical analysis and three-dimensional model construction method, the mechanical design scheme of grain collection and bagging machine is analyzed. According to the functional requirements of the device, the virtual prototype is built through SolidWorks, and the circuit control system is designed, and the three-dimensional model of the key mechanical parts is built through finite element analysis to simulate and analyze and strength check, and verify its reliability. The device design can meet the demand for rapid collection and bagging of grain, its structure is reasonable, simple operation, improve the efficiency of grain collection and bagging work, can better complete the setup work, has a certain application prospects and promotion value.

articleTitle: Research on Geological Hazard Monitoring and Early Warning of Transmission Lines Based on UAV-A Case Study of Panyi Line
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid economic development in the southwest region of China, transmission lines play a crucial role in ensuring the region’s power supply. However, the complex and variable geological environment frequently threatens transmission lines with landslides, collapses, and mudslides, especially along the Panyi 246 route, where the high incidence of geological disasters poses a serious challenge to the stability of the power system. Traditional manual inspection methods are not only inefficient but also difficult to respond in time during disasters, so it is urgent to introduce efficient and intelligent monitoring methods. This study uses drone technology to analyze the affected terrain, tower damage, and surrounding geological structure, providing a basis for disaster assessment and ensuring the scientificity and effectiveness of the judgment. It also reduces inspection costs and successfully warns of multiple landslide events in actual applications, ensuring the safe operation of the Panyi 246 route.

articleTitle: Improved ActionCLIP-based Temporal Action Recognition for Long Video
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Multimodal pre-training models have been successfully applied to the vision domain, and a large number of researches have been conducted on this basis for video action recognition of short duration single actions. However, the current downstream tasks commonly have requirements for multiple action timing recognition, and there is no effective architecture to realize the requirements in terms of timing rules. This study proposes SeqActionMatchNet, a simple and effective architecture based on ActionCLIP improvement to address these challenges. The learning capability of ActionCLIP is utilized to obtain the action timing information of long videos by performing action recognition after cutting them. A generative large model is used to process the text of the task rule to obtain the text timing information, and finally the information of the video and the text are compared and matched to realize the recognition of the action timing of the long video.

articleTitle: Implementation and Application of an Intelligent Travel Photography System Based on Outdoor DSLR-Grade Internet Cameras
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper introduces a smart travel photography system that utilizes an outdoor DSLR-grade internet camera. By integrating algorithms for eliminating irrelevant background characters in landscape portrait photos, real-time high-resolution video keying algorithms, an image security communication system design based on grid coding modulation, and adaptive writing algorithms for landscape photos, the system achieves high-quality, convenient, and innovative selfie services in scenic areas. It can operate stably in complex environments and effectively process images, while also protecting user privacy and generating personalized copy for users, greatly enhancing tourists' travel photography experience. This system holds significant application value and boasts broad development prospects in the field of smart tourism.

articleTitle: Design and development of measurement and control system for hydrogen production from electrolytic water based on microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the design and development of a microcontroller-based measurement and control system for hydrogen production by electrolytic water. This design connects with BMP180 module and hydrogen sensor through I2C bus, collects ambient temperature and pressure data in real time, and calculates hydrogen concentration according to the collected hydrogen sensor data. Then the relay plays a switch role on the hydrogen production device of electrolytic water. If the hydrogen concentration is enough, the relay will open, that is, the hydrogen production device will stop; If the concentration is not up to standard, the relay is closed, the hydrogen production device runs, and the external temperature is too high, the buzzer alarms, thus forming a safe, environmentally friendly and reliable cycle mode for hydrogen production.

articleTitle: The Application of OBE-Based Course Objective Achievement Evaluation Model in Top-Level Courses
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The degree of achievement of course objectives is an important indicator for evaluating the effectiveness of course teaching and is a major component of the course evaluation system. Starting from the concept of OBE, this paper constructs a comprehensive evaluation model for the achievement of course objectives. The evaluation of achievement degree is based on the support relationship of each assessment part of the course to the course objectives, and the calculation results show that the construction of the municipal top-level course 'Computer System Platform' has achieved relatively remarkable results, which also confirms the high accuracy of the evaluation model.

articleTitle: A New Denoising Method for Ship-Radiated Noise Based on Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Noise reduction lays a foundation for feature extraction and identification of ship-radiated noise. To improve the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of ship-radiated noise, a new denoising scheme is proposed in this paper, based on complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN) and improved permutation entropy (IPE). The proposed approach initiates with the decomposition of ship-generated acoustic signals into multiple intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) through the CEEMDAN technique. Subsequently, these IMF components are categorized into three distinct groups -pure noise components, noise-biased components, and signal-dominant components - based on their respective IPE metrics. The processing strategy involves discarding the pure noise IMFs while applying least mean square adaptive filtering (LMSAF) to refine the noise-biased components. The final denoised output is reconstructed by integrating the processed noise-dominant IMFs with the unaltered signal-dominant IMFs. Experimental validation through both simulated and real-world acoustic datasets demonstrates the superior performance of this approach. Comparative analysis reveals that the proposed technique outperforms conventional methods, providing a more reliable preprocessing solution for underwater acoustic signal analysis and subsequent interpretation tasks.

articleTitle: Segmented load classification aggregation method based on load investigation of users in a new power load management system
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Electricity resources are an indispensable resource in both daily life and industrial production. As the demand for electricity from all sectors of society keeps rising, the complexity of load data in the power system gradually escalates, the daily load peak-valley difference continues to expand, and the peak electricity consumption time is concentrated. A superior load classification method is the key to resolving the aforementioned problems and guaranteeing the normal and stable operation of the power system. Considering the characteristics of China's current power system, classifying power loads and analyzing the electricity consumption behavior patterns of each category of load can provide a foundation for the power department to formulate power supply plans, implement staggered management, and set electricity prices.

articleTitle: Automatic Recognition System for Gear Defects Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: It is particularly necessary to conduct defect detection on the gears during the production process to ensure that the quality of the gear products meets the requirements when they leave the factory. Adopting adaptive median filtering algorithm to denoise gear images, using genetic neural network algorithm for gear defect segmentation, extracting geometric and shape features of gear defect regions based on their characteristics. Given the significant differences in the characteristics of cracks, dents, holes, and tooth breakage defects, different gear defect recognition algorithms are adopted. Based on the research on gear defect recognition algorithms, a machine vision based automatic gear defect recognition system was designed and developed, and gear sample images were collected for simulation experiments of the system. The experimental results show that the system can accurately identify defects in gears and classify them with high recognition accuracy. The system also runs very fast, with an average time of 2 seconds required to detect an image. It has high real-time performance and greatly reduces the time required by manual detection methods.

articleTitle: Communication Network Selection Algorithm Based on D-S Evidence Theory for Power Distribution Service
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the advancement of the construction process of the new power system, the power distribution service puts forward new demands for the distribution communication access network. It is difficult for a single communication method to meet the new demands of distribution network service, so a network selection algorithm based on D-S evidence theory (NSA-D-S) for distribution network service is proposed. The algorithm calculates the service importance degree by quantifying the demand of distribution network service about each performance and the network selection is performed based on service importance. During network selection, the network with the largest fusion judgement value calculated by D-S evidence theory considering delay, bandwidth, and reliability is selected as the access network for the service. The simulation proves that the algorithm can improve the normalized quality of service (QoS) of important distribution network services, and improve the utilization of high-quality network resource.

articleTitle: Micro-expression Recognition Based on Optical Flow Maps and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To address the challenge of detecting subtle changes in local regions during micro-expression occurrence, this paper proposes a micro-expression recognition method based on optical flow maps and attention mechanisms. First, the frame difference method is used to identify the apexframe in micro-expression samples that lack apexframe labels. Next, the TV-L1 optical flow method is employed to extract the horizontal and vertical components of the optical flow between the onsetframe and the apexframe, and these optical flow component maps are then used to derive the corresponding optical flow strain pattern maps. Subsequently, the three optical flow component maps are stacked together to form the optical flow feature map of the micro-expression. Finally, an attention module is introduced into a convolutional neural network built on the Inception module, allowing the model to focus more on the subtle changes in the motion areas when the micro-expression occurs during the feature extraction process. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves an UF1 score of 0.860 and a UAR score of 0.854 on the CASME II dataset, surpassing many existing methods in terms of UF1 and UAR scores on other datasets as well.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Monitoring Terminal of Transmission Line Hidden Target Based on Multi-dimensional Optical Information
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The construction and maintenance of transmission lines are critical to ensuring national energy security. Current methods for detecting hidden targets in transmission lines involve uploading massive amounts of images from various monitoring points to a centralized video platform and then carrying out the algorithmic recognition, which demands an extremely high computational load on the platform. Therefore, designing edge-intelligent algorithm deployments at the monitoring terminals can effectively distribute the load, reduce the redundancy of uploaded images, and lower the computational burden and power consumption of the central platform. To ensure the safe and stable operation of transmission lines, this paper proposed a novel intelligent monitoring terminal based on multi-dimensional optical information fusion. TensorRT inference optimization engine, CUDA programming model and parameter quantization method are used to achieve edge deployment and optimization of hidden target detection algorithm on the terminal. Results show that the intelligent surveillance terminal effectively balances the contradictory relationship between model accuracy, computational ability and power consumption, and ultimately improves the inference speed while maintaining the accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of File Upload Vulnerability Detection Tool
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The file upload vulnerability is one of the common and highly harmful vulnerabilities in web applications, which can be exploited by attackers to control web servers. This article focuses on analyzing the causes of file upload vulnerabilities and researching methods for detecting different types of file upload vulnerabilities. Based on this, a file upload vulnerability detection tool is designed and implemented using Python 3 reuqests and bs4 modules. The experimental results show that the detection tool proposed in this article can comprehensively detect file upload vulnerabilities on websites, and the efficiency of vulnerability detection is relatively high.

articleTitle: A Convolution Neural Network-Based Approach for Ship Engine Fault Diagnosis Leveraging Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In Facing the complexities of diagnosing ship engine faults in marine environments, this study presents a novel approach that combines Convolution Neural Network (CNN) with transfer learning. We began by obtaining a substantial annotated data set from a marine engine simulator to train an initial CNN model. This model was then adapted to the target domain with limited annotated data through fine-tuning. Comparative evaluations with traditional methods like CNN, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), decision trees, and random forests showed that our transfer learning-enhanced CNN model achieved highest recognition accuracy. This outcome confirms the efficacy of our approach and its significant potential for diagnosing ship engine faults, especially in data-scarce scenarios.

articleTitle: Forward Prediction-Based Feedforward Time Delay Compensation of Electro-hydraulic Shaking Table
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Real-time hybrid simulation using electro-hydraulic shaking tables has been widely applied in vibration testing of large-scale structures. However, the presence of time delay in electro-hydraulic shaking tables significantly affects the control accuracy of real-time hybrid simulations. In this study, a forward-prediction-based feedforward time-delay compensation method is proposed. Frequency characteristic fluctuations are compensated, and time delay is reduced using the autocorrelation algorithm and FP algorithm. Additionally, time-varying system characteristics are compensated through an online adaptive control algorithm. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively reduces time delay and significantly improves the tracking accuracy of the reference waveform.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Spacecraft Pointing Error on Terahertz Communication
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In space terahertz communication missions, aircraft are subject to various factors such as platform disturbances and background noise, which can cause angular micro vibrations and result in non-zero antenna pointing errors, thereby affecting the overall performance of the communication system. This article combines the pointing error of typical spacecraft to establish a channel model under its influence, derives the expression of BER and channel capacity under the influence of pointing error, and quantitatively and intuitively analyzes the impact of spacecraft pointing error on terahertz frequency band communication performance from multiple perspectives such as signal constellation diagram, BER, channel capacity. The results indicate that the 16QAM modulation signal is affected by pointing errors with a RMS greater than 10 μ rad, resulting in a BER deviation greater than 4dB and a channel capacity deviation greater than 10%; At high SNR, the BER is greater than 20%, and the channel capacity deviation is close to 60%. The above results have important implications for the design of space terahertz communication systems in practice.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a File Exchange System between Intranet and Internet Based on WeChat Mini - Program
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, many enterprises have established internal networks, and direct file exchange between the intranet and the Internet is not permitted. File exchanges between these networks are mostly conducted through a fixed location for centralized file collection and distribution, which results in more and more employees spending time in the process of file sending and receiving. In order to improve the convenience of file exchange between networks, this paper designs a set of file exchange system between the intranet and the Internet based on WeChat Mini - Program. This system can greatly improve the efficiency and convenience of file exchange between the intranet and the Internet in enterprises, and has strong significance for promotion.

articleTitle: Research on the recognition system of visual arc welding
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, many domestic scholars and research institutions have studied the laser vision welding seam tracking system. By improving the control strategy of the robot and welding seam tracking system, the processing time is optimized and the real-time response of the welding seam tracking system is promoted. However, the practical application of the research results is not yet satisfactory. This paper carries out an experimental study of vision-based arc weld tracking. Its main content contains welding robot kine matics and control systems, weld image processing technology, right angle weld tracking technology, and so on. The research shows that the feature extraction of arc weld based on vision can be completed and arc weld recognition can be realized. It provides some reference for the application of laser vision welding seam tracking systems in industry.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of greenhouse environment monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Agricultural modernization has become an inevitable trend of global agricultural development. The traditional greenhouse monitoring system has limitations, which cannot detect and deal with the abnormal environment in the greenhouse in time. In response to the above problems, this paper designs a greenhouse environment monitoring system based on STM32. The hardware part of the system uses STM32 as the main control module. The LD3322 speech recognition sensor is used in the speech module. Temperature and humidity sensor detection module using DHT11 digital sensor; Soil moisture using waterproof DS18B20 digital sensor; The actuator is controlled by a relay module. In addition, the LORA module is used in the wireless communication module, so that users can remotely monitor the situation of the greenhouse environment. In the light acquisition part of the software, the Kalman filter algorithm is used to analyze and process the data, and the serial communication protocol is used to transmit the collected data to the host computer. Through experimental debugging, the system realizes the function of speech recognition control and environmental temperature and humidity detection. The experimental results show that the greenhouse environmental monitoring and control system has high stability and reliability, can effectively solve the problems existing in the traditional greenhouse monitoring, and has certain application prospects and promotion value.

articleTitle: Network Function Offloading on Programmable Switch with Sequential Pipelines
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Network Function Virtualization (NFV) allows network functions (NFs) to be chained as a service function chain (SFC) and deployed on a number of servers through virtualization technology, enabling flexible processing of network functions. With the development of programmable switches in recent years, some switches, such as P4 switches, are also capable of processing NFs, which can effectively improve the throughput of the system and reduce the processing latency of SFCs. But current programmable switches can only allow packets to be processed in a fixed NF order. Such a feature creates new problems in situations where network SFC requests are in a dynamic randomized manner. Based on the above background, this paper proposes a policy algorithm for accelerating SFC processing based on P4 switches. Our scheme take into account the sequential requirements of SFCs and the sequential structure of the P4 switch pipeline, and uses multiple switches to jointly process SFCs, which is able to handle dynamically generated SFCs with superior performance. Compared with other algorithms, our algorithm is able to achieve lower latency.

articleTitle: A Method for Constructing Dataset of Campus Network Broadband Access Server
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Broadband Access Server (BAS) is a critical device located at the edge of the Internet Service Provider (ISP) network, responsible for centralized management, control, and forwarding of user data traffic. In campus networks, broadband access technologies have played a significant role in providing faster and more stable network connections. Currently, the field lacks relevant datasets, which has led to a shortage of accurate, effective, and high-quality data support for BAS research. This paper proposes a method for constructing a dataset for campus network BAS and uses this method to collect one month of data from a real campus network environment. To validate the usability of the dataset, the device load prediction was taken as an example, and various machine learning algorithms were tested. The experimental results show that the dataset collected by this method is accurate and complete, truly reflecting the actual characteristics of the devices, and capable of distinguishing the generalization capabilities of different models. It can be used for relevant experimental research and has achieved the expected objectives.

articleTitle: Dynamic behavior driven resource allocation and its impact on epidemic spreading in complex networks
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Epidemic spreading in complex networks is influenced not only by the network topology but also by individual behavior and resource allocation mechanisms. Traditional models often assume static or homogeneous resource allocation, neglecting the dynamic and heterogeneous adjustments of individual behavior in response to local infection states. This study introduces a dynamic behavior-driven resource allocation model, which couples the classic SIS model with sensitivity parameter and resource awareness parameter. The model captures the interaction between individual behavior, resource allocation, and epidemic dynamics through a two-layer network framework. Through extensive numerical simulations, we obtain the following findings: First, increasing the individual sensitivity can significantly raise the epidemic threshold, which effectively delaying the epidemic outbreaks. High sensitivity enables individuals to rapidly adjust their behavior, leading the reduction in contact rates and resource allocation, thereby suppressing infection spread. Second, the resource awareness of individuals demonstrates a non-monotonic influence on epidemic spreading, and an optimal range of awareness level is obtained, which can maximize epidemic suppression by balancing resource allocation and protection. Lastly, the coupling of dynamic behavior and resource allocation mechanisms provides critical insights into how local interactions can mitigate global epidemic spreading. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating behavioral and resource factors into epidemic models, offering a theoretical basis for developing adaptive public health strategies in complex network environments.

articleTitle: Research on Bending Resistance Model Based on Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To obtain comprehensive data characterizing the bending resistance of samples and to address the limitations of traditional experimental methods—namely, the scarcity, discreteness, and lengthy durations of data collection—this study investigates a three-dimensional (3D) bending resistance model based on digital twin technology. Specifically, our research encompasses four key components. First, we conducted measurements on a laboratory three-point bending model while simplifying certain secondary components. Second, we established a 3D model utilizing digital twin technology and tested the bending performance of the samples under various external loads. Third, we characterized the bending resistance of the samples through the digital twin model, focusing on three aspects: the amount of displacement from the indenter, the description of the bending curve, and the statistical analysis of maximum von Mises stress. Finally, we validated the model's accuracy using traditional experimental equipment. The results indicate that the accuracy of the 3D bending resistance model based on digital twin technology meets design requirements. In comparison to conventional testing methods, this model enables the acquisition of richer data, effectively addressing issues related to data scarcity, discontinuity, and prolonged testing durations.

articleTitle: Low-Energy Ultrasonic Particle Enrichment Technology Based on Phononic Crystals
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This study has developed a particle concentration device suitable for automated pipeline cell culture systems, characterized by its low cost, single-use, and suitability for batch processing. By thoroughly analyzing the attenuation characteristics of near-field acoustic streaming coupled with solids and the movement patterns of particles, and utilizing a specially designed tunable phononic crystal plate (PCP) to precisely control the intensity and range of the acoustic field, the device efficiently achieves particle concentration. Extensive numerical simulations and experimental validations conducted in this study have confirmed the feasibility of this method, and relevant parameters have been optimized, providing an effective solution for the high-sensitivity and rapid concentration of trace samples.

articleTitle: 220kV Substation Capacity Demands Assessment Method Considering Irradiance of Regional Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The problem of insufficient capacity of the main transformer has always been the key factor restricting the security operation of the power grid. The continuous increase in the penetration of distributed photovoltaics puts forward new requirements for renewable energy access and power load down-grid ability of the power system. The irradiance factor of the power grid and the development of renewable energy are considered. The capacity deficits of the 220kV substation based on the guideline capacity-load ratio are calculated by analyzing the regional distributed photovoltaic output simultaneity rate at noon and the installed situation of distributed photovoltaic. Then, the load rate of the main transformer N-1 failure of the heavyduty 220kV substation is analyzed. The additional 220kV transformer capacity is calculated when the transferred load of the lower power grid is considered and the renewable energy source is not adopted. Finally, the evaluation index of 220kV substation capacity demand of the regional power grid is proposed, which is used to evaluate the relationship between the shortage of substation capacity of each heavy-duty substation and the overall 220kV substation capacity shortage in the region. The effectiveness and adaptability of the proposed method are verified by an actual power grid.

articleTitle: Design of gear defect detection system based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As the society develop rapidly, the existence of machinery is indispensable, inside the most basic part is the gear. But the traditional measurement methods such as vernier calipers, coordinate measuring instruments and so on, greatly reduce the measurement efficiency under the condition of ensuring accuracy. In view of the above problems, this paper designs a gear defect detection system based on machine vision. The hardware part of the system uses a white ring light source, a area array camera model with ME2L-505-36U3M/C and a prime focus lens. In the software part, Halcon software building the gear parameter detection system combining with DobotStudio platform is used to control the robot arm. Firstly, the reality coordinates and pixel coordinate are converted into matrix through nine-point calibration. Secondly, images are filtered by Gaussian smoothing, and detect edge through Canny operator. At that way, we can obtain the basic parameters of the gear quickly and accurately, and detect whether the gear qualified. Thirdly, the corresponding coordinate will be transferred to DobotStudio platform via the TCP transmission protocol, so that the robot arm will be controlled to complete the screening work. Through experimental debugging, the measurement parameter error of the system is less than 0.10mm. Unqualified gears are absorbed by the mechanical arm with the air pump and placed aside, so as to achieve the purpose of gear screening. The experimental results show that the system can greatly improve the efficiency and accuracy of gear defect detection, and has certain application value.

articleTitle: Three-degree-of-freedom Parallel Leg Design Based On The Environment Of Reinforced Mesh
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to allow the rebar binding robot to walk in the environment of reinforced mesh, a new three-degree-of-freedom spherical parallel mechanical leg was designed for it. The maximum height that can be lifted by the end of the mechanical leg is 220mm, and the rebar 200mm above the ground can be crossed with a step of up to 120mm. The end of the mechanical leg is equipped with a stilt with a height of 230mm, and the stilt will remain perpendicular to the ground during walking, so the quadruped robot equipped with the mechanical leg can stand and walk in a reinforced mesh with a rebar spacing of 100mm and a distance of 200mm from the ground. The mechanical leg adopts a parallel structure, which has higher rigidity and greater load capacity. In this paper, the structure and working principle of the mechanical leg are introduced in detail, and then the kinematic analysis is carried out to deduce the kinematic correct solution of the mechanical leg, Finally, the trajectory of the foot end of the prototype was mapped and compared with the theoretical motion trajectory.

articleTitle: Research on low temperature heating technology of battery based on bidirectional pulse current
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper addresses the problems of slow charging and high energy loss of power batteries in low temperature environments, and proposes a fast self-heating technology for battery systems based on bidirectional pulses. It explains the principle of pulse current heating and gives a specific design of bidirectional pulse current. The experimental verification of pulse current heating for power batteries in low temperature environments is presented, and the experimental results show that the pulse current heating method can achieve the rapid self-heating of power batteries in low temperature environments.

articleTitle: Locally Linear Embedding Based on Scrambled Halton Sequence Initialized Frilled Lizard Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the era of big data, the scale and complexity of data are ever increasing, traditional data dimensionality reduction methods can no longer meet the requirements of data users. In this context, manifold learning has now become an important research direction, which mainly achieves dimensionality reduction and mapping of nonlinear structural data in high-dimensional space to low-dimensional space, reduces data noise, and improves low-dimensional data representation ability. Locally linear embedding (LLE) is an important algorithm in manifold learning that projects data from high-dimensional space onto low-dimensional space while maintaining the linear relationship between data. However, the optimization objective function of LLE uses L2 norm measurement to approximate the error, which can easily amplify or reduce the error and cause oscillation in the error measurement. Therefore, in this paper, L1 norm instead of L2 norm is used to overcome this drawback, but introduces a new problem of the objective function becoming a non-smooth function. To solve this problem, in this paper, a derivative-free optimization method, which is also a swarm intelligence method called scrambled Halton sequence initialized frilled lizard optimization has been proposed, and via numerical experiment, its reliability and effectiveness has been verified.

articleTitle: New method to assess enhanced image quality based on luminance
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposed a new method to assess enhanced image quality based on luminance, studied the relationship between image luminance and image quality and the experiments proved the trend of image quality and image luminance under different visual conditions. Firstly, the image quality method to assess the enhanced image was established, then in order to get accurate results, we adopted two different luminance adjustment methods to study the relationship of the luminance and image quality assessment. Finally, the relationship between the image quality and the luminance was experimentally verified. Results shows that the image quality method can directly apply to assess the image quality and the relationship of the image quality and the luminance is a convex and non-linear function. According to the new method proposed in this study, we can use the relationship of the image quality and the luminance to adjust the luminance and achieve the best visual image quality and the research result will lay the foundation of image quality assessment.

articleTitle: Millimeter-Wave and Submillimeter-Wave FFT Digital Spectrum Radiometer
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The FFT digital spectrum radiometer is a detector that receives and finely analyzes the broadband spectrum of the atmosphere and is capable of precisely detecting the vertical temperature distribution of the atmosphere, which has a broad application prospect in satellite meteorological remote sensing. In this paper, a method for designing and implementing a two-dimensional FFT digital spectral radiometer based on complex conjugate optimized is presented. The working principle, composition, and functions of the system are provided. Finally, the experiment result shows the FFT digital spectrum has the abilities of receiving signal band up to 4.8GHz, real-time processing of 32768 data and dividing Spectrum from 10 to 200 MHz, which satisfies the radiometer system's needs for a digital spectrometer in terms of high-speed operation, high-precision quantization, and adaptability."

articleTitle: Research on Infrared Dim and Small Target Recognition Algorithm based on Improved YOLO v5s
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
