abstract: In response to the demand for high-precision infrared small target detection in complex backgrounds, a target intelligent recognition algorithm based on YOLO v5s is proposed. This algorithm introduces the SKAttention module into the backbone network of the YOLO v5s model to enhance its ability to extract features of targets at different scales. Additionally, the SimAM module is incorporated into the connection layer to help the model focus more effectively on the target region, without increasing the number of model parameters. Moreover, SIOU is used in place of EIOU to achieve more accurate target localization. Various image processing algorithms are employed to preprocess the infrared SIRST dataset, augmenting the number of images and completing model training and comparative experiments. Experimental results demonstrate that the improved YOLO v5s model outperforms the original YOLO v5s model by a 2.6% increase in accuracy, and exhibits superior target recognition performance compared to competing algorithms, effectively identifying infrared small targets in diverse background scenarios.

articleTitle: Economic Scheduling of Virtual Power Plants Based on Master-Slave Games
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the continued advancement of power market reforms, particularly on the power sales side, studying the economic optimization of multi-virtual power plant systems has become increasingly significant. For multi-objective virtual power plant systems, this paper proposes an economic optimization method based on a master-slave game framework. The method is divided into two phases: In the lower layer, the operation cost and environmental pollution cost of the virtual power plants are set as the optimization objectives. An optimization model is established for various micro-sources, such as wind power, photovoltaics, micro-gas turbines, and fuel cells, among others. In the upper layer, a master-slave game model is developed to regulate the optimal internal electricity price, facilitating electricity trading between the system operator and the virtual power plant group, thereby enhancing the level of energy sharing. The results of case studies demonstrate that the proposed methodology effectively incorporates the interests of the multi-objective modeling of virtual power plants, system operators, and multiple decision-making entities within the distribution network. It achieves mutual benefits through electricity and resource sharing, thereby significantly improving the economic performance of both virtual power plant groups and system operators.

articleTitle: GARL: A Generative Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for Transferable Power Grid Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel deep reinforcement learning approach, named GARL (Generative Adversarial Reinforcement Learning), for intra-day optimization dispatch in high-proportion new energy grid. The proposed method embeds a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) within the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) framework to learn the reward distribution of the power grid in the future operation situation, so as to realize the cumulative reward prediction in the dispatching period and ensure the optimization of the dispatching decision. Comprehensive experiments are conducted on the SG-126 power grid simulator under three representative scenarios to evaluate the performance and generalization capability of GARL. The results show that GARL can learn the distribution characteristics of stateaction-reward sequence from historical experience, establish the mapping relationship between current state and future cumulative reward, and improve the accuracy of future power grid operation trend prediction, which is always better than the independent DDPG algorithm. Furthermore, the study explores the potential of transfer learning between scenarios and finds that GARL exhibits a promising generalization capability.

articleTitle: An Efficient and Highly Coupled Energy Transfer Coil Optimization Design Method Applied to Space Wireless Energy Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In response to the demand for long service life and high reliability of power supply systems for future space multifunctional modular spacecraft, non-contact wireless energy transfer (WPT) technology can be used for power supply to avoid mechanical wear and arcing of cable interfaces. When wireless energy transmission occurs over a wide range of space, the coupling coefficient of the coupling mechanism in the wireless energy transmission system will decrease. This paper proposes an efficient and highly coupled energy transmission coil optimization design method applied to space wireless energy transmission systems. The coil optimization design method is studied to achieve efficient wireless energy transmission in high aspect ratio scenarios.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Anomaly Detection and Traffic Prediction Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the growing deployment of the Smart Integration Routing System (SIRS), ensuring system security has become a pressing challenge. Internal failures and external traffic attacks significantly impact system robustness, while the complexity of SIRS routing devices complicates anomaly detection and root cause analysis. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a comprehensive anomaly detection and prediction framework for SIRS traffic data, focusing on the critical network traffic. Furthermore, the Knowledge Graph Convolutional Network (KGCN) is employed for root cause localization, enabling the identification of complex, non-Euclidean relationships between anomalies and their causes. This study provides a robust and scalable solution for anomaly detection, prediction, and root cause localization in the Smart Integration Routing System, significantly improving its security, maintainability, and resilience against dynamic threats.

articleTitle: Analysis of Several Fault Cases and Rectification Measures for GIS Circuit Breaker Switch Operations in Substations
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper discusses the basic structure and working principle of GIS circuit breakers, and provides an in-depth analysis of several typical switching faults, including issues such as the fracture of the main drive shaft pin and faults caused by the spring mechanism. The paper also presents methods for fault handling and optimization strategies for operation and maintenance. Through the analysis of several case studies, the paper aims to offer insights for addressing similar fault issues, with the goal of improving the reliability and stability of GIS circuit breakers.

articleTitle: An Auto-test Architecture and Use Case Autocompilation Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the problems of long time-consumption, high work intensity and unstable result accuracy in the manual function and performance testing of the task control system, we propose an auto-test architecture and automatic preparation mechanism for use cases according to the test requirements of the unmanned task control system, including architecture composition, test process and test case design. In addition, the key algorithm for test case compilation is studied, and the test case is automatically and quickly provided to improve the test efficiency. Finally, compared with the manual testing method, the operation results of the autotest architecture are analyzed, and the results show that the auto-test architecture of the task control system proposed in this paper can meet the requirements of the task control system for test efficiency and test accuracy. In addition, the auto-test case compilation technology can significantly reduce the time and improve the accuracy of test case writing.

articleTitle: A Time-to-Digital Converter Employing a Voltage-Controlled Ring Oscillator with High Gain Linearity for LiDAR Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper presents a time-to-digital converter (TDC) employing a voltage-controlled ring oscillator (VCRO) with high gain linearity for light detection and ranging (LiDAR) applications. To eliminate the regulation dead zone during voltage control, a resistance tuning module incorporating dual NMOS transistors is proposed in the VCRO. Simulation results demonstrate that the VCRO's oscillation frequency is fully tunable from 446 MHz to 800 MHz across the full power supply range of 1.8V with high linearity, and the variation rate of the voltage control gain is maintained within 17.02%. Based on the VCRO, a 16-bit TDC is designed, which achieves a resolution spanning from 134 to 280 ps, a maximum range of 18 μs, and the power consumption is 3.5 mW.

articleTitle: Binomial Logistic Regression and XGBoost Model of Multiple Factors on Employee Well-being
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Employee Well-being is the physical and psychological experience and feeling of employees during work, it is a critical indicator of employee's quality of life and plays an important role in organization development. Therefore, it is of great significance to explore the main factors that affect Employee Well-being and learn the mechanism between Employee Well-being and its influences. Binomial Logistic Regression and XGBoost are machine learning tools using different algorithm. Binomial Logistic Regression uses linear regression analysis to integrate linear combination of features with logical functions, while XGBoost is a gradient Boosting algorithm, it uses decision trees as base learners and integrates their predictions to form powerful integrated models. In this study, Binomial Logistic Regression model was built to get a multivariate linear relationship between dependent variable and independent variables and XGBoost model was set to get a multivariate nonlinear relationship between dependent variable and independent variables. 6 independent variables, Organizational Innovation, Cooperative Behaviors, Job Satisfaction, Sense of Control, Perceived Stress and Trust which showed significant correlations with Employee Well-being were obtained by Pearson correlation analysis. Both Binomial Logistic Regression model and XGBoost model simulated well in accuracy, precision, recall and F1score, and demonstrated explicit classification and prediction effect. Perceived Stress showed the most significance to Employee Well-being in both models, which meant the main factor influencing dependent variable. Since the correlation between Employee Well-being and its main factors were explored successfully by the two models, it would be a simplified and efficient way to apply machine learning model to explore the mechanism of Employee Well-being with its potential factors, predict the level of Employee Well-being accurately, adjust the status of Employee Well-being timely.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Task Allocation Algorithm Based on Mixed Task Grouping
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: UAV task allocation still has some challenges in the field of military search, such as the balance of search task execution. In order to solve the problem of UAV task allocation reasonably, this paper proposes a UAV task allocation algorithm based on mixed task grouping. Firstly, a task grouping algorithm is proposed, which groups tasks by task similarity. Secondly, the search task group allocation is realized by combining the auction algorithm, and the price update rule of the auction algorithm is improved to prevent the UAV task allocation conflict problem, and finally the best solution for multi-UAV search task allocation is obtained. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can not only minimize the maximum flight distance of the UAV, but also maximize the balance degree of the UAV to complete the search task, and improve the balance degree of the UAV to perform the search task by more than 3 times under the condition that the total flight distance of the UAV is unchanged.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Path Planning Based on 3D Scene Modeling
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In response to the problem of simplifying the simulation experimental environment and obtaining experimental results that cannot meet the actual navigation needs in the research of existing unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) path planning algorithms, this study establishes a three-dimensional (3D) environment model of actual terrain based on digital elevation models (DEM), meanwhile uses functions to establish random 3D maps, and selects particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm and ant colony algorithm (ACO) to carry out the UAV path planning under circumstances of DEM and random 3D map, and the four sets of experimental results obtained are compared and analyzed. Compared to the DEM model, the random terrain has a lower complexity, allowing the fitness values of both the PSO and ACO algorithms to converge more quickly, with less time required to complete 100 iterations. For both algorithms, the PSO algorithm takes less time, only about one-third of the time taken by the ACO algorithm. It is recommended to use the DEM that derived from the real terrain environment instead of a simplified math-derived environment model in UAV path planning research.

articleTitle: Image Compression Algorithm Based on Region of Interest Extraction for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Communication
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The flexibility and maneuverability of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have led to their widespread use, but the challenge of limited storage space and bandwidth in emergency scenarios necessitates efficient image compression techniques. In this research, we propose an image compression algorithm tailored for UAV communication, termed ROIE-UC (Region of Interest Extraction for UAV Communication). Firstly, image pixels are clustered into super pixel blocks using the Simple Linear Iterative Clustering (SLIC). Secondly, these super pixels are grouped into regions of interest (ROI) using the Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN). The image is then segmented into ROI and non-ROI areas based on these clusters. Lossless compression is applied to the ROI, while lossy compression with a high ratio is used for non-ROI regions. At the receiving end, the image is decompressed and reconstructed. Experimental results show that the ROIE-UC achieves a Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) of 46.37 dB and a Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) of 99.94% for the ROI part, with compression ratios of 27, 25, and 14 for the whole image. Compared to the JPEG, PSNR improved by up to 28.52% and SSIM by 1.51%, with a compression ratio increase from 14.52 to 27.56. The ROIE-UC also provides up to a 49.44% increase in PSNR over other methods. These results demonstrate that ROIE-UC is an efficient and effective solution for image processing and data compression in UAV applications.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Anomaly Detection Method of Edge Devices Based on Attack Chain Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As power distribution IoT technology advances, traditional security measures are increasingly inadequate. This study proposes a dynamic anomaly detection method for edge devices using attack chain knowledge graph technology. By analyzing IoT attack paths and constructing an attack chain model, the method establishes a hierarchical network security knowledge extraction model. It automatically builds a security knowledge graph based on the attack chain, enabling effective dynamic anomaly detection and improving security performance. The approach combines graph structure storage and algorithms for fast attack detection and threat traceability. Additionally, it incorporates atlas similarity and critical path analysis for dynamic detection. Experimental results show that this method effectively identifies potential security threats, enhances system security, and meets the complex protection needs of power distribution IoT systems.

articleTitle: Research on PCB defect detection method based on principal component analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The surface defect detection of printed circuit board (PCB) is an important means to ensure the quality of PCB. In this paper, the method of PCB defect detection is deeply studied, and the image registration, image difference method and image segmentation in the detection process are mainly discussed. Random Hough transform is used to extract the coordinate value of the feature point and improve the accuracy of registration. In calculating the difference image, an improved method is proposed, which can effectively extract the difference between images and reduce the interference information. Based on Otsu threshold, a weighted threshold method is proposed to improve the accuracy of image segmentation. The location and size of defects in PCB images were detected by combining connected components detection and area threshold. The experimental results show that the proposed method has high accuracy in the identification of PCB surface defects and can meet the actual system requirements.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Power Market Policy Question-Answering System based on Local Knowledge Base
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the growth of global energy demand and the increasing complexity of power markets, quickly acquiring and understanding policy information has become a key challenge. This paper proposes a method to use triple knowledge graphs to construct a dataset for fine-tuning a large language model and build a local knowledge base to form an intelligent question-answering system for power market policies. The knowledge graph is constructed by extracting key relationships in the power market policy text, and efficient question-answering is achieved by combining an optimized large language model. Experimental results show that the system exhibits high recall and precision in the evaluation of multiple embedding models, providing an efficient solution for the intelligent interpretation of power market policies.

articleTitle: Signal Analysis for High-Speed Train Damper Based on CPO-ICEEMDAN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: High-speed trains use anti-yaw dampers to reduce snaking vibrations during operation, ensuring smooth and safe travel. If these dampers fail, they create complex and unstable vibration signals, making it difficult for traditional signal analysis methods to work effectively. This study introduces an Improved Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (ICEEMDAN) method, optimized by the Crested Porcupine Optimizer (CPO). This approach enhances the clarity and stability of signal decomposition by adjusting noise parameters. We conducted simulation experiments on both normal and faulty from high-speed train anti-yaw dampers. The results show that the CPO-ICEEMDAN method outperforms traditional techniques in mode separation, fault feature extraction, and noise resistance. Compared to Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD), Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition (EEMD), and Improved Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (ICEEMDAN) methods, the CPO-ICEEMDAN method maintains stable decomposition even when there is significant noise interference.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Spare Parts Production Decision System Based on Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Most enterprises in the market need to purchase spare parts for assembly. The qualification of the finished products depends on the quality of the spare parts. The unqualified quality of any single spare part will lead to the disqualification of the finished product. However, even if all the spare parts are qualified, the finished product may still be unqualified due to other factors. Therefore, how to select spare parts has become a decision-making dilemma for enterprises. This paper will establish a multiple linear regression model to predict the cost of spare parts. On this basis, the decision tree algorithm is used to efficiently determine the quality status of spare parts, enabling enterprises to make more scientific and accurate production decisions for spare parts. This helps enterprises achieve strategic goals of cost reduction, quality improvement, and benefit maximization in the fierce market competition, laying a solid foundation for the sustainable development of enterprises.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Connected Data Management System for Vehicle-road-cloud Integration
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In vehicle-road-cloud integration architecture, there are many challenges to data management and collaborative management due to multi-source heterogeneous data, different levels of resource storage, and differences in calculation. This paper presents a design of an intelligent connected data management system for vehicle-road-cloud integration. The vehicle-road-cloud multimodal information fusion is studied from the three aspects, namely, the data storage collaboration, data mode collaboration, and data processing collaboration on the cloud end, road edge and device. This information exchange in and out of vehicles, between roads and road edge , and among cloud ends is smoothed, which provides an important data foundation for realizing the vehicle-road-cloud integrated perception. Finally, experimental tests verify the effectiveness and reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Temperature Distribution of Porcelain Insulators for HVDC Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The infrared method has increasingly been employed to inspect in-service HVAC porcelain insulators on power transmission lines during recent years. However, the voltage as well as temperature distribution in the HVDC case are much different from those in the case of HVAC, hindering the application of infrared technology in the fault inspection of HVDC insulators. In this paper, the temperature distribution of an HVDC 9-insulator string has been studied through comparative experimental studies, in terms of different defection types and different positions in the string. The aim of this work is to attempt to explore possible infrared criterion for the inspections on defected HVDC porcelain insulators.

Index Terms: High Voltage Direct Current Transmission Lines

articleTitle: Virtual Power Plant Energy Management based on Distributed Network of Sewage Treatment Plant
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Virtual power plant is an intelligent power system that integrates distributed energy resources, energy storage facilities and controllable loads through advanced information and communication technology to form an intelligent power system that can participate in power market operation and grid scheduling. In this paper, distributed network Paxos algorithm and BP neural network model are used to integrate distributed energy, energy storage, load and other distributed units in sewage treatment plant. This paper deduces the system capability after network operation, and constructs the mathematical model of energy distribution based on it. We design systems that coordinate and control operations, optimize energy use and electricity consumption during wastewater treatment, and reduce carbon emissions.

articleTitle: Design of Cascade PD Controller Algorithm for The Quad-Rotor UAV
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Compared with traditional fixed wing drones, quad-rotor drones have better maneuverability and stability. It can adapt to more complex flight environments and requires lower control skills from the operator, so quad-rotor drones have been widely used in various fields in recent years. The quad-rotor itself has the characteristics of strong coupling, nonlinearity, and fewer driving numbers about degrees of freedom, which greatly increase the design difficulty of quad-rotor flight control systems. Based on the corresponding theories of physics and mechanics, a mathematical model was first established for the quad-rotor; Then, a flight control system based on the cascade PID control algorithm was designed for the quad-rotor. The control system has been verified to have strong stability and anti-interference ability through simulation of flight experiments.

articleTitle: Optimization strategy of tension control for film changing based on feedforward control
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Tension control is one of the core elements of the control system of film bi-directional stretching production line, which directly determines the film quality. For the upper winding type double station winding turret equipment with auxiliary roll, during the process of roll change operation, the change of film tension caused by turret overturning will adversely affect the quality of finished film. For this reason, a feed-forward speed compensation strategy is proposed in this paper. By calculating the two superimposed velocities generated on the film by the turret overturning during the roll change operation, the strategy obtains a generalized formula for the superimposed velocities of the duplex winding turret with auxiliary roll. Through data analysis, the relationship between the rotation angle of the turret and the stacked acceleration was obtained. Based on the calculated relation equation of superimposed acceleration, a feed-forward-PID tension control system was designed and compared with the traditional PID controller in simulation experiments. The results show that the system has good control effect.

articleTitle: BAT Optimized SMC for Continuous Stirred Tank Reactor
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This topic proposed a Sliding Mode Control (SMC) strategy utilizing the BAT Algorithm (BAT-SMC) for regulating concentration and temperature in a Continuous Stirred Tank Reactor (CSTR) system. The SMC is designed to maintain concentration (CA) and temperature (T) within desired setpoints by adapting sliding surfaces in the presence of disturbances and system uncertainties. The BAT Algorithm enhances the SMC by optimizing control parameters, reducing chattering effects, and improving tracking accuracy. Simulations validate the efficacy of BAT-SMC, showing improved dynamic performance for both concentration and temperature control compared to other controllers.

articleTitle: Analysis of Near-Field Electromagnetic Scattering Characteristics of the Hypersonic Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To enhance the detection and strike accuracy of hypersonic vehicles, it is essential to analyze their electromagnetic scattering characteristics. Under short-range detection conditions, the body target effect must be considered. Additionally, the plasma sheath formed on the surface of a hypersonic vehicle during near-space flight alters the vehicle’s electromagnetic scattering characteristics. In this paper, the near-field electromagnetic scattering characteristic of the plasma-coated hypersonic vehicle is analyzed. Simulation results show that compared to the far-field condition, the peak value of the RCS curve decreases, and the main lobe broadens under near-field conditions. The RCS of plasma-coated hypersonic vehicles is reduced compared to the case without plasma coating. As the detection frequency increases, the attenuating effect of the plasma sheath on RCS gradually decreases. Analyzing the near-field RCS of plasma-coated hypersonic vehicles serves as a foundation for short-range detection and signal processing of these vehicles.

articleTitle: Prediction of Grouting Volume for Shield Tunnel Construction Based on Integrated Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Accurately forecasting grouting volume is crucial in shield tunneling to ensure tunnel stability and construction safety. This paper proposes a grouting volume prediction method based on an Integrated Learning Model (ILM), with Bayesian Optimization (BO) used to optimize the model’s hyperparameters. The ILM is constructed by combining three base learners: Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Gradient Boosting Decision Tree (XGBoost), with the optimal model serving as the meta-learner. The prediction model is built using real-world shield construction data and its performance is evaluated through comparative analysis. The results show that the ILM achieves an R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> value of 0.92, with optimal performance in RMSE and MAE, significantly outperforming individual models. Furthermore, feature importance analysis reveals that face earth pressure and excavation rate are the key factors influencing grouting volume, offering valuable insights for optimizing grouting strategy during construction.

articleTitle: Research on CNN-LSTM photovoltaic power output prediction method considering gray correlation analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the promotion of the "double carbon" goal, the new energy industry, particularly photovoltaic (PV) power generation technology, has made significant advancements. However, the fluctuation and unpredictability of PV power generation present challenges to grid security. Therefore, precise prediction of PV output is crucial for ensuring grid security and advancing the new energy industry. To enhance the accuracy of PV output prediction, this study utilizes gray correlation analysis to identify the key factors influencing PV output within the existing prediction model. By integrating convolutional neural network and long short-term memory neural network, a CNN-LSTM prediction model is developed to enhance prediction accuracy. The model is validated using PV output data from a PV station, demonstrating a substantial improvement in prediction accuracy and practical value.

Author Keywords: Long- and short-term memory neural networks

articleTitle: Electrolytic Water Hydrogen Model Characteristics and Impact on Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Hydrogen energy is a kind of secondary energy with abundant sources, green and low carbon, and is an important energy carrier of intermittent and random renewable energy system. Hydrogen energy plays an increasingly important role in power system with renewable energy proliferation. However, different interaction scenarios of hydrogen and electricity have a great impact on power grid power flow, voltage, control and protection under different operating conditions. In this paper, the model and output characteristics of alkaline electrolyzer is analyzed and its influence on power system is studied. Frist the alkaline electrolyzer model is established. Then the influence of operating temperature on electrolysis is analyzed in details. Finally, the influence on power flow and node voltage of power system with alkaline electrolyzer is studied utilizing IEEE 14 node system.

articleTitle: Exploiting 3D Semantic Priors for Ultra-Low Bitrate Human Video Compression
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The recent advancements in model-based video codecs have revealed significant potential. However, encoding human videos at ultra-low bitrates remains an unprecedented challenge due to the complex structure and dynamics of the human body. Inspired by the recent 3D semantic prior-based face video compression, we make the first attempt to exploit 3D prior information for extreme human video compression. More specifically, at the encoder, we first extract 3D human model parameters with specific semantics from each frame and then compress the keyframe and the parameter residuals of adjacent frames. Finally, utilizing the improved motion imitator, the motion information is derived from the decoded keyframe and reconstructed 3D prior representations to synthesize each frame. Experimental results indicate that the proposed scheme can produce satisfying reconstruction results at ultra-low bitrates and better support downstream 3D tasks such as constructing 3D human models at the same bitrates.

articleTitle: Role-Based Personalized Dialogue Summarization
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a role-based personalized dialogue summarization method (RoPeD) aimed at improving the quality of summaries in multi-role dialogue scenarios. We integrate the BART model and introduce a role personalization strategy to capture multi-role interactions in dialogues, generating summaries with better coherence, structure, and semantic consistency. Experiments were conducted on the CSDS and MC Chinese datasets, and the results demonstrate that RoPeD outperforms traditional methods across multiple evaluation metrics, including ROUGE, BLEU, and BERTScore, significantly improving summary quality. In particular, RoPeD shows superior performance in handling semantic consistency and multi-role interactions, outperforming conventional methods. The experimental results validate the effectiveness of role personalization in multi-role dialogue summarization and provide an innovative solution for future applications in more complex dialogue scenarios.

articleTitle: Study of a CART-AFT method for automatic generation of unstructured meshes
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The automation and intelligence of mesh generation is one of the bottleneck problems restricting the development of computational fluid dynamics. The quality and efficiency of mesh generation affect the accuracy and efficiency of numerical computation. Aiming at the problem of cumbersome intersection judgment in the traditional advancing front method (AFT), a CART-AFT method for automatic generation of unstructured meshes is proposed, and a CART model suitable for mesh data processing is designed, which is applied to predict the generation mode and new point coordinate in the mesh generation of AFT. The CART-AFT method is used to generate several classic two-dimensional unstructured meshes (30P30N three-element airfoil, NACA 0012 airfoil, a set of single-joint fractures, two-dimensional cylinder). Specific methods are adopted to test the mesh quality, quantity and generation time consumption, and comparisons are made with the traditional AFT and the mainstream ANN-AFT method. The results show that on the premise of equivalent generated mesh quality, the CART-AFT method reduces the mesh quantity by 2.65% and shortens the generation time by about 7% compared with the ANN-AFT algorithm, and reduces the mesh quantity by 6.98% and shortens the generation time by about 16.7% compared with the traditional AFT method.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent fault diagnosis of equipment parts based on improved wavelet domain Perona-Malik filtering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: An improved Perona-Malik filtering algorithm in wavelet domain was put forward for rotating mechanical vibration signals in multiplicative noise by integrating wavelet transform and Perona-Malik nonlinear anisotropy diffusion filtering model. At first, partial differential equation theories were introduced and Perona-Malik model, as one of important nonlinear anisotropy diffusion filtering algorithms, was brought in. From their applications in image denoising, it can be analyzed and inferred that both wavelet threshold denoising algorithm and Perona-Malik filtering model have their respective disadvantages. However there were a few interrelations and complementarities between them. Thus by integrating wavelet transform and Perona-Malik filtering model, an improved Perona-Malik filtering algorithm in wavelet domain was put forward for multiplicative signal denoising. Furthermore its algorithm principle was elaborated with flow chart. At last, by comparison with wavelet threshold denoising algorithm and Perona-Malik filtering model on bearing vibration signals, it can be indicated that this new improved Perona-Malik filtering algorithm is very appropriate for mechanical vibration signals in multiplicative noise. Above all, this new improved Perona-Malik filtering algorithm can not only realize signal denoising but also reserve signal features without signal distortions. It is a perfect synthesis of wavelet transform and Perona-Malik filtering model with better denoising performance and better anti-noise robustness.

articleTitle: Optimization Algorithm of Photovoltaic Module Array Arrangement based on Monte Carlo Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation is an important technology in the field of solar power generation. This paper mainly focuses on the land utilization rate of photovoltaic system based on layout optimization algorithm. First of all, the technical principle of photovoltaic power generation and the composition and classification of photovoltaic power generation system are summarized and analyzed, the mathematical model of photovoltaic panel array is established, and the MATLAB/Simulink simulation model of photovoltaic array under uniform arrangement and non-uniform arrangement is established. This paper studies the principle of energy conversion efficiency of photovoltaic array based on Monte Carlo algorithm, explains the influence of arrangement mode on the output power and output characteristics of photovoltaic array, and obtains the land utilization rate of photovoltaic system after various optimization.

articleTitle: Implementation of underwater target and background simulator based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of sonar technology, equipment for target detection and location based on underwater sound waves has experienced extensive applications. However, due to the limitations posed by the cost and operational cycle of underwater experiments, target and background simulators are necessary for the design, implementation, analysis, and performance testing of modern underwater guidance systems. In view of this, this study proposes a docking electrical-signal target background simulator, which can realistically simulate both the motion and spatial characteristics of underwater targets in real-time. Meanwhile, it can also simulate background noise and main background reverberation interference, which can effectively replace underwater tests. The proposed target background simulator uses a high-speed DSP(DigitalSignalProcessor)and a computer platform to realize real-time simulations of electrical signals received by array elements of an underwater guidance system in an actual underwater navigation state. In this study, both hardware composition and software design based on parallel processing are described in detail, and the generation principles of the target echo, background noise, and reverberation are discussed. The developed target background simulator is verified experimentally, and the results demonstrated strong real-time performance, expandable functions, and large dynamic range. Finally, the proposed design can be beneficial for the trial production of underwater guidance systems.

articleTitle: A Broadband Doherty Power Amplifier Design with 22.4-dBm Psat and 31% PAE in 45-nm SOI CMOS for 5G Application
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The escalating data demands in contemporary wireless communications necessitate advanced power amplifier (PA) designs to meet stringent requirements of next-generation 5G millimeter-wave transceivers. This paper proposes an ultra-compact broadband Doherty Power Amplifier (DPA). Utilizing a transformer-based output combining and matching network, the proposed PA achieves a significantly smaller chip area compared to conventional Doherty PA design, as well as a low-loss output matching in the millimeter-wave frequency range. An inductor-based Wilkinson power divider is also employed for broadband power splitting. Furthermore, an adaptive bias network is adopted to enable real-time input signal tracking to optimize the linearity and efficiency of the PA, resulting in a high power-back-off efficiency. The simulation results demonstrate a saturated output power (P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sat</inf>) of 22.4 dBm with a peak power-added efficiency (PAE) of 31%, and an output power of 16.7 dBm with a 6-dB back-off PAE of 16%. The DPA achieves an 8 GHz 1-dB P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sat</inf> bandwidth (BW) from 18.5 GHz to 28.5 GHz and a 13.6 GHz 3-dB small-signal bandwidth from 15.9 GHz to 29.5 GHz in 45nm SOI CMOS technology.

articleTitle: An improved adaptive navigation control model for state prediction of the forward vessel
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of poor model prediction performance caused by the uncertainty of the forward vessel's speed in the ship adaptive navigation system, temporal convolution network (TCN) is used to predict future acceleration based on the actual speed and acceleration of the forward vessel, and the predicted acceleration is used as a disturbance to construct improved forward vessel adaptive navigation state prediction model.Historical data verification shows that compared to the Univariate long short-term memory network model (LSTM), the new model has an R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> value 0.75 and an RMSE value of 2.48, indicating that the new model has better fit and higher prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Beacon Calibration Algorithm Based on Probability Graph Model
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of acoustic technology, underwater localization plays an increasingly important role in the field of Marine resources exploitation and Marine military field. In order to accurately obtain the underwater target position, long baseline positioning method is often adopted. However, the accuracy of the beacon position greatly affects the accuracy of the target position. This paper studies the principle of probability graph model and underwater positioning technology, establishes factor graph model for absolute calibration of beacon in long baseline positioning process, and then deduces edge probability distribution function of target position variable by sum-product algorithm. Finally, the validity of the probability graph method is verified by lake test. When the amount of data is sufficient, the positioning accuracy of probability graph method and least square method is the same order of magnitude.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of UML-based Welding Management System
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In a rapidly growing manufacturing environment, students and corporate tradesmen play a vital role in welding competence.Welding technology, as a basic and critical skill, occupies a pivotal place in the training system of colleges and universities.However, in order to more effectively meet the needs of the industry and enhance the market competitiveness of students, the welding training platform is in urgent need of intelligent and safe reform and innovation.This paper in-depth study of the ‘ theoretical assessment and physical training’platform host computer management software design and development, the use of UML software modelling technology, a comprehensive introduction from the needs analysis to the platform to build the various stages, to ensure that the system's scalability.

articleTitle: Road Surface Damage Detection Based on Improved YOLOv5 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the shortcomings of YOLOv5 road surface damage detection algorithm in detection accuracy and practicability, and combined with the characteristics of road surface damage, YOLOv5 model is improved. Preprocess the collected road image to improve the image quality. Add a squeeze incentive attention mechanism module between the last C3 module and the SPPF module of the backbone network to build an improved YOLOv5 model. The improved model can focus on the channel features with the largest amount of information and suppress unnecessary channel features, thus greatly improving the accuracy of damaged target detection. The improved YOLOv5 model is used for detection experiments on open source datasets and actual scene damaged images. The experimental results show that the improved model shows good adaptability and robustness, and the detection accuracy is also higher, which can more effectively detect damaged targets on the road surface.

articleTitle: The risk identification of streamed flight data based on deep temporal network
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Compared with post-flight operations quality assurance, it is preferable to identify the operation risks by monitoring streamed flight data. A risk identification method based on streamed flight data deep learning was studied, and the proposed method was further verified in aircraft approaching flight. A deep temporal network (DTN) was constructed by combining temporal convolutional networks (TCN) with gated recurrent units (GRU). Firstly, the DTN was used to extract the long-term memory and the local time-dependent features based on the offline flight dataset. Secondly, the DTN was simplified to the DTN-R network which is suitable for online anomaly monitoring. The anomaly detection tests based on real streamed flight data show that the DTN-R is able to identify typical anomalies including high speed exceedance (HSE), glide slope deviation (GSD) and late flap setting (LFS), thus achieving the online risk monitoring. By studying different risk features, the DTN can be extended to identify other inflight risks. Providing the score of risk confidence, the DTN-R is helpful to explain the causes of abnormal risks. Furthermore, the proposed methodology provides an effective way of assuring flight safety.

articleTitle: Radar Antenna Scanning Pattern Recognition Method Based on LSTM Network
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Radar antenna scanning patterns include mechanical scanning, one-dimensional phased array scanning, and two-dimensional phased array scanning. When facing radar emitter whose radar type is unknown, the antenna scanning pattern is a critical factor in assessing the threat level. Traditional identification methods are based on expert features and often fail to adequately consider factors such as amplitude-frequency response and measurement errors. This paper employs short-term interpolation for noise reduction and long-term LSTM for classification and recognition. Experiments show that this method has good accuracy in identifying pulse sequences under conditions of frequency variation and measurement errors, making it valuable for practical applications.

articleTitle: Underwater Target Tracking Based on Siamese Fully Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The underwater acoustic detection environment is complex and subject to significant noise interference, leading to high similarity between underwater acoustic image speckles and background images. This similarity makes it difficult for target tracking algorithms to accurately obtain histogram confidence estimates, resulting in rough and discontinuous tracking trajectories. To address this issue, a method for tracking underwater acoustic image speckle targets based on Siamese fully convolutional network is proposed. The histogram confidence estimates for the target template and search area in underwater acoustic images are determined, and a self-restarting mechanism for the learning rate is simulated, with the learning module initialized by given correct annotations. The predictive learning module is updated based on the confidence estimates, effectively distinguishing the speckle target to be tracked from similar targets and achieving precise tracking of the speckle target. Experimental results show that our method produces smooth and continuous tracking trajectories for underwater acoustic image speckle targets, exhibits good resistance to noise interference, and has high accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Research on modular unmanned detection robot based on 2-in-1 land-air-amphibious robot
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This rescue robot is designed in the context of the global rise in disasters and the development of intelligent disaster rescue. This robot is designed for unmanned detection and rescue in disaster affected areas. The study is based on the remote control detection and rescue robot composed of Windows computer and STM32F107 microcontroller with upper and lower computer. The overall structure of the robot consists of two modules: a six-football body device and an amphibious ellipsoidal device, with three types of motion: crawling, rolling and flying. The device is equipped with a variety of detection and sensing components and redundant component interfaces, and can perform a variety of tasks. The robot is amphibious, unmanned and modular in design to increase the size, safety and flexibility of exploration of the affected area.

articleTitle: Design of a precision irrigation nursery system based on binocular vision system
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In response to the increasing demand for precision irrigation technology in smart agriculture, this study designed and studied a precision irrigation seedling system based on a binocular depth camera. In order to solve the problem of seedling data collection and precise control of the robotic arm, the 3D mapping and neural network recognition technology of binocular depth camera were used to comprehensively analyse the growth environment and species of the seedlings to obtain the key parameters of water demand analysis. In addition, the system analyses the distance between the water-deficient part of the seedling and the robotic arm through depth ranging, calculates the coordinate system and precisely controls the robotic arm for irrigation. The simulation experimental results show that the system effectively improves the irrigation accuracy and efficiency, provides a feasible solution for smart agriculture, and provides a new reference for water-saving irrigation and crop growth monitoring.

articleTitle: The capacity price mechanism of energy storage power station considering the whole life cycle and capacity credibility
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the construction of new power systems and the access of high proportion of new energy sources, the stable operation of traditional power systems has been challenged. As a power source with flexibility and regulation ability, new energy storage can achieve peak shaving and valley filling and promote the consumption of new energy. By establishing a model considering the credibility of capacity and the cost and benefit of the whole life cycle, the capacity price of energy storage power stations is calculated, and the current capacity price cannot cover the staged problem of unrecovered fixed costs, so as to promote the reasonable positioning of new energy storage in the power market and the reasonable formulation of capacity electricity prices.

articleTitle: Prediction of Global Warming Trends Using ARIMA-BP Neural Network and Their Implications for Water Resources
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper quantitatively analyzes global warming using collected data and develops four predictive models: the Grey prediction model, ARIMA model, BP Neural Network model, and ARIMA-BP Neural Network model. The analysis reveals that the ARIMA-BP Neural Network model offers the best fit with minimal error, making it the most reliable for predicting future temperatures. Projections indicate that the Earth’s average surface temperature will not reach 20°C until the 22nd century, with predictions varying slightly among the models. Additionally, correlation analysis shows that global temperature is influenced by both time and location, with temperatures decreasing with latitude and stabilizing over time before rising due to global warming. The study also examines the regional impacts of natural disasters, such as volcanic eruptions and forest fires, and the global effect of COVID-19 on temperature. Based on these findings, the paper proposes measures to address global warming and mitigate its effects.

articleTitle: Application of OpenCV multi video mosaic fusion in group robot control
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Swarm robot control technology shows great potential in improving production eficiency and optimizing resource allocation. However, how to obtain comprehensive environmental information has become a major challenge. Therefore, this study proposes a real-time mosaic fusion algorithm of multi video images based on OpenCV, which aims to provide global vision for swarm robot. video mosaic technology has been widely used in the fields of monitoring, navigation and scene understanding. It provides more comprehensive environmental information for the observer by seamlessly splicing multiple video images together to form a wide viewing angle or panoramic image. In the control of swarm robots, this technology can significantly improve the perception ability of robots to the environment. In this study, the real-time mosaic and fusion of multiple video images are realized by using the modules of feature point detection, feature matching, image transformation and image fusion in OpenCV. Among them, multi band fusion, image smoothing and other technologies are used to reduce the stitching gap and image distortion, and improve the stitching quality. The experimental results show that the multi video image real-time mosaic fusion algorithm proposed in this study can efectively provide global vision for swarm robots.

articleTitle: Automatic Classification of DEM Terrain Based on GMF-HRNet
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this study, to address the problems of multi-source data input, low classification accuracy, and fuzzy segmentation boundaries in the terrain classification task, NASADEM is used as the data source, and part of the Shaanxi Province of China is intercepted as the dataset, so as to propose an optimized semantic segmentation network model, GMF-HRNet, to achieve efficient and automatic classification of the basic landform types. Initially, we introduce a Gated Attention Block (GA Block) to efficiently extract terrain feature information and enhance semantic information. Subsequently, in order to take into account the complementarity and inherent dissimilarity among features of varying scales, a Multi-scale Gradual Feature Fusion module (MGFF) is devised to aggregate global and local information, thereby significantly improving classification accuracy. The experimental results show that the mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of GMF-HRNet reaches 78.16%, which is improved by 3.73% compared with the original model, and at the same time exceeds the mainstream semantic segmentation network model, which has a wide range of application prospects in the research field of the intersection of geography and computer disciplines.

articleTitle: A study on the forecasting of agricultural product price trends based on SARIMA
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Agriculture has always been the foundation of national stability and people's well-being, especially food and oil agricultural products as an important part of people's daily diet, and its price fluctuations have a far-reaching impact on the social economy. This paper predicts the price fluctuation trend of grain and oil agricultural products based on the SARIMA model. By analyzing the monthly price data of agricultural products marketplaces throughout the year released by the National Bureau of Statistics of China from 2018 to 2022, the seasonal fluctuation characteristics of the prices of agricultural products, such as rice and rapeseed, are summarized, and the price fluctuation trend of agricultural products is predicted using the characteristics as parameters. The results of the study show that the SARIMA model has high accuracy and good fitting quality in the prediction of agricultural product price volatility trends, and the assumption of residual normality is well satisfied. The model is of great significance in assisting the government to formulate agricultural policies and protect farmers' interests and market stability.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Autonomous Controllability of Computer Equipment in Control System Based on FAHP
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As the "brain" of power grid dispatching operation, the control system gradually requires higher levels of autonomy and controllability of the system and equipment. However, the localization level of computer equipment chips used in current system construction needs to be improved, and autonomous and controllable applications are subject to certain constraints. This article analyzes the necessity of autonomous and controllable evaluation of control system computer equipment, clarifies the scope and principles of evaluation, and constructs a complete set of indicators, methods, and processes for autonomous and controllable evaluation of computer equipment around multiple dimensions, comprehensively and accurately evaluating the autonomous and controllable capabilities of the entire equipment and its components.

articleTitle: A Ku-Band Circularly Polarized Antenna Array with Low Axial Ratio
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper presents an 8×8 scale Ku-band circularly polarized antenna array with low axial ratio. The antenna array contains four-point feeding antenna elements, rectangular shield cavities formed by metallic via-holes, and coaxial-like structures. To reduce the interface of the coaxial-like structure to the radiation performance of the antenna array, the coaxial-like structure is designed to integrate with the shield cavity. Combining multi-point feeding circularly polarized antenna element with rotating subarrays technology, the axial ratio of the synthesized beam of the antenna array is less than 2dB within the whole scanning range of -60° to 60°. The proposed antenna array can cover the bandwidth of 14.5-16.5GHz with VSWR<1.1, and has average realized radiation gain higher than 21.5dBi.

articleTitle: An Efficiency Optimization and Constant Voltage Output Technology Based on Three-Coil WPT System
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Constant voltage (CV) charging and efficiency Optimization are the most basic and primary targets to be achieved in wireless power transfer (WPT) systems. This brief proposes a three-coil WPT system based on efficiency optimization and constant voltage output technique. Under heavy-load conditions, both the inverter and rectifier operate in full-bridge mode with satisfactory efficiency. Under light-load conditions, the rectifier is reconfigured into a voltage-doubler and half-bridge rectifier, which forces the equivalent resistance close to the optimal equivalent load resistance (OELR) to improve the transfer efficiency of the system. It can ensure system efficiency in the range of 90.4% to 92.4% when the load is from 20Ω to 200Ω. Meanwhile, the inverter is reconfigured into a half-bridge inverter to achieve CV charging. Different from existing methods such as multi-coil and switch arrays, optimal-frequency tracking, and maximum-efficiency tracking (MET), this technique avoids redundant compensation components, complex control techniques and additional converters. Finally, after the simulation validation, which proves the feasibility of the proposed technology.

articleTitle: A Method to Evaluate Product Development System for Civil Aviation Power System Based on SAE ARP4754A
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In response to the public's concern about the safety and reliability of civil aviation products, SAE ARP4754A was published. The international mainstream civil aircraft manufacturers and system-level and equipment-level suppliers have referred to SAE ARP4754A when establishing their own product development systems, and on this basis, they have formed system documents such as guidelines, regulations, templates, and checklists applicable to their respective products. Most of Chinese aviation manufacturers are also gradually establishing product development systems for their own products. From the perspective of a power system R&D company, this paper introduces a method of evaluating the construction and operation of the suppliers' product development system, According to this method, the evaluation activities are scored from four dimensions: R&D team, R&D tools, R&D procedures and R&D activities. After the evaluation, the scores of the four dimensions were weighted and averaged according to the set weighting, 20%, 20%, 30%, and 30%. In the end, the five suppliers, companies A, B, C, D, and E, scored 70.5, 62.4, 71.6, 68.8, and 79.0, respectively. In addition, this paper also gives some practical suggestions, such as conducting the evaluation in conjunction with the project milestone review, or scheduling the evaluation according to the progress of product development.

articleTitle: Multi-head Attention and Multi-scale Feature Fusion for Remote Sensing Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Remote sensing image classification plays important role in land use and land cover monitoring applications. However, remote sensing images contain multi-scale objects which are challenging for many previous methods. Besides, high semantic features are further needed to handle the large intra-class variances and subtle inter-class difference. Different from many previous methods that design complicated structure to learn informative features from remote sensing images, a plugin multi-head attention and multi-scale feature fusion modules are designed to learn discriminate features with better semantic understanding of the remote sensing image. experiments are conducted on two widely used datasets of UC-Merced and AID. Comparisons with some relevant state methods evaluate the superiority of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Map-Free Trajectory Prediction in Traffic with Motion-Pattern-Enhanced Hyper-Relational Interaction Modeling
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Trajectory prediction in complex traffic scenes requires both accurate and real-time. Most of the existing advanced map-based Trajectory prediction methods rely heavily on high-definition maps for higher accuracy, but the high-definition maps in open driving environments are extremely expensive to construct and maintain, which hinders the generalization of such models. Another type of map-less methods have a faster reasoning speed, but they perform much lower in complex scenes than the map-based methods due to the lack of map information constraints. To this end, we present a two-stage map-less Trajectory prediction method. First, a contrastive learning-based encoder captures motion patterns, providing implicit constraint semantic. Second, an adaptive multi-granularity hypergraph topology construction module and a bi-directed hypergraph attention module capture complex interaction patterns among agents. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance when comparing with advanced map-less methods and competitive performance against most map-based methods.

articleTitle: Intelligent infusion monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to monitor the infusion situation of patients in real time, assist medical staff to replace the liquid medicine in time, solve the hidden dangers caused by the shortage of medical resources and improve work efficiency and patient satisfaction, this study designed an intelligent infusion detection system composed of four parts: detection, display, alarm and data transmission. The system includes microcontroller minimum system, drip rate detection module, liquid level detection module, stepper motor control circuit, DS18B20 temperature detection circuit, relay temperature control circuit and WIFI wireless transmission circuit and other key parts. The droplet detection module detects the speed of droplets in the current medicine bottle, and then sends it to the microcontroller through the LM393 comparator. After calculation, the droplet speed will be displayed on the OLED LCD screen. When the droplet speed is higher than the upper limit or lower limit, the buzzer alarms, and the current data can be transmitted to the cloud platform server for display through the WIFI module. To sum up, the system can well meet the current medical needs and provide patients with more efficient and safe infusion services.

articleTitle: Effective Intrusion Detection in Imbalanced Network Traffic using XGBoost and LightGBM
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the continuous evolution of network attack methods, traditional Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) face increasing challenges. To improve the accuracy and responsiveness of IDS, this paper proposes a network traffic classification approach based on two machine learning algorithms: XGBoost and LightGBM. We train and evaluate both models using several publicly available network traffic datasets to compare their performance in handling different types of network attacks. The models are evaluated using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score, while confusion matrix analysis assesses performance across various attack categories. Experimental results show that XGBoost outperforms LightGBM in most attack categories, especially in detecting DDoS attacks, where it demonstrates higher precision and recall. On the other hand, LightGBM offers advantages in training speed and memory consumption, making it more suitable for large-scale datasets. Based on accuracy, efficiency, and resource consumption, this paper provides two effective machine learning methods for network intrusion detection and discusses their application scenarios and potential improvements.

articleTitle: Ice thickness prediction algorithm based on the Makkonen-Transformer model
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The thickness of ice around power transmission lines is influenced by numerous parameters. The accurate measurement of key parameters is challenging, which leads to the relatively low prediction accuracy of existing models for ice thickness. A prediction method for ice thickness around power transmission lines based on the Makkonen-Transformer model is proposed. As the most key parameter, freezing coefficient is measured very difficultly. In this paper, the freezing coefficient is predicted by the Transformer model using the historical data related to the ice thickness, and then the ice thickness is predicted with the Makkonen model. This approach combines the advantages of machine learning and physical computational models in the issue of ice thickness prediction, overcoming the strong reliance of machine learning on data quality and quantity, as well as the difficulty in obtaining key parameters in physical computational models. Therefore, the proposed model enhances the prediction accuracy of ice thickness around power transmission lines. The simulation results show that the proposed model has higher accuracy compared with existing single machine learning methods and can provide a scientific basis for grid enterprises to formulate the strategies for anti-icing and disaster reduction.

articleTitle: A Fair Priority Scheduling Algorithm for UAV Ad hoc network
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The purpose of the packet scheduling algorithm is to calculate the order in which users are allocated resource blocks according to the scheduling formula when there are multiple services that need to transmit data at the same time. Furthermore, the channel state, priority, past throughput and other factors of the node should be comprehensively considered. In this paper, a packet scheduling algorithm based on service priority and fairness is proposed. The algorithm can realize differentiated treatment of different priorities, and can dynamically increase the priority when there is no resource allocation for medium and low priorities for a long time. The simulation results of the proposed scheduler indicate an evident improvement of the QoS performance parameters for non-emergency services, packet loss rate, average throughput, fairness.

articleTitle: Research on Target Detection Algorithm for Traffic Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low model recognition accuracy, easy to miss detection as well as false detection of target detection algorithms in complex traffic environments, this paper proposes an improved target detection algorithm based on YOLO v8. Firstly, SPD-Conv is used to replace the traditional step-size convolution and pooling layer in the YOLOv8 backbone network to reduce the loss of fine-grained information and enrich the feature information of small objects occupying small pixel ratios; then, a small target detection layer with a size of 160x160 is added to the YOLOv8 neck network to obtain a smaller receptive field and solve the problem of inconsistent scales in detecting small targets, which results in the semantic information loss problem. In this paper, experimental validation is carried out on the BDD100K dataset, and the results show that the average accuracy of the improved algorithm proposed in this paper is improved by 6.4% compared with the original YOLOv8, which effectively improves the target detection accuracy of the model for the traffic scenario under the condition of ensuring the detection speed.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Management System for Sugarcane Field Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low mechanization level, insufficient technology supply, low efficiency and low yield in the field of sugarcane cultivation, this paper carries out an in-depth research in three dimensions, namely, intelligent management system of sugarcane field, planting monitoring platform and mobile application. Using IoT technology methods, precise monitoring of sugarcane growing environment, timely diagnosis of pests and diseases, and scientific prediction of yield were realized. The functions, data transmission efficiency and reliability of the system were comprehensively tested through simulation experiments on sugarcane growth under different environmental conditions. The experimental results confirm that the intelligent management system of sugarcane field using IoT technology is practical and feasible, which can not only significantly improve the intelligent management level of sugarcane cultivation, but also effectively reduce the production risk and enhance the economic benefits.

articleTitle: Research on path planning method for staircase turning platforms
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For indoor path planning, it is essential to account for inter-floor navigation requirements. The unmanned vehicle must navigate the turning platform when ascending or descending stairs. These narrow platforms, combined with the vehicle's large size, increase the risk of collisions and scrapes while turning. To address this issue, an improved A* algorithm is proposed. This method first expands obstacles when generating a 2D grid map and improves the cost function of the A* algorithm by introducing the reciprocal distance between node n and the handrail of the turning platform, to avoid obstacles as well as adding a turning cost function to make the planned path smoother. By comprehensively considering these costs, a safer and more feasible path can be planned. Next, the ‘arc collision detection method’ is used to calculate whether the arc of the vehicle's diagonal during a turn overlapped with surrounding obstacles, effectively preventing the vehicle from colliding or scraping against obstacles while turning. Then, Bezier curve is used to smooth the path, solving the problem of sharp turns that are unfavorable for vehicle movement. Simulation experiments demonstrate that, with this method, the unmanned vehicle can safely navigate stair turning platforms, achieving shorter path lengths and planning times compared to traditional algorithms..

articleTitle: AES-based Privacy Protection strategy of virtual power plant under blockchain
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As the energy structure shifts from fossil fuels to renewable energy, the energy industry is evolving towards decentralization and intelligence, with virtual power plants gradually gaining attention as a novel form of energy organization. However, virtual power plants still face significant challenges in data privacy protection when participating in electricity market transactions. To address the issue of privacy leakage, this paper proposes a privacy protection strategy for virtual power plants based on a blockchain integrated with the AES algorithm. Firstly, the AES algorithm is used to encrypt the transaction data information to ensure that the internal data of the virtual power plant is encrypted and protected during the calculation process. Second, the RBFT consensus algorithm is combined with blockchain technology for data storage and identity verification. Finally, through MATLAB simulations, the effectiveness of this algorithm in protecting privacy during transactions is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Indoor Localization for MmWave wireless System Using Diversity Property of RIS Device
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Indoor localization, which aims to provide localization level with centimeter accuracy, is becoming one of key research topics for beyond 5G/6G systems. In addition, wireless system over mmWave band will be more efficient candidate which can achieve higher bandwidth efficiency due to large bandwidth resource and more accurate localization due to high space resolution of mmWave signal. In recent years, a new and powerful low-cost reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) has been proposed and be employed to configure a smart wireless environment for the capacity enhancement of many wireless technologies. RIS can control wireless channel by changing the direction of the reflected signal. Therefore, for one receiver location, system can generate many location-related data by using different RIS propagation pattern. This diversity property can be used for the improvement of localization accuracy. Based on this property, in this paper, we will propose a low-complexity fingerprint-based localization for mmWave system. The simulated results confirm its efficiency even if the RIS cell has only limited phases for usage.

articleTitle: Adaptive Virtual Mode Control for Adaptive Dynamic Walking of Bipedal Robots on Uneven Terrain Conditions
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Efficient locomotion control in uneven terrain environments is the essential function for bipedal robots’ off-road application.
