This paper presents a adaptive fuzzy-virtual-model controller for stable walking management of bipedal robots in uneven terrain environments. The proposed controller incorporates the fuzzy logic mechanism that allows dynamic adjustment of robot's virtual control parameters for the swing leg according to the kinematic state, which devote to achieve a efficient tracking control for the swing leg ’s movement. Simulation result shows that the proposed controller can traverse through the typical uneven terrain while maintaining an average speed of 0.5 m/s.

articleTitle: Integrated waveform design of ITS channel and radar communication
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This article demonstrates the time-varying nature of time-frequency domain channels and the sparsity of time-delay Doppler domain channels through simulation. The concepts and formulas of ambiguity function, PAPR, and BER are given, and the basic principles and integrated system structure of OFDM modulation are introduced. The ambiguity function formula of OFDM signals is derived, and its ambiguity function is verified to be a pushpin type through simulation. The formula for PAPR of OFDM signal is given, and simulation shows that PAPR increases with the increase of subcarrier number M. Then, the basic principle and system structure of OTFS modulation were introduced, and the ambiguity function of OTFS signal was given based on OFDM signal. It was proved that the ambiguity function of OTFS signal is also a pushpin type, and the PAPR of OTFS signal was analyzed. Finally, the relationship between PAPR and symbol number N of OFDM and OTFS signals was demonstrated through simulation, as well as the BER of the two signals at different target speeds. The advantages and disadvantages of the two modulation methods were analyzed from the aspects of CP length and modulation and demodulation complexity.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Motion Compensation Algorithm Based on Staged Velocity Estimation for High-Speed Weak Targets
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The Linear Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (LFMCW) signal is highly sensitive to the radial motion of the target, which necessitates precise motion compensation. High-speed weak targets, characterized by rapid motion and low signal-to-noise ratios (SNR), impose high demands on motion compensation algorithms. In this paper, an improved motion compensation algorithm based on staged velocity estimation is presented, which significantly reduces computational complexity while maintaining accuracy compared to traditional methods. The Radon transform is applied to obtain a coarse velocity estimate along with its error range. This error range is then used as a refined search interval for precise velocity estimation using the Radon-Fourier Transform (RFT). The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is validated by simulation experiments, which demonstrates its ability to achieve reliable motion compensation for high-speed weak targets.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Trajectory Planning Based on the IAPF-CRRT* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of RRT* algorithm, such as large sampling randomness, low search efficiency, and great impact on the quality of search trajectory due to the limited number of iterations, a RRT*-Connect algorithm combining improved artificial potential field (IAPF-CRRT* algorithm) was proposed to realize trajectory planning in complex three-dimensional environment. In the direction of point expansion, improved gravitational and repulsive fields were introduced to guide the point expansion process and limit the randomness of the expansion. In this study, a dynamic step length selection method was proposed for the random tree point step length, and whether the current point was in the repulsive field was discussed, so that different expansion step length could be determined. The results showed that compared with RRT* algorithm, the designed IAPF-CRRT* algorithm had less planning time, shorter trajectory length, higher point utilization rate, which had significantly improved the planning efficiency.

articleTitle: Application Research of Small Drones in Future Operations
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Small drones are characterized by small size, light weight, low cost, easy operation and guarantee. They are used more and more widely in modern war. Their application in war has become the focus of attention. In The paper, we expounded the definition of small drones and the composition of small drone system. We have analyzed the small drones in the mountain reconnaissance, target strike and communication relay application scenarios. We have explored the basic tactical applications of the small drones in the future operations such as single combat, "swarm" combat, no man-machines coordination and bait. The small drones facing realistic challenges in combat applications have been combed. It can provide useful guidance for future efficient applications of small and unmanned users.

articleTitle: Development of Automotive Exhaust Emission Detection System Based on Fuzzy PID Adaptive Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the theory of fuzzy PID control, a brand-new and efficient automobile exhaust emission detection system is successfully developed through constant speed, constant torque and constant power control. The system is designed with a signal conditioning circuit to achieve monitoring of automobile exhaust emissions. This paper elaborates the technical route of the development of the automobile exhaust emission detection system, introduces the detection methods, procedures and criteria for automobile exhaust emissions, analyzes the overall structure of the automobile exhaust emission detection system, discusses the design of the system, and carries out system tests and result analysis to improve the level of automobile exhaust emission detection.

articleTitle: RGBT Tracking via Multimodal Bias Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: RGBT tracking is mainly implemented by mutual enhancement and complementarity of two modalities, RGB and TIR, so that it can effectively perform target tracking in various complex environments. The multimodal interaction plays a critical part in it. Previous methods use symmetric operation in each interaction, which allows RGB and TIR to influence each other in each interaction. However, this approach ignores the problem that when a single modality is poor in quality, it may introduce background noise into the other modality. Moreover, in this coarse interaction, unnecessary redundant noise is actually introduced for the side with better modal quality. To overcome these limitations, we design a novel Multimodal Bias Enhancement (MBE) module, which is based on an adaptive token selection strategy that enables the better quality modality to perform cross-modal interactions on the poorer modality by recognizing the differences in the selection results. During each bias enhancement, the better modality performs a focused enhancement on the other modality, thus improving the features of the poorer modality and providing it with more robust multimodal context information. Our MBE module is inserted into the ViT backbone for biased modality enhancement to accomplish cross-modality interaction. We evaluate the MBE module on two RGBT tracking benchmarks, including RGBT234 and LasHeR. The experimental results show that our method achieves advanced performance.

articleTitle: Energy Aware SFC Offloading On PDP Switches Based On DQN
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Network Function Virtualization decouples network functions from hardware, allowing user service requests to be fulfilled by software running on general-purpose servers. This technology is critical in data center (DC) networks. Network services are delivered through Service Function Chains (SFCs) composed of different Virtual Network Functions (VNFs). Currently, the increasing energy consumption of data centers has drawn significant attention, and the energy wastage caused by SFC processing on data center servers is a critical issue. In this paper, we propose an energy-aware SFC deployment method for heterogeneous platforms, named SFC-EQ, based on Deep Q-Networks (DQN). We introduce a programmable data plane SFC offloading mechanism and use the DQN algorithm to optimize VNF node deployment and offloading strategies. This approach dynamically guides the SFC traffic between servers and P4 switches, reducing the energy waste caused by server power cycling and idle states. Experimental results show that the proposed method significantly reduces energy consumption while improving network performance. Simulation results show that our method reduces average energy consumption and processing time by 22% and 31%, respectively, compared to the greedy algorithm, and improves QoS performance by over 60%.

articleTitle: Research on Security Authentication of Internet of Things Perception - layer Nodes Based on Elliptic Curve Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet of Things (IoT), as the basic level of the IoT, the security authentication of nodes in the perception layer is facing many challenges. This paper conducts an in - depth study of the security authentication scheme for IoT perception - layer nodes based on the Elliptic Curve Algorithm (ECC). It introduces the structure and security requirements of the IoT perception layer, and expounds the principles and advantages of the Elliptic Curve Algorithm. It also describes in detail the node security authentication model based on ECC, including aspects such as node identity identification, key negotiation and management, and authentication process. Through a comparative analysis with traditional security authentication algorithms, it shows the high efficiency, security, and applicability of ECC in the security authentication of IoT perception - layer nodes. Finally, the development prospects of security authentication for IoT perception - layer nodes based on the Elliptic Curve Algorithm are prospected.

articleTitle: A VMD-AM-LSTM-based method for health condition assessment of liner-type self-lubricating joint bearings
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The liner type self-lubricating joint bearings are simple in structure and have large load bearing and impact resistance, which are widely used in aerospace, automotive, construction machinery and many other fields. The accurate assessment of their health status can provide a decision basis for the repair and maintenance of the equipment, which can effectively reduce the safety accidents and economic losses. Considering multiple features, such as the friction torque, wear amount and friction temperature and so on, a VMD-AM-LSTM-based method for health condition assessment of liner-type self-lubricating joint bearings is proposed, which is able to predict the degradation tendency of the liner type self-lubricating joint bearing more accurately in order to grasp its health condition. Firstly, a set of fatigue wear tests of liner-type self-lubricating joint bearings under multiple working conditions is carried out by using a comprehensive evaluation testing machine for joint bearings to collect signals such as friction torque, wear and temperature during the degradation of the bearings. Secondly, the VMD method is used to extract features from the collected signals in order to obtain the feature components that can characterize the bearing degradation trend. Then the feature components are normalized and input to the VMD-AM-LSTM model for training and testing. Finally, the Bayesian optimization method is used to optimize the hyperparameters to further improve the prediction accuracy of the model. A series of comparative experimental results show that the proposed method has higher prediction accuracy for the health condition of liner type self-lubricating joint bearings under different working conditions.

articleTitle: A Substrate-Isolated SPAD Integrated with A Fast Active Quench and Reset Circuit in Standard CMOS Process
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs) fabricated in standard CMOS process can be directly integrated with other circuits, making them suitable for cost-effective applications. In this work, a substrate-isolated p-well/deep n-well (DNW) SPAD integrated with a compact and fast active quench and reset (AQR) circuit in standard CMOS process is proposed. The DNW of the SPAD is virtually connected, which makes a deep p-substrate region serve as a guard ring to reduce the edge electric field. In addition, a native MOSFET with a low voltage threshold (VTH) is employed as part of the quench circuit to extend the excess voltage (VEX). Post-layout simulations show that the range of VEX can be extended from 1.7 V to 3.5 V, and a quench time as low as 138 ps can be achieved, which corresponds to a quench slew rate of 25.4 V/ns. Both the quench and the reset time are adjustable, achieving the smallest dead time of 1.2 ns.

articleTitle: Ship false positioning identification method based on big data
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The identification method of false ship positioning information proposed in this paper divides the voyage from the starting point to the destination into multiple sub-voyages, obtains the historical positioning information of each sub-voyage from the starting point to the destination, and averages the historical positioning information of each sub-voyage to obtain the averaged historical positioning information. By obtaining the positioning information of the ship to be identified for each sub-voyage from the starting point to the destination, a false positioning information identification model is set, and the position change curve of the ship to be identified is obtained based on the averaged historical positioning information and the positioning information of the ship to be identified. The monitoring point of the ship to be identified is obtained on the position change curve, and the curve change angle of all two adjacent monitoring points in the entire voyage is obtained. By setting the identification strategy of the positioning information of the ship to be identified, the positioning information of the ship to be identified is identified according to the identification strategy and combined with the curve change angle.

articleTitle: Intelligent Equipment Fault Signal Denoising with Improved Perona-Malik Model Based on Wavelet Transform Module
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to the defects of traditional denoising algorithms for equipment vibration signals, an improved Perona-Malik model based on wavelet transform module was put forward. This new model can be applied to equipment vibration signal denoising by considering partial differential equations in image denoising. At first, the interrelation between wavelet threshold denoising and nonlinear diffusion filtering was studied. Secondly, an improved Perona-Malik model based on wavelet transform module was proposed by structuring a new diffusion coefficient function with wavelet transform module instead of gradient module. At last, the discretization numerical format of this improved Perona-Malik model was provided. The simulation experiments indicate that the improved Perona-Malik model can not only realize signal denoising effectively but also well reserve detail features without signal distortions.

articleTitle: Research on power grid security situation awareness based on linear discriminant analysis and RBF neural network
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the Internet of Things transformation of power information network construction, the development and research of smart grids are becoming more and more intelligent at present. The open network architecture and diverse power demands make the power system increasingly complex and bring huge uncertainties to the construction and operation of the power system. To ensure the safe and stable operation of the power grid, this paper proposes a grid security situation awareness evaluation method based on linear discrimination and RBF neural network. This method first uses linear discriminant analysis (LDA) to optimize the dimensionality reduction preprocessing of sample data, and then uses the training data of the RBF neural network model to realize the perception of power system network security situation.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Hydropower Inspection Agent Technology Based on Large Language Model
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This article conducts an analysis and elaboration from aspects such as the current development status of large model agents, large model agent technologies, large model agent technical architectures, application scenarios, etc.

articleTitle: Distributed intelligent lighting system control based on an adaptive consistency algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Lighting is a part of social infrastructure construction. In modern urban planning and infrastructure development, the lighting load is a significant portion of the electrical load. The demand for lighting load is increasing with the development of urbanization. While ensuring the required illumination, the lighting load can act as a demand response resource to alleviate the imbalance between electricity supply and demand by appropriately regulating the illumination and changing the operating power. Due to the vast number of lighting loads, centralized control for unified regulation is not feasible. Therefore, this paper proposes a distributed consistency algorithm for the dynamic regulation of large-scale lighting loads. By adaptively regulating the coefficients of the consistency algorithm, the system’s convergence rate is accelerated. It has been verified that the system using the optimized algorithm reduces the number of iterations by 33.8%, providing a solid technical guarantee for the implementation of intelligent lighting management in large-scale buildings.

articleTitle: Research and Development and Application of Loader Tipping Warning Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the widespread application of loaders in engineering construction and mining operations, the safety of loaders has received increasing attention. Lateral rollover accidents are one of the important issues affecting the safety of loader operations, which may cause casualties and equipment damage in severe cases. To this end, this paper proposes a loader lateral rollover warning technology based on multi-sensor data fusion. Through real-time monitoring of the loader's tilt angle, speed, center of gravity position and other information, combined with mathematical models to predict the rollover risk, and then provide a warning signal. The experimental results show that the technology has high warning accuracy and strong practical application value.

articleTitle: Optimizing Urban UAV Delivery Networks with Improved K-Means: Insights from Shiyan City
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This study addresses the logistical challenges of urban unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) delivery systems by proposing an enhanced K-Means clustering algorithm tailored for delivery area division. Integrating UAV-specific constraints, such as battery life, payload limits, and dynamic delivery demands, the algorithm optimizes flight distance, energy efficiency, and cluster workload balance. Comprehensive simulations using data from Shiyan City validate the algorithm ’ s effectiveness, demonstrating significant improvements over traditional methods. The findings offer a scalable framework for integrating UAVs into urban logistics networks and provide actionable insights for optimizing UAV operations under real-world conditions. This research also highlights future directions, including incorporating real-time data streams and advanced UAV technologies to enhance logistics adaptability and efficiency.

articleTitle: Discovering u-shapelets with key points for time series clustering
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Focusing on the problem that most existing time series clustering algorithms based on u-shapelets fail to simultaneously balance the efficiency and quality of u-shapelet extraction, this paper proposes a new time series clustering algorithm, keyUS, which identifies u-shapelets based on key points. First, a subset of time series is selected by random sampling from the time series dataset. Then, a two-step method is proposed to identify key points within the sampled time series. Secondly, these key points are utilized to extract subsequences to obtain the u-shapelet candidate set, effectively reducing the number of candidate subsequences while ensuring their high representativeness. Subsequently, the Davies-Bouldin (DB) index is introduced as a new quality evaluation method to ensure that the obtained u-shapelet set exhibits high quality. Finally, use k-Means to cluster the distance matrix constructed based on the u-shapelet set. We make experiments on various datasets and evaluate the performance of the keyUS with 12 baseline methods. The experimental results demonstrate that the keyUS algorithm has higher accuracy and better interpretability. The proposed method can effectively improve the clustering accuracy of time series while ensuring the efficiency of u-shapelet extraction.

articleTitle: Voltage monitoring method for 220kV and below local power grid based on monitoring information event system
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This article introduces a voltage monitoring method for 220kV and below local power grids based on a monitoring information event system. Firstly, collect the initial status of each outgoing switch on the current busbar, as well as the circuit breakers and isolation switches of the lower level substations, to form a matrix of adjacent equipment in the system. Then, based on the topology of the local power grid system, determine the power of the subsequent changes in the adjacent device matrix of the system. After calculation, the results are normalized to obtain the local system topology matrix. On this basis, the voltage signals of the local power grid power points are collected to form a power point voltage matrix, and then combined with the local system topology matrix, the local power grid voltage discrimination matrix is calculated under normal operation mode. Once a system fault signal is received, the real-time local power grid voltage discrimination matrix is quickly calculated, and then the local power grid power loss matrix is calculated to quickly determine the power loss situation of the busbar, line, and subordinate substations. This method can automatically distinguish the voltage in all areas of the local power grid after the automatic switching of equipment busbars and lines of 220kV and below, as well as the backup of lower level substations. It can effectively improve the reporting efficiency of monitoring personnel and operation and maintenance personnel for comprehensive accidents of busbars, lines and other local power grid faults in 220kV and below substations, accelerate response speed, and buy more time for accident handling.

articleTitle: Research on the Improvement of RTS/CTS Mechanism in WAPI Protocol for Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The WAPI protocol has been widely used in power systems because of its excellent identity authentication mechanism, which effectively improves the reliability of data transmission in wireless local area networks (WLANs). However, the RTS/CTS mechanism in IEEE 802.11, the underlying protocol of WAPI, has security risks, and an attacker can realize DoS attacks by flooding RTS or forging RTS frames with oversized Duration to occupy channel resources. To address the above issues, an improved RTS/CTS mechanism for power system WLANs is proposed, which defends against RTS/CTS-oriented DoS attacks by introducing RTS/CTS lead frames and broadcast frames. The performance of the improved RTS/CTS mechanism is simulated and verified by the packet loss rate, throughput and transmission delay indexes. The results show that the improved RTS/CTS mechanism is able to effectively resist the RTS/CTS flooding attack and the oversized Duration attack, and improves the network security under the premise of guaranteeing the network throughput and communication delay.

articleTitle: Principle and Realization Method of Serpentine Maneuver at the Ballistic End of Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The end of the aircraft is facing increasingly severe air defense threat, so it is necessary to maneuver the end to improve the probability of the penetration of the aircraft. This paper expounds the guidance problem of the snake maneuver of the vehicle, and deeply analyzes the maneuver and guidance principles of three snake-like maneuver methods based on overload vector cycle change, velocity vector cycle change and displacement vector cycle change. And this paper put forward the corresponding implementation method. The feasibility of the three principles and the implementation method is verified through the mathematical simulation; Finally, the comparative analysis summarizes the advantages and disadvantages of the above three methods.

articleTitle: The Metrological Traceability Method for a Comprehensive Trackside Vehicle Detection System
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The wheelset of a metro vehicle is a very critical component in the vehicle's travelling part, and its geometry will change with operation, which will pose a threat to the safety of the vehicle. Nowadays, the mainstream inspection method is the trackside vehicle integrated inspection system. In view of the inconvenience caused by the weight of the wheel to the traceability of the system, the design of the portable wheel instead of the traditional standard wheel, greatly reducing the mass of the wheel, so that the traceability of the trackside vehicle integrated detection system can be achieved; at the same time, through the analysis of the field test data and uncertainty assessment to prove the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Research on Defect Detection and Process Control of 3D Printing Mechanical System based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of additive manufacturing (AM) technology, 3D printing has been widely used in industries such as industry, medicine, and aerospace. However, due to the complex manufacturing process and material uncertainty, defects are prone to occur during 3D printing, which in turn affects product quality. In recent years, the development of artificial intelligence (AI) technology has provided new solutions for defect detection and process control of 3D printing mechanical systems. This paper focuses on the research progress of 3D printing defect detection and process control based on artificial intelligence, and analyzes related technologies, challenges, and future development directions.

articleTitle: Logistic Regression and XGBoost Model of Multiple factors on Trust
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The trust study was begun in the 1960s. Previous research has been particularly focused on understanding the psychological underpinnings of trust formation and sustenance, with influences from economic interests, social identity, and self-actualization. However, the majority of these studies relied on qualitative approaches, with limited research incorporating covariates and a lack of studies comparing the magnitudes of these variables' effects. To bridge this gap, we conducted an online survey research and collected 268 valid questionnaires. The dependent variable was generalized trust, while the independent variables included a set of personality traits and social preference measures (e.g., self-esteem, self-control, anxiety, cultural Tightness Looseness (TL), and Belief in a Just World (BJW)). Leveraging the advantages of machine learning, this study identified the key factors (i.e., BJW, TL) contributing to Trust. The exploration of these mechanisms has been crucial in advancing our understanding of how trust operates in different contexts and at different levels of human interaction.

articleTitle: Optimization study of process parameters for integrated 3D printing of concrete
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of scattered process and large area of equipment for Concrete 3D printing with external pumping system, the research group designed an integrated 3D printing equipment. The printhead enables the mixing and blending of concrete powder with water and the extrusion of slurry. In this paper, we conducted experimental testing and research on integrated 3D printing process parameters, and the results showed that the print height (the height of the extrusion end of the printhead from the print cut surface) should be slightly higher than the material thickness. At the same time, the use of variable height can better realize the dimensional consistency and mechanical properties of the parts. In order to achieve the best mechanical properties, the screw speed should be 145 r/min in 3 days, the printing height should be stepped (the first and second layers are 15 mm, the third and fourth layers are 12 mm), the compressive strength is 23.98 ~ 24.30 MPa, the bending strength is 7.83 ~ 8.13 MPa. At 7 days, the screw speed should be 135 r/min, the print height is still stepped, the compressive strength is 31.89 MPa to 34.21 MPa, and the flexural strength is 8.99 MPa to 8.68 MPa.

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship between Technology-Driven Investment and Smart Agriculture Operational Performance
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the DT era, technology-driven investment has become a key means for enterprises to improve their operational performance. This study with A shares involving intelligent agricultural listed companies as the research object, using Python technology research technology driven investment and operational performance, through the establishment of multiple linear regression model, put forward the research hypothesis, build structure equation model, explore technology driven investment, corporate governance and the relationship between intelligent agricultural operation performance. The results show that technology-driven investment has a significant lag impact on operational performance. Technology-driven investment is the antecedent factor of operating performance and has a significant negative correlation with current operating performance, while corporate governance has a significant reverse adjustment effect between technology-driven investment and current operating performance. The research conclusions enrich the antecedent perspective of smart agriculture operation performance, and provide a theoretical basis for smart agriculture enterprises to flexibly adjust technology-driven investment strategies in combination with corporate governance strategy strategy.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment and Control Strategy Based on Civil Aircraft Environmental Control System Project
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Civil aircraft risk management is of great significance in improving system reliability, ensuring flight safety, optimizing design and maintenance, etc. This paper studies the civil aircraft risk management process, taking the environmental control system components as an example to conduct risk management and control. According to the risk rating assessment table proposed in this article, the probability of the occurrence of a risk event is assessed for the Air Cycle Machine (ACM) jamming. The likelihood of a jamming occurring is determined to be rated at 6. And the impact rating of the risk event is assessed as 6. The risk probability index is 60. Based on the results obtained from this evaluation method, the engineering team has developed appropriate risk countermeasures and regularly tracks the implementation of measures. We do our best to ensure the successful development of the aircraft's environmental control system with an effective risk assessment and control Strategy.

articleTitle: Person Re-identification based on Data Augmentation And Multiple Deep Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Person re-identification technology is taking a larger proportion in the research direction of pattern recognition. The main purpose of this technology is to identify the presence or absence of person in different time periods in different camera environments. At present, many research scholars have studied the feature representation of person in this technology, and sought and designed a person feature representation that is robust to factors such as viewing angle changes and illumination changes. The person feature extracted by many researchers have achieved very good results in the recognition. In order to better express the person feature, this paper proposes a Data Augmentation and Multiple Feature Fusion method (DAMFF). We consider that different deep convolution network have certain differences in the features extracted from the same person dataset. So we want to deeper fusion features of extracting from different deep convolution network that improve the recognition rate. Specifically, images increased by data augmentation for training and then the features are extracted by different deep convolution network, the final distance is obtained by a specific metric weighted fusion of different metric distance. Our method has achieved better results than other methods on datasets such as Market-1501, CUHK03.

articleTitle: A Home Broadband Maintenance and Installation Solution Leveraging LLM-Agent Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: During home maintenance, LLM (large language Model) can help front-line personnel quickly locate problems, effectively shorten service processing time and fault recovery time, and improve user satisfaction. However, LLM is also prone to hallucination and difficult to deal with complex calculations. Therefore, this patent proposes a home wide installation and maintenance solution based on LLM-Agent, The LLM-Agent model predicts future traffic trends based on historical traffic data and current network conditions. This predictive capability helps operators better schedule and optimize resources, ensuring stable network performance even during peak hours. At the same time, it can also help users better plan network usage and avoid unnecessary traffic waste.

articleTitle: A design study of an amphibious garbage removal vessel based on Arduino
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of garbage cleaning pollution on water and land at the same time, improve the cleaning efficiency and reduce the cleaning cost, this study designed an amphibious garbage cleaning device, with Arduino as the control core, and a control system designed based on the ATmega32u4 chip to control the operation of the cleaning vessel, and the three-dimensional modeling software was used to model and analyze the overall device, which mainly consisted of a garbage gathering device, a conveying device, a crushing device, a water purification device, a compression device, The energy supply device and the driving device are composed of several parts. Finally, through reasonable mechanical structure and system control, garbage collection, water filtration, water purification, crushing, compression, and storage can be integrated, so as to improve the economy, environmental protection and safety of garbage removal.

articleTitle: Research and application of ship identification based on image processing
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Ship name identification carries identity information. Ship data can be collected quickly by identifying the identification characters in the ship image. However, due to many factors such as light pollution, large tilt angle and environmental interference in ship image, ordinary Optical Character Recognition is difficult to process directly. Based on the self-built ship image dataset, this paper completes the preprocessing of the target image by means of gray levelization, straight square equalization and noise removal. Afterwards, the improved character region positioning algorithm and the fusion neural network model are used to realize the extraction of ship number characters. The recognition accuracy of ship number character can reach 92%. At the same time, referring to the method of highway traffic management, this identification method is used as the core function to design the ship identification system.

articleTitle: Sensitive information identification method combining MTL and fuzzy classification
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To address the limitations of traditional sensitive information classification methods when handling complex data structures and fuzzy boundaries, a method combining multi-task learning and fuzzy logic is proposed. The method constructs a multi-task(MTL) model based on LSTM and attention mechanisms, with classification adjustments made through fuzzy logic. Comparative experimental results show that the proposed method significantly outperforms traditional methods in metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and AUC, achieving an accuracy of 99.97%, an F1 score of 0.9993, and an AUC of 0.9994. Compared to models like Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and Neural Networks, this method demonstrates a clear performance advantage. Ablation experiments further validate the contribution of multi-task learning and fuzzy logic in improving model performance. Overall, the model performs excellently across various evaluation metrics, proving its effectiveness and practicality in sensitive information recognition tasks.

articleTitle: FDGM: A Lightweight Model for Privacy-Preserving Encrypted Traffic Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As encryption technologies like SSL/TLS, VPN, and Tor grow more widespread, encrypted traffic classification (ETC) is essential for network management and security. Traditional methods struggle with encrypted data and dynamic ports, posing accuracy and privacy challenges. This paper introduces FDGM (Flexible Deep Grouped Dilated Model), a lightweight and privacy-preserving model for encrypted traffic classification. FDGM efficiently captures spatial and temporal features from traffic packets, achieving 99.3% accuracy on the ISCX-VPN dataset and 99.8% on ISCX-Tor. It outperforms models like Fasttraffic and ET-BERT in both accuracy and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control for A Full-Order Unmanned Undersea System Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Unlike general reduced-order control methods, the control method introduced in this article is grounded directly on the full-order controlled model of an unmanned undersea system. Through stability analysis, the range of values for the control parameters is determined. Recognizing the inherent adaptability of the traditional policy-based reinforcement learning, which targets the action conditional probability distribution function (CPDF) as its learning objective, this article extends this notion and introduces a parameter adaptive adjustment method based on reinforcement learning. The method is based on the classic A2C framework and achieves adaptive adjustment of control parameters by learning the conditional probability distribution function of the parameter. While the method boasts the advantages of higher intelligence and wider applicability compared to classical adaptive methods, it also exhibits superior learning efficiency compared to classical reinforcement learning due to the predefined range of control parameter values based on stability analysis. Through the numerical simulation, the article validates the effectiveness of the introduced method and demonstrates its uniqueness by comparing it with an adaptive control method based on fuzzy logic.

articleTitle: A lightweight Ore recognition and detection network model based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the silica ore target detection task, the original model of YOLOv5 suffers from the problem that the model is too large resulting in long computation time and slow real-time recognition rate. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a lightweight detection model Swift-YOLOv5 based on the improvement of YOLOv5. Firstly, replacing the original convolutional model with the GhostConv to replace the original convolution can greatly reduce the computation and size of the model. Secondly, we introduce the ITA attention module to improve the network performance and feature representation ability, and finally we use the CIOU loss function to speed up the model convergence. The experimental results show that the Swift- YOLOv5 model has a detection speed FPS of 45.2, which is a 84.4% improvement over the original model. The number of parameters of the model is 3.1M, which is 55.6% lower than the original model. The Map of the model is 97.6%. Compared with other networks, Swift-YOLOv5 is more suitable for silica ore detection.

articleTitle: A Single-channel Blind Source Separation Method based on Modulation Parameter Estimation and Signal Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In modern warfare, the electromagnetic spectrum control becomes one of the key factors that determines the outcome of battles. Blind source separation (BSS) technology has been widely applied in electronic reconnaissance to effectively separate various source signals. Addressing the poor performance of traditional single-channel BSS (SCBSS) algorithms under low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions, this paper proposes a SCBSS algorithm based on modulation parameter estimation and demodulated short-time Fourier transform (DSTFT) reconstruction. First, the parameter estimation problem is formulated as an optimization problem, and the instantaneous frequency (IF) and phase of the source signals are accurately estimated through using the quantum-inspired bald eagle search (QBES) algorithm. Then, the DSTFT of the mixed signal is performed to obtain the enhanced time-frequency (TF) distribution of the corresponding source signal. Finally, the source signals are precisely reconstructed by utilizing the TF coefficients near the estimated IF trajectory. Through extensive simulation experiments, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in signal separation is validated, particularly under low SNR conditions, where it demonstrates superior noise robustness compared to the competing algorithms.

articleTitle: Co-Processor Based FSM Generator
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Finite State Machines (FSMs) are critical components in hardware design, particularly in modern System-on-Chips (SoCs), where their complexity and scale continue to increase in resent years, and the complexity leads to the increase of total area occupied by FSMs. In response to these demands, we present an FSM generator, a dedicated co-processor accelerator for handling FSMs within SoCs. This paper proposes an FSM generator, based on the RISC-V architecture, is highly parameterized and reconfigurable, capable of generating an optimized FSM accelerator from a flexible architectural template. Compared to a Cortex-M0-based FSM processor, Simulation results demonstrate that the speed increased by 5×, and core area consumption decreased by 3×.

articleTitle: The Application of DolphinScheduler in the Asian Hazardous Weather Advisory Center System
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The Asian Hazardous Weather Advisory Center is an important meteorological institution dedicated to enhancing aviation weather services in Asia, providing accurate and timely meteorological services to aviation users in various countries through advanced technology and international cooperation. DolphinScheduler, a distributed, easily scalable and highly available data processing platform, plays a significant role in the Asian Hazardous Weather Advisory Center system. This paper introduces the application of DolphinScheduler in the Asian Hazardous Weather Advisory Center system, which makes use of DolphinScheduler's powerful task scheduling and data processing capabilities to effectively improve the efficiency of meteorological data processing and provide more accurate meteorological services for aviation users in Asian countries.

Author Keywords: the Asian Hazardous Weather Advisory Center

articleTitle: Research and Design of Field of View for PAF
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Radio telescope is a reflector antenna for receiving radio signals radiated by cosmic celestial body, and microwave receiver is a signal receiving device placed at the focal position of radio telescope. Because of the limited beam width, single beam receiver can only observe the sky area with fixed field of view. In order to improve the observation efficiency of telescope, multi-beam receiver came into being, because it can apply multiple beams at the same time, especially for sky survey or mapping observation. Phased array receiver is a classification of multi-beam receiver. Compared with the traditional multi-beam receiver composed of discrete feed array, the adjacent beams formed by phased array receiver overlap each other, so the field of view of the telescope formed by combining with radio telescope is not only larger, but also more continuous, which can further improve the observation efficiency. Based on the beam width and equivalent field of view of the radio telescope with reflector antenna, combined with the definition of telescope beam deviation and simulation software, this paper analyzes and compares the beam performance of the telescope in the case of multiple continuous beams, and gives the design method of the field of view of phased array receiver. The above work has certain guiding significance for the realization of the front-end array size and field of view of phased array receiver used for reflector antenna, and the array design can be constrained in combination with the field of view requirements in the future.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning for Automated Pragma-Based Loop Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Loops often dominate the execution time in high-performance computing, effective loop optimization is critical for overall performance. We propose a reinforcement learning–based framework that automatically discovers and composes transformations—including tiling, fusion, interchange, and unrolling—and evaluate the framework on a subset of Polybench benchmarks. Compared to the Polly compiler baseline, our approach achieves an average speedup of 2.46×, peaking at 7× on the jacobi-1d kernel, while also consistently outperforming a global greedy scheduling algorithm. By adaptively combining multiple transformations, the RL-based method exploits deeper synergies with minimal overhead once trained, thus alleviating the repeated manual tuning and hardware-specific adjustments required by conventional techniques.

articleTitle: Research on mental health education of college students based on k-means algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The research on the mental health education of college students is of great significance to improve the mental health level and quality of college students. In terms of research methods, there are both traditional statistical methods of survey data and current research methods of mathematical model algorithm analysis. This paper first collected the relevant data of 11943 college students, including age, gender, somatization, obsessive-compulsive disorder, interpersonal relationship and other 12 factors. Then descriptive analysis of the data is carried out on the basis of data collection. Finally, the K-means algorithm in cluster analysis is used to cluster the mental health problems of college students of all ages and the mental health problems of college students of all ages, and the clustering effect is better when k=4. After the final clustering results are obtained, the results are analyzed and relevant conclusions are drawn and relevant suggestions are put forward. The K-means algorithm used in this paper has a good effect on the analysis of mental health problems, and provides great help for improving the research of mental health education path of college students, which is of great significance.

articleTitle: Study on the operation strategy of wind power photovoltaic and pumping and storage power stations to participate in the power market
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the context of carbon peak and carbon neutrality, wind power and photovoltaic power generation as an important part of clean energy, its large-scale grid connection and stable output pose challenges to the grid. By combining energy storage technologies such as pumped storage power stations (PSPS), the volatility and intermittency of new energy can be effectively suppressed, the acceptance capacity of the power grid can be improved, and the frequency response capacity and standby capacity of the system can be improved. Aiming at the characteristics of Wind power - photovoltaic power(WP) station and PSPS, based on the clearing price of the power market and the conditional value at risk to measure the risk preference level of the combined power station, this paper constructs a joint optimization operation model of Wind power - photovoltaic - pumped storage power station(WPPS) which improves the enthusiasm of the hydropower station to participate in the power market and the competitiveness of new energy in the power market. At the same time, the absorption capacity of new energy is improved, and the stability and adjustment flexibility of the power system are enhanced.

Author Keywords: Combined operation of Wind power - photovoltaic - pumped storage

articleTitle: Design of a Tilt-Rotor Vertical Takeoff and Landing Fixed-Wing UAV
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To meet the requirements of rapid response and flexible operation in fields such as emergency rescue and logistics transportation, a novel tilt-rotor vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) fixed-wing UAV is designed. It features a streamlined fuselage and double-convex trapezoidal main wings, and a hybrid design integrating tilt quad-rotors with fixed wings, enabling excellent vertical takeoff and landing as well as horizontal flight performance. The combined design of the front two tilt rotors and the rear two fixed rotors enhances the stability of the UAV, solves the problems of nose-up and yaw during the tilting moment, and reduces the risk of loss of control. The landing gear is designed as a carbon fiber four-legged type, which not only reduces the weight but also improves the shock resistance, adapting to various takeoff and landing conditions. Through bionic design, inspired by the form of locusts, it has significant advantages in takeoff and landing performance and stability, especially suitable for takeoff and landing requirements in complex terrains. Lithium batteries are used as the power source to ensure light weight and high efficiency. The YOLOv8 algorithm is adopted for real-time target recognition, which can quickly identify disaster-stricken areas and trapped people in complex environments and improve the rescue efficiency. The flight test results show that the UAV has high lift and stability during the flight, with excellent maximum load capacity and endurance. The UAV can greatly improve the efficiency in emergency rescue and material transportation, conforms to the development trend of modern UAVs towards automation and intelligence, and demonstrates broad applicability and high efficiency in various future application scenarios.

articleTitle: Data envelopment analysis method in the evaluation of high quality characteristics of complex mechatronics products
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper describe the application method of data envelopment analysis(DEA)in the quality evaluation of satellite important components. Complex mechatronics products usually consist of numerous critical and complex components, the failure of which can directly affect mission success. Taking the satellite external vector adjustment mechanism as an example, the product interfaces with the satellite main body in multiple ways, including mechanical, electrical, thermal, piping, and high-voltage cables. The production process involves numerous techniques, and any functional failure can cause the electric propulsion system to lose vector adjustment capabilities, thereby impairing the satellite's orbit transfer, attitude control, and angular momentum unloading functions, or even the adjustment capability of other key payloads, resulting in mission failure. This paper proposes a method for DEA and risk assessment based on key product parameters derived from prior information, providing a novel approach for quantitative risk control from a statistical perspective.

articleTitle: Dynamic Graph Contrastive Learning for EEG-Based Epileptic Seizure Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Conventional methods for diagnosing epilepsy using EEG struggle to capture the complex spatiotemporal relationships inherent in brain activity. This paper introduces Dynamic Graph Contrastive Learning (DGCL) for detecting epileptic seizures. DGCL combines dynamic graph neural networks (DGNNs) with self-supervised contrastive learning, enabling the model to capture the intricate spatiotemporal dependencies in EEG data while minimizing the need for labeled data. The model utilizes DGNNs to represent the evolving state of the brain network and applies contrastive learning techniques to extract robust feature representations from unlabeled data. Experiments conducted on the CHB-MIT dataset show that DGCL outperforms existing methods, achieving accuracies of 96.95% for patient-specific data and 73.67% for cross-patient data. Comparisons with other state-of-the-art techniques further validate DGCL’s effectiveness in classification accuracy and its ability to generalize. These results confirm that DGCL offers a promising solution for automated epilepsy detection, especially in cases where labeled data is scarce.

articleTitle: Research and Application of On-orbit Software Updating Technology for Spacecraft Based on Terrestrial-Satellite Communication Links
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of satellite communication technology, the need for remote updating and maintenance of on-orbit satellite system is increasing day by day. In this paper, the uploading strategy, data management, data transmission and reliability of on-orbit update are studied, and the solution of on-orbit injection system is obtained. According to the research conclusion, the design and application of the on-orbit injection system is completed based on DSP microprocessor. This system focuses on the hardware design, data storage scheme, device selection, on-orbit update startup and update strategy, and the evaluation of practical application effect. The research results show that the system successfully completed the on-orbit injection task, and the function, performance and reliability meet the requirements. The research of on-orbit injection strategy and reliability safety in this paper is reasonable and feasible, which can provide theoretical support and technical guidance for on-orbit maintenance of spacecraft.

articleTitle: Research on broad band high amplitude pulse current measurement technology against strong electromagnetic interference
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper addresses the measurement needs of high amplitude wideband pulse current signals and proposes a large dynamic range, wideband, and high stability pulse current measurement technology. It studies the design of MA-level pulse large current Rogowski coils, establishes the wideband winding model of the transient large current condition, proposes an external integral type Rogowski coil design, analyzes the influence of stray parameters, and studies the electromagnetic interference characteristics of the Rogowski coil disk.

articleTitle: Research on Gear Parameter Measurement Method Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to design and implement a gear parameter measurement system based on HALCON. Taking standard involute gears as measurement objects, machine vision technology replaces traditional artificial vision measurement, which improves the efficiency and accuracy of gear detection, and reduces the influence of measurement errors and subjective judgment. A set of image acquisition platform is designed, which can easily obtain high-quality images of gears and provide a solid foundation for subsequent analysis. With HALCON image processing and analysis function, a set of image processing program is designed, which can automatically detect and extract the key geometric parameters of gears, including tooth number, modulus, etc., and display the measurement results intuitively. Through the experimental verification, the system shows a high degree of reliability in identifying the parameters of standard gears, and the measurement accuracy is in line with expectations. The experimental results show that the system can not only provide stable measurement performance, but also have high measurement accuracy, which provides a reference for the detection of gear parameters.

articleTitle: The Harmonic Detection Method for APF based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the issues of low precision and slow speed of traditional harmonic detection methods, the harmonic detection method for Active Power Filter (APF) based on wavelet transform is put forward. The wavelet threshold function is improved to perform smoothing and denoising operations on the current signal, the sliding window iterative Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) is employed to decompose and reconstruct the current signals, and the current signal is decomposed and reconstructed by wavelet transform. As a result, the dynamic performance and detection accuracy of APF system is greatly improved. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional instantaneous reactive power detection method, the proposed method reduces THD by 47.52% and improves the system's dynamic response speed by 12.5%.

articleTitle: Research on Complexity Evaluation Method for Dispatch Automatic Generation Control Software Based on GRA
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of dispatch automatic generation control (AGC) systems, evaluating the software complexity has become essential for optimizing performance and improving reliability. This paper investigates the complexity evaluation of AGC software by analyzing its operational and functional characteristics. A complexity evaluation model is constructed from the perspectives of code structure and software structure. The model introduces a structural complexity indicator based on functional network density and evaluates corresponding metrics using the grey relational analysis (GRA) comprehensive evaluation method. Case studies are conducted to verify the feasibility and applicability of the proposed method. The results demonstrate that this model and evaluation method can provide valuable support for improving software quality, optimizing software testing strategies, and guiding the development of more efficient AGC systems.

articleTitle: t-SNE Based on Hammersley Sequence Initialized Genghis Khan Shark Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Manifold learning is a nonlinear dimensionality reduction technique that preserves the original data features and obtains the intrinsic probability features and distribution structure of high-dimensional data through dimensionality reduction and simplification processing. t-distribution stochastic neighbor embedding (t-SNE) is an important algorithm in manifold learning that can visualize high-dimensional data by preserving the local probability distribution structure of the data in a low-dimensional space. However, the loss function of t-SNE is a strongly nonlinear non-convex function, and parameter optimization often faces difficulties in global optimization and high computational complexity, which limits the efficiency and scalability of the algorithm. To address these issues, in this paper, a derivative-free global optimization algorithm as well as a swarm intelligence method, namely Hammersley sequence initialized Genghis Khan shark optimizer (HSGKSO) has been proposed. The proposed algorithm can achieve stronger global search capability and faster convergence speed, and its effectiveness in finding the optimal solution of t-SNE loss function has been verified through numerical experiments.

articleTitle: Research Status and Development Trend of Fiber Grating Flow Sensing Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the industrial production process, flow, pressure, temperature and level are collectively referred to as the four parameters in process control, and people can monitor and control the production process through these parameter characteristics. The accurate measurement and regulation of flow has become the basis for ensuring the efficient operation, economic safety and management automation of production processes. This paper analyzes the characteristics of fiber grating sensing, and reviews the research status of fiber grating flow sensing technology, including fiber grating differential pressure flowmeter, fiber grating vortex flowmeter, fiber grating target flowmeter, etc. The development trend of fiber grating flow sensor is analyzed.

articleTitle: Identification Method of 220kV Key Substation Based on Guaranteed Supply Requirement Constraint
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To ensure the integrity of the regional power grid structure and minimize load loss, the key 220kV substations in the power grid are identified according to the operation state. It provides decision support for the power grid disaster warning and control. In this paper, the proportion of the important load to the rated capacity of the substation is analyzed first. At the time of heavy load, the substation load rate after the maximum capacity main transformer N1 failure is calculated. Next, based on the non-transferable load and the important load, the ratio between it and the rated capacity of the substation is analyzed and calculated. According to the output power of the power source in the substation supply area through the 110kV voltage level and below, the ratio between the output power of the power source and the important load is calculated. Then, the sum of power flowing into the substation node and the power flowing out of the substation node are analyzed, and the ratio between the power flowing out and the power flowing into the substation node is calculated. Finally, the objective function is established. The 220kV substations are sorted according to the value of the objective function. The effectiveness and adaptability of the proposed method are verified by a provincial power grid.

articleTitle: Design of Grid Operation Control Schemes Following Integration of New Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the establishment of a new type of power system based on new energy, the proportion of new energy access continues to increase, and the study of new energy grid connection has become a hot spot. This paper considers the influence of decentralized and centralized grid-connection methods on power system. This research is based on PSASP simulation platform to calculate the power flow of power system and study the power flow control scheme after grid connection. The results show that power flow can be controlled by increasing generator output and shunt capacitors during peak period. The output of the generator can be reduced during the operation of the trough section, and the shunt reactor can control the power flow. In addition, considering the decentralized and centralized grid-connection of new energy, the power flow can be controlled by reducing the output of generators and shunt reactors. This paper also considers new energy sources, which has certain practical significance under the background of "dual carbon".

articleTitle: Feature fusion-based weighted broad learning system for imbalanced data
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Broad Learning System (BLS), characterized by its flat architecture as an efficient neural network, has garnered significant interest for its benefits in terms of training velocity and network scalability. However, BLS does not perform well when dealing with imbalanced classification problems. First, conventional BLS neglects the intrinsic logical information contained in the original input data, which may be critical for classification and prediction. Second, BLS fails to emphasize the significance of minority classes in imbalanced data scenarios. In this paper, we propose a feature fusion-based weighted broad learning system. Unlike traditional BLS, we combine the original features and broad features as fused features for training. Additionally, we introduce a weight generation mechanism that assigns higher weights to minority classes, enhancing the model’s focus on these classes. A closed solution is available for the issue, and the transformation matrix can be effectively resolved. The experimental results on multiple imbalanced datasets show that our method is superior to other imbalanced methods.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Transaction of Distribution Network Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the increase of demand side flexible load and the development of new energy technology, the power transaction of distribution network is gradually improved. This paper considers the application of blockchain technology to demand-side electrical energy trading. First of all, the basic framework to meet the needs of various flexible loads and distributed energy trading is established, and then the content of blockchain trading technology is analyzed, and the distribution network intelligent trading based on blockchain technology is realized through the deployment of smart contracts that meet the main characteristics of distributed energy-grid-flexible loads, and finally through matching transactions. Finally, the transaction deployment that meets the main characteristics of the distribution network is realized.

articleTitle: ProExRE: A Prototype Learning-Based Explainable Relation Extraction Model
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a prototype learning-based explainable relation extraction model (ProExRE), aimed at enhancing the interpretability of relation extraction to meet the high requirements for interpretability in vertical domains such as healthcare, finance, and law. The ProExRE framework comprises four components: a preprocessing layer, an encoding layer, a prototype layer, and a decision layer. During the training phase, a fixed number of prototypes are learned for each predefined relation type using labeled input samples. In the inference phase, the similarity score between the input and the prototype for each relation type is calculated, and the relation type is predicted based on the similarity score. This framework learns prototypes to represent the feature patterns of relation types, making the decision of relation types interpretable. This helps reveal the evolutionary path of concepts or viewpoints in specific domains and provides more comprehensive prior knowledge for downstream applications.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Model for Detecting Distracted Driving Behavior with Multi-Level Feature Fusion and Efficient Target Extraction
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Distracted driving behavior target detection plays a central role in contributing to the improvement of public health and fire prevention. Given the limitations of existing techniques in multi-scale fusion, feature fusion efficiency, and accurate extraction of key targets in complex data environments, this paper proposes an advanced and efficient innovative algorithmic model-BEC-YOLO, which focuses on solving these challenges with a view to improving the overall detection performance. In this paper, BiFPN is firstly adopted to realize multi-level feature fusion in order to make up for the shortcomings of existing target detection algorithms in feature extraction and recognition, which effectively improves the feature fusion effect. Then, ECA is introduced to significantly improve the efficiency and accuracy of key target information extraction in complex data environments. Finally, the feature representation and fusion efficiency are further enhanced by introducing CBAM. The experimental findings demonstrate a notable 9.8% enhancement in mAP when comparing the approach in this paper to the original model. This highlights the accuracy of the BEC-YOLO model for detecting distracted driving behavior in intricate settings.

articleTitle: Improving Text Summarization with Filtered Attention Mechanism on BERT
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper presents FAM-BERT, a BERT-based text summarization model enhanced with a Filtered Attention Mechanism (FAM), addressing challenges in content selection and redundancy in abstractive summarization. By integrating FAM, the model dynamically identifies and focuses on key content while suppressing irrelevant details, resulting in concise and coherent summaries. Extensive experiments on the CNN/Daily Mail dataset demonstrate that FAM-BERT achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing baseline models such as Transformer, PGN, and BERT across ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L metrics. These results validate the efficacy of FAMBERT in improving content coverage, fluency, and structural consistency, offering a robust solution for high-quality abstractive text summarization.

articleTitle: Dynamic Response Law of Pipeline Winding Optical Fiber under Internal and External Double Adhesive Layers
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to further improve the measurement accuracy of the distributed optical fiber flow sensor, this paper proposes a packaging structure of the internal and external double adhesive layers, and establishes a dynamic model of the distributed optical fiber flow sensor including the internal and external double adhesive layers. The influence law of elastic modulus and thickness of internal and external adhesive layers on the dynamic response of optical fiber is analyzed by theoretical calculation, and the theoretical analysis results are verified by experimental analysis. In practical applications, the internal adhesive layer with large elastic modulus and small thickness and the external adhesive layer with small elastic modulus should be selected to form a double adhesive layers structure.

articleTitle: Temperature self-compensation sensitization fiber Bragg grating strain sensor while drilling
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the measurement requirements of WOB torque near the bit and the temperature-strain cross-sensitivity of fiber Bragg grating (FBG) in MWD, a diamond-shaped FBG sensor with hinge structure is proposed to realize temperature self-compensation and strain sensitization. The parametric modeling and static simulation of the sensor are carried out by using the finite element method. The influence of the hinge size on the grating strain and the maximum equivalent stress at the hinge is analyzed, and the optimal structural parameters are determined by response surface optimization design. Experiments show that the strain sensitivity of the sensor is 4.2 pm/με, and the temperature sensitivity is 2.381 pm/℃, which is 3.5 times and 4.8 times higher than that of the bare grating, respectively. The problem of low sensitivity is successfully solved, which provides a new scheme and research idea for the application of optical fiber sensing technology in the field of MWD.

articleTitle: Research on the Collaborative Control Method of the Turntable and the High-Speed Momentum wheel under High Inertia Load
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Reconnaissance and surveillance satellites are an important part of a country's strategic early warning system and also a key means for the construction and development of the ability to control space information rights. Electronic reconnaissance satellites, as an important link in intelligence reconnaissance and strategic early warning, rely on their wide frequency band, high-timeliness information transmission, and intelligent information processing, and possess relatively strong support capabilities. They have become the foundation and support of the current informationized combat system. In order to obtain ground intelligence comprehensively and effectively, electronic reconnaissance satellites must adopt large receiving antennas with high sensitivity. In response to the urgent need for payload lightweighting at present, it is necessary to study the collaborative control method of the turntable and the high-speed despun Momentum wheel under high inertia load. The despun collaborative control of the turntable and the high-speed Momentum wheel usually requires multiple processors to achieve the synchronous control of the turntable and the Momentum wheel respectively. In this paper, through the DSP, a control method that nests the system-wide algorithm interrupt and the high-speed Momentum wheel motor commutation interrupt is adopted to realize the real-time four-quadrant control of the turntable and the high-speed Momentum wheel. Finally, after experimental tests, when the turntable rotation speed is 90°/s and the load inertia is 60 kg, the residual torque of the turntable subsystem is less than 0.1 Nm, and the speed stability of the turntable reaches 0.2°/s.

articleTitle: Distributed Photovoltaic Island Monitoring Method Based on Gated Loop Unit
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The rapid deployment of distributed photovoltaic (PV) systems has introduced new challenges in islanding detection, a critical task for grid stability and safety. This paper presents a novel Distributed Photovoltaic Island Monitoring Method Based on Gated Loop Unit (GLU). The GLU leverages advanced signal processing and dynamic response mechanisms to enhance detection sensitivity and accuracy. The proposed distributed architecture enables real-time data acquisition and collaborative decision-making across PV nodes, ensuring reliable monitoring under diverse grid conditions.
