Simulations and case studies validate the method’s effectiveness, demonstrating superior performance in terms of detection accuracy, low latency, and robustness when compared to conventional techniques. The proposed approach provides a scalable and efficient solution for improving islanding detection in distributed PV systems, contributing to the development of resilient and intelligent power grids.

articleTitle: Testability Research of Civil Aircraft Cockpit Lighting System
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The cockpit lighting system is a critical human-machine interface that integrates controls, displays, and lighting for status control and indication across various aircraft systems. It enables flight crews to operate aircraft systems and provides illumination and status displays under all cockpit lighting conditions. Effective cockpit lighting design mitigates pilot visual fatigue, enhances operational accuracy, and reduces the risk of human error-induced flight accidents, thus fostering a more comfortable flight environment. Adhering to MIL-STD-2165, this study employs diverse testability design and analysis methods, including FMEA, testability analysis, and BIT design, to enhance the testability and safety of the cockpit lighting system. The research contributes novel perspectives and methodologies for the design and maintenance of future civil aircraft cockpit lighting systems, emphasizing fault detection and prediction to ensure system reliability throughout its lifecycle.

articleTitle: Research on Brake Drum Surface Defect Detection System Based on Machine Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the development of an efficient and accurate brake drum surface defect detection system to meet the growing demands for brake safety performance in the manufacturing industry. The system analyzes common defect types on brake drum surfaces, such as chips and cracks, and designs a comprehensive detection scheme. In terms of hardware architecture, it integrates high-resolution image acquisition equipment and a customized lighting system to ensure clear and comprehensive images of the brake drum surface under different lighting conditions. At the software level, the system implements image preprocessing steps, including noise filtering and contrast enhancement, to optimize image quality. Subsequently, advanced feature extraction algorithms are used to precisely locate and analyze the characteristic information of potential defects. Ultimately, the system achieves the identification of brake drum surface defects. Experimental results show that the system not only effectively distinguishes between different types of surface defects but also exhibits significant advantages in detection speed and accuracy, significantly enhancing the efficiency of quality control on brake drum production lines. Compared with traditional manual detection methods, this system significantly reduces the rates of missed and false detections while alleviating the human workload, providing strong support for the intelligent upgrade of the brake manufacturer industry.

articleTitle: A method for identifying behavioral feature of risk navigation preference
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Currently, research on the causes of improper maneuvering by ship drivers involves a lot of subjective judgments, resulting in significant deviations between research results and actual situations. Based on this, this article constructs a risk navigation preference behavior feature recognition model based on the Shapley Additive Interpretation (SHAP) algorithm and Extreme Gradient Boosting Tree (XG boost) technology. Actual data verification shows that risk navigation preference behavior can be divided into cautious, normal, and aggressive types, among which aggressive ships tend to frequently change their speed during navigation; The recognition accuracy of the model for three types of risk navigation preference behaviors reached 99.4%. Using the selected 11 key features as input variables for the model, the prediction accuracy still reached 99.2%. Although slightly lower than the former, the computation time decreased from 57.22ms to 24.15ms.

articleTitle: Multi-Class Flight Delay Prediction Based on an Improved XGBoost Model
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Flight delay prediction is a critical issue in aviation management. This paper proposes a multi-class flight delay prediction model based on an improved XGBoost, aimed at achieving precise classification of flight delays. The study utilizes 2020 flight operation data from a certain U.S. airline, analyzing and processing the raw data to produce a standardized dataset. In light of the class imbalance within the dataset, a novel loss function is designed for optimization, and feature engineering is employed to enhance the model’s expressive capabilities. Furthermore, to efficiently find the optimal parameter configuration in XGBoost—given its numerous adjustable parameters—Bayesian optimization is introduced. Comparative analyses with various models validate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed model.

articleTitle: A recursive convolutional neural network based on DeBERTa and adaptive pooling for calculating semantic similarity of power grid data
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, research on duplicate data detection in power grid measurement data usually only uses traditional network models or detection methods, and rarely incorporates the concept of machine learning to study. This article starts from the recursive convolutional neural network and adds the high-performance pertained language model DeBERTa to establish a duplicate data detection model, and analyzes it. In the pooling layer module, an adaptive pooling method is used to replace the traditional max pooling module, and an attention layer is creatively added to enhance the focus on key data information, assign weights to different feature vectors, and then perform duplicate detection of data information. Finally, the effectiveness of the model proposed in this paper is validated through case study.

articleTitle: Capacity Planning Optimization of Multi-Level Distribution Network Considering Multiple Flexible Loads
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Compared with the traditional power system, the power supply structure of the new power system takes renewable energy as the main body. With the obvious randomness, fluctuation, and intermittence characteristics, the power grid has higher and higher requirements for flexible controllability, security, and stability. In this paper, the distribution network planning framework based on the resource-network-load-storage cooperation is designed innovatively. To realize the security and stability operation of the power grid and full absorption of distributed power supply, the three key technologies of distributed energy output curve fitting, multiple flexible resource response prediction, and fast sequential operation simulation are required to break through. The five planning contents that complete the distribution network digital modeling, distributed energy prediction, load curve optimization, time series simulation, and comprehensive scheme comparison are realized. Considering the development of distributed energy and flexible load, the multi-level distribution network planning optimization of regional source network load and storage is carried out through a time series simulation platform. Finally, the effectiveness and adaptability of the proposed algorithm are verified by a practical power grid.

articleTitle: Research on the Risk of Water Traffic Accidents Considering Risk Navigation Preference Behavior
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The prediction of ship traffic accidents has always been a hot topic in the industry. Although the traffic safety risk assessment model based on waterway operation status has achieved certain results, it is still unsatisfactory. Therefore, two traffic accident prediction models have been built in the article based on logistic regression algorithm. The first model only considers the main characteristics of waterway operation status as variables, while the second model considers both risk navigation preference behavior and the main characteristics of waterway operation status as variables. Actual data verification shows that compared with the prediction results of the first model, accuracy of the second model has increased by 5.20%, false alarm rate has decreased by 2.51%, false alarm rate has decreased by 6.62%, and Area Under Curve (AUC) value has increased by 0.04. Research results indicate that using the main characteristics of risk navigation preference behavior as variables in traffic accident prediction models yields better results.

articleTitle: Design of Smart Cane Field Management Monitoring System based on Kalman Filter Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, for the traditional sugarcane planting inaccurate fertiliser application, pest and disease control difficulties, relying on artificial experience to produce planting and other issues, from plant irrigation, information transfer and data processing three aspects, in-depth research, using Kalman filter algorithm to monitor the data filtering and denoising process, improve the measurement accuracy, reduce the error, the use of the Internet of Things (IoT) sensor technology and wireless communication technology, to achieve field environment real-time monitoring, efficient use of water resources and early warning of pests and diseases. The experiments were carried out by establishing a simulation model, and the experimental results showed that this technology is highly feasible and provides a scientific basis for further improving the efficiency and yield of sugarcane field management.

articleTitle: Research on the fault propagation law of consecutive k-out-of-n: F systems with local load sharing and boundary effect
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Most of the traditional studies on consecutive k-out-of-n: F systems assume that each component in the system is independent, and some recent studies have studied the reliability model of consecutive k-out-of-n: F systems with local load sharing characteristics between components. In this paper, a reliability model of the consecutive k-out-of-n: F systems considering both local load sharing and boundary effects is established. When a component fails from the middle of the system, the load shared by the failed component will be equally distributed to the two adjacent components, while the load of the other components is less affected. When a component fails from the starting point of the system, the load shared by the failed component is fully distributed to the adjacent component. As a result, the degradation rate of each component in the system (dependent on the load of the component) will become different when considering this new dependence, which makes the failure path of the system more complex. Taking the bolt system of civil aircraft as an example, this work uses the numerical analysis method to explore the fault propagation law of the consecutive k-out-of-n: F systems with this new dependence. The results show that reliability of the consecutive k-out-of-n: F systems is closely related to the choice of the failure criterion k value when the new dependence is considered.

articleTitle: Enhanced VSG Transient Power Angle Stability Transient Damping Design
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Virtual synchronous generator (VSG) can provide voltage and frequency support to the grid, but when the grid is in fault condition, the power angle instability problem similar to that of synchronous generators will occur. In this paper, the mechanism of the influence of VSG damping parameters on the transient stability of the system is investigated by using the phase plane diagram, the relationship between the transient damping parameters and the power angle stability of the VSG system is qualitatively analyzed by using the root trajectory diagram and the dominant pole method, and an optimized damping design criterion to enhance the power angle stability of the VSG is proposed, and an algorithmic flow is designed to quantitatively compute the transient damping parameters by solving the third-order nonlinear equation of state. a MATLAB simulation model is constructed, and the simulation results show that the introduction of transient damping and reasonable configuration of transient damping parameters can improve the transient power angle stability of the system.

articleTitle: Improvement of Range and Velocity Ambiguity Resolution for Multiple Targets in the Radar Sensor
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems such as slow operation velocity and serious false and missed alarm when employing conventional ambiguity resolutions for multiple targets in the radar sensor, this paper proposes an improved ambiguity resolution method. This method combines the advantages of table lookup and least square algorithm, thus reducing the calculation involved in sorting the possible values and resolving the mean square error. In addition, this method traverses the possible pulse repetition interval (PRI) combinations when matching multiple targets to reduce the missed alarm rate. Moreover, joint resolution of range and velocity ambiguity is employed to decrease the false alarm rate. Simulation experiment shows the proposed method is much faster than conventional methods with a lower missed alarm rate.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Multi-link Ad Hoc Networks Based on IDP Protocol
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In heterogeneous multi-link network environments, data transmission is constrained by limited throughput and unstable links. Targeting mobile ad hoc networks, this study integrates the concept of identifier separation to optimize message transmission mechanisms and proposes an improved multi-interface Optimized Link State Routing (OLSR) protocol, enhancing overall network performance. A UAV-based communication system design is developed for heterogeneous networks, leveraging link parameters to ensure service differentiation. This work provides a novel solution for mobile ad hoc network communication in complex environments.

articleTitle: Color Image Fusion Based on Laplacian Pyramid Transform and CLAHE Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A color image fusion algorithm based on Laplacian pyramid transform and CLAHE technology is proposed for improving the quality of color infrared image and color visible light image fusion. Firstly, the gray scale transformation is applied to the color infrared image for grayscale image, and an enhanced infrared grayscale image is obtained by CLAHE technology. Secondly, the color visible light image is converted into Y, I and Q components through YIQ color transformation. The enhanced infrared grayscale image and Y component in front are fused using pyramid decomposition as the Y component of the fused image. Finally, the Y component is subjected to YIQ inverse transformation with the I and Q components of the color visible light image to obtain the final fused image. Simulation experiments show that algorithm proposed can effectively maintain the detailed texture information and color information of the source image, improve the objective indicators such as mean, information entropy, average gradient and spatial frequency. It is an effective color image fusion algorithm.

articleTitle: Low-illumination color image enhancement algorithm based on HSV space
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of unclear details and low contrast in low illumination color images, this paper proposes a low illumination color image enhancement algorithm based on HSV space. Firstly, the low-light color image is converted into HSV space to obtain brightness, saturation and hue image. Then, power transformation is used to adjust the brightness image, and three groups of images with different brightness are obtained. Then, principal component analysis is used to obtain the fusion weights of images with different brightness, and fusion processing is carried out to obtain the fusion image. In order to highlight the details of the image, the edge weights of the image are obtained by means of bilateral filtering, etc., and the brightness enhanced image is obtained by exponential calculation with the fused image. Finally, the color enhanced image is obtained by HSV inversion. The experimental results show that the enhancement algorithm proposed in this paper can not only improve the brightness of low illumination image, but also highlight the details of the image, and obtain a good visual effect.

articleTitle: Research on the Identification of Scientific Research Project Misconduct Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Science and technology are the primary productive forces, and scientific and technological innovation capability has become a decisive factor in the competition of comprehensive national strength. Scientific research projects are important carriers of scientific and technological innovation. With the implementation of the national innovation-driven development strategy, the number and funding of scientific research projects have increased significantly. The problem is that scientific research project misconduct (SRPM) emerges in endlessly. This paper studies the feature extraction method for misconduct of scientific research projects in large data environment, explores and proposes a sentence representation model and matching architecture based on deep convolution neural network (DCNN), and carries out effective training to learn the expression of sentence matching at different levels, so as to improve the expressive ability of the model, thereby improving the accuracy and accuracy of text similarity calculation.

articleTitle: Research on differential game model of military-civilian collaborative innovation dual-use technology under revenue distribution
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As a crucial intersection of the military-civilian integration strategy and the innovation-driven development strategy, the collaborative innovation (co-innovation) of dual-use technologies has emerged as a novel paradigm for significant scientific and technological research. It is discovered that the benefits accrued to the participants do not necessarily escalate with an increase in their net worth corresponding to a larger share of benefit distribution; instead, they are contingent upon each participant’s specific share of benefit distribution.

articleTitle: A DQN-based resource scheduling optimization algorithm for multi-computing nodes of large AI models
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the booming era of artificial intelligence, the demand for computing resources in AI large-model training is increasing exponentially. However, the traditional centralized computing resource management model fails to meet this growing demand. This paper focuses on the resource utilization issue of multiple computing center nodes and introduces the Deep Q-Network (DQN) algorithm to optimize the logic and strategy of computing task scheduling. A system model encompassing a specific state space, action space, and reward mechanism is established. A one-dimensional DNN network serves as the DQN training model, which is trained by means of the Mean Squared Error (MSE) loss function and the RMSProp optimizer. In the experiment, the DQN is compared with five traditional algorithm models. The results demonstrate that the DQN exhibits the smallest and most balanced fluctuations in resource utilization, boasting the best performance. Consequently, it offers an effective solution for computing resource management.

articleTitle: Exoskeleton actuators based on artificial muscle triggers
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: When conducting high-altitude operations such as overhead line maintenance in power systems, grid workers frequently need to climb electric towers, which poses significant safety risks. The fall protection devices currently in use may cause secondary injuries to workers, while existing exoskeleton devices suffer from poor portability, limiting their practical application. To address this issue, this paper proposes an intelligent wearable climbing tower fall protection system featuring a flexible exoskeleton actuated by artificial muscles. The system comprises a flexible drive sensor-integrated exoskeleton glove, an actuator driven by artificial muscles, and an integrated control unit. Experimental measurements of the actuator's trigger speed and locking force demonstrate its superior performance, providing substantial support for the development of the overall system and holding significant implications for the advancement of novel fall protection devices in modern power systems.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Standard Time Reproducibility Performance for Very Long Baseline
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, the standard time reproduction equipment deployed by the National Time Service Center of the Chinese Academy of Sciences in Minsk, Belarus, was used as the reference, and the performance of the two different methods, satellite common-view and satellite all-view, was verified. Under the condition of a ultra-long baseline of 6,240 kilometers, the limitation of fewer satellites with longer baselines was broken, and the comparison method was improved to enhance the precision of common-view comparison method. The analysis results show that, under the same test environment and using visible satellites of both GPS and BDS systems, the standard time reproduction effect using satellite common-view is better than that using satellite all-view method, whether in the absolute deviation between the reproduced signal and the standard time signal or in the statistical standard deviation of the measurement results. The satellite common-view method used in this paper is superior to the satellite all-view method in terms of both absolute deviation and statistical standard deviation, which can provide reference for the next step of global super-long baseline standard time reproduction.

articleTitle: An adaptive Kalman filtering algorithm for ship speed measurement
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In response to the problem of low measurement accuracy caused by dynamic model errors in ship speed measurement using Kalman filtering, this article proposes an adaptive Kalman filtering algorithm: an abnormal error identification function is constructed to detect dynamic model errors, and an exponential function is used to construct an adaptive factor to reduce dynamic model errors. Simulation verification shows that compared with KF algorithm and interactive multiple model algorithm (IMM), AKF algorithm has reduced the mean absolute error (MAE) by 22% and 11% respectively, and the root mean square error (RSME) by 26% and 15% respectively, indicating that AKF algorithm has better performance in both measurement accuracy and stability evaluation indicators.

articleTitle: Research on Vibration Frequency Measurement of Axial Piston Pump Based on Fiber Grating Sensing
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Through modal analysis, the modes of each order of the inclined axial piston pump are obtained, the vibration characteristics of the axial piston pump body are analyzed better, and the most obvious vibration location is found as the vibration test location. The inclined axial piston pump frequency measurement test bench was built, the original demodulation signal processing system was improved, Butterworth filter was added to make the frequency domain signal analysis more obvious and intuitive, and the working frequency of the axial piston pump under different motor speeds was measured with high precision. It provides the basis for fault diagnosis of axial piston pump. The results show that the vibration frequency measurement system can calculate, analyze, read and display the vibration frequency of the plunger pump with high precision, which makes the application of FBG vibration frequency sensing and measurement more convenient.

articleTitle: Research on the Analysis of User Power Consumption Behavior Characteristics based on the Improved K-means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid economic development and the continuous growth of electricity demand, the power grid is facing severe pressure in power supply guarantee. This study utilizes data mining techniques to analyze user power consumption data and proposes a strategy of using the kmeans algorithm for clustering analysis of user power consumption data. Given that the k-means algorithm is sensitive to noisy data, the DBSCAN algorithm is adopted to optimize the clustering analysis strategy. Moreover, evaluation indicators such as CHI, silhouette coefficient, and DBI are used to conduct a comparative analysis of the clustering results of the traditional k - means algorithm and the k - means algorithm improved by DBSCAN. The results show that the latter exhibits more significant superiority when dealing with user power consumption data. By optimizing the algorithm for clustering analysis of user power consumption behavior characteristics, this research aims to better support personalized services in the power industry and the optimization of power grid dispatching.

Author Keywords: Characteristics of User Power Consumption Behavior

articleTitle: SSS-YOLOv8: Track Crack Detection Based on Attention Mechanism and Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In practice, detecting track cracks is a challenging problem due to different sizes of cracks and complex backgrounds. In this paper, an improved YOLOv8n model is proposed. First, the SPD-Conv module is introduced into the model, which improves the model's detection accuracy of track cracks, especially fine cracks, by replacing the traditional jump convolution and pooling layers. Then, the Second-order Channel Attention module is introduced, which better utilizes the complex relationship between features and improves the generalization ability of the model in various complex contexts. Finally, the Selective Kernel Attention module is introduced, which adaptively adjusts the size of the receptive field through the input features to better handle features of different scales and further improve the detection performance. The experimental results show that the mean average precision(mAP) of the improved model is 3.4% higher than that of the original model. Therefore, the improved model can be better applied in detecting track cracks in actual detection.

articleTitle: CD-YOLO: An Enhanced YOLOv8n-Based Algorithm for Accurate Crop Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Timely detection of crop diseases is crucial for precise fertilization. To address challenges such as difficulty in distinguishing disease spots and low recognition efficiency, this paper proposes an improved disease detection algorithm based on the YOLOv8n network, termed CD-YOLO. The enhancements focus on three main aspects. First, the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) is added at the end of the backbone network to improve the model's ability to extract features related to crop diseases. Second, the Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network (BiFPN) is incorporated into the Neck layer to enable efficient bidirectional feature fusion and adaptive weight allocation, enhancing detection performance across crops of various scales. Finally, the Efficient Channel Attention (ECA) mechanism is introduced in the output layer, allowing the model to dynamically focus on key channel features with low computational cost. This improves the distinction of disease categories and details, particularly in complex backgrounds or when disease spots share similar features. Experimental results indicate that the improved CD-YOLO model achieves a 2.8% increase in mAP@50 compared to the traditional YOLOv8, reaching 92.0%. In tomato leaf disease detection, the model demonstrates higher accuracy and stability, significantly reducing missed and false detections while providing more precise localization and recognition of disease targets. This study offers valuable insights for improving crop productivity.

articleTitle: Data Frame Encryption and Decryption System of SM4-CBC on ZYNQ
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the information age of rapid development in artificial intelligence and the Internet of Things, various devices continuously generate and exchange massive amounts of data. Behind this data explosion lies security risks. The SM4 algorithm, issued by the Chinese National Cryptography Administration, is a block encryption algorithm that can provide security for IoT-based networks. The standard SM4 algorithm has problems such as poor scalability and low implementation efficiency, and needs to be optimized for energy saving and reducing implementation area. Therefore, exploring the implementation of SM4 on hardware-constrained devices is crucial. In this work, we adopt a loop architecture and collaborative work between the processing system (PS) and programmable logic (PL) to reduce the resource usage of SM4-CBC, enhance algorithm security, and employ a ping-pong approach between two encryption modules to increase data throughput. Finally, Ethernet is the data transmission channel to achieve high-speed and reliable data communication.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-channel Data Preprocessing Unit for Microwave Radiometer Based on FPGA and ARM
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The data preprocessing unit is a crucial component within the digital signal processing subsystem of meteorological microwave radiometers. In response to the increasing number of channels in the developing microwave radiometers and the diverse requirements of ground system validation experiments, a data preprocessing unit based on FPGA and ARM has been designed. This data preprocessing unit accomplishes multi-channel data acquisition, communication and control with external devices, voltage signal output, and telemetry signal detection, etc. The design has a high degree of functional integration and versatility to adapt to changing external demands, making it a reliable acquisition and control device for microwave radiometers.

articleTitle: Analysis and Optimization of Wind Farm Operational Performance
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the deteriorating global environment and the increasing scarcity of non-renewable energy sources, the development of renewable and clean wind energy has become one of the energy goals of various countries. Based on the principle of wind power generation, this paper determines the main indexes for evaluating wind energy resources through statistical analysis and establishes relevant mathematical models. First, we use the raw data to calculate the two indicators of monthly average wind speed and monthly average wind power density, and conclude that wind resources are most abundantly utilized in February and December, and are poorer in August. Then, we exclude the data with wind speed less than 4m/s as invalid data, and obtain the monthly effective hours, the monthly effective average wind speed and the monthly effective wind power again - it still comes to the conclusion that the months of February and December are the richest time for wind energy, and the month of August is the most available time for wind energy utilization. We compare the two sets of data and we observe that the culled data has better utilization of the wind resource as compared to the original data. Further, we introduce two new metrics, monthly effective equivalent wind speed and monthly effective wind energy utilization, to compare the wind resource and its utilization with the rating metrics in the culled data, and conclude that the utilization of the wind resource is seasonally dependent, with the winter months (January, February and December) being the most wind-rich time, and the summer months (July and August) being the poorest time for the utilization of the wind resource.

articleTitle: Research on Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Patrol and Detection Technology for Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the current context of rapid technological advancements, drone technology is evolving at an astonishing pace and has been widely adopted in the realm of transmission line inspection. Particularly in the scenarios of long-distance overhead transmission lines with complex geographical conditions, drones have significantly alleviated the workload of inspection personnel and ensured their safety. In the aspect of disaster prevention and mitigation for transmission lines, the application of drones is still in the initial trial stage. Against the backdrop of the landslide case in the Wufeng Mountain area of Hubei, this paper investigates the technologies of drones for rapidly surveying, accurately assessing, and efficiently early warning different geological disasters through means such as image recognition and data analysis under its complex geomorphic characteristics, with the aim of providing technical support and practical references for the safe and stable operation of the power system and the intelligent promotion of disaster prevention and mitigation work.

articleTitle: Research on Spatiotemporal Distribution Characteristics of Network Attention to 5A-level Tourist Attractions in Guangxi
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The advent of the big data era has brought about a profound transformation in the way tourism information is disseminated, greatly enhancing the influence of network attention in shaping the decision-making processes of tourists. The study systematically collected network attention data for 5A-level tourist attractions in Guangxi, utilizing the Baidu Index as the data sources, and analyzed the spatiotemporal distribution characteristics using both the seasonal concentration index and geographical concentration index. The findings indicate that, in terms of temporal distribution, the network attention to 5A-level tourist attractions in Guangxi exhibits a generally fluctuating upward trend, with notable monthly variations primarily influenced by factors such as climate comfort and leisure time. In terms of spatial distribution, the regions with higher levels of network attention are predominantly located in Guangxi and its neighboring provinces, as well as the economically developed eastern provinces, while the regions with lower levels of network attention are mainly found in northwestern China. It reflects that the economic development level of the source market, climate difference the distance between the source market and the destination significantly influences the variations in network attention.

articleTitle: Comparison of Cuscore and GLR in Detecting Mean Shifts of Lévy Stable Processes
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: There is a class of problems in stochastic systems that have many important applications, namely how to quickly monitor change points. It can be applied in industrial quality control, and can also be applied in automatic fault monitoring of automatic systems, etc. In order to solve such problems quickly and effectively, different forms of control charts have been proposed. In the previous studies of various control charts, it is often assumed that the variance of the process is limited or that the random variables are normally distributed. However, in practical problems, many variables are stable and have infinite variance. Therefore, it is a practical problem to monitor the mean change point of Lévy stable process. In statistical process control, the average running length is widely used to evaluate and compare the monitoring effect of various control charts. In this paper, when monitoring the mean change point of Lévy stable process, the interval estimation of the average running length (ARL) of Cuscore and GLR control charts is given first, and then the monitoring effect is compared by using the method of digital simulation.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Generation Algorithm Based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The knowledge graph is a structured knowledge base used to describe concepts, entities, and their interrelationships in the physical world in symbolic form. Compared to large models, knowledge graphs have more explicit knowledge representation and structural advantages. Having stronger data integration and processing capabilities, reasoning and interpretability. This article is based on the Bayesian network structure learning algorithm MMPC (Max-Min Parents and Children), and constructs a knowledge graph through three modifications: Firstly, we use text segmentation and calculation of intersection to union ratio to preliminarily measure the coupling relationship between entities, reduce irrelevant entities, and lower computational complexity. Besides, mutual information clustering algorithm is used to improve the accuracy of independence judgment. Finally, we use a greedy algorithm based on information entropy gain ratio to find the optimal network structure.

articleTitle: Super-resolution reconstruction of remote sensing images based on multi-scale reparameterized pyramids
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of loss of structural details and insufficient attention to edge information in the existing lightweight remote sensing super-resolution reconstruction methods, a multi-scale reparameterized pyramid network (MRPN) method for remote sensing image super-resolution reconstruction based on multi-scale reparameterized pyramids was proposed. The model is based on the deep residual network structure, and multiple cascading multi-scale reparameterized pyramid modules are designed in the network for feature extraction. In the module, a multi-scale separation convolution and fusion module is designed to help the network refine image information, and the unglobal and global feature expressions are enhanced, and the link-enhanced spatial attention module is used to improve the attention to high-frequency feature information. Finally, the jumping connection method is used to fuse multi-level features to achieve effective spatial information fusion. The model is verified by 2x, 3x and 4x super-resolution reconstruction on the NWPU-RESISC45 dataset and the AID dataset, and the experimental results show that the peak signal-to-noise ratio and structural similarity are improved, and the method has good performance in improving image quality and preserving details.

articleTitle: An adaptive cooperative transmission mechanism under complex heterogeneous networks
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, the Internet industry has been developing rapidly, and various mobile terminal network applications such as short videos and live broadcasts have emerged rapidly, with a sharp increase in the number of users, leading to a rapid growth in network bandwidth demand. Considering that smartphones and other smart terminal devices currently provide multiple wireless network access methods such as WIFI, LTE, 5G, satellite, etc., multipath parallel transmission technology has become an ideal solution. However, most of the current researches tend to refine the scenarios and design the scheduling and transmission mechanisms for specific scenarios, and as the scenarios continue to be refined, the adaptability of the scheduling algorithms decreases, and the avalanche effect of the system caused by the degradation of some links that exists under the heterogeneous wireless networks is not taken into account. Based on the analysis of the above problems, this thesis designs a scheduling and transmission mechanism that can adapt to the changes in transmission traffic while avoiding the avalanche effect under heterogeneous network environments. Compared to the classic minRTT algorithm, the overall transmission delay is reduced by 30% in the test environment, and the transmission bandwidth and video transmission effect are both greatly improved.

articleTitle: Indoor and outdoor collaborative positioning technology based on Beidou and Bluetooth positioning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the field of deep learning, the quantity and quality of the dataset are crucial for training high-performance neural network models. In situations with insufficient data samples, the trained network may exhibit poor generalization. To overcome this challenge, this paper proposes a Bayesian inference-optimized approach using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) for data augmentation. By training GANs on the original dataset, the model can generate data samples that are similar but distinct from the original data. Unlike traditional data augmentation methods, GANs not only generate more samples but also produce diverse and realistic data, thereby enhancing neural network recognition performance in subsequent small sample environments.

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis and Prevention Strategies of Acquaintance Injury Incidents from the Perspective of Multidimensional Modeling
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper explores the occurrence mechanism of acquaintance injury incidents through a multidimensional analysis framework, combining quantitative and qualitative research methods, and analyzes the intertwined effects of social, psychological, family, and legal factors. The research shows that the occurrence of acquaintance injury incidents is the result of the joint action of multiple factors, and preventive measures must comprehensively consider factors such as law enforcement, optimization of the social environment, and mental health intervention. Based on this, this paper proposes a series of targeted prevention strategies, including strengthening legal protection and enforcement, improving the social environment, optimizing family education, and providing mental health support. The research results provide theoretical support and practical suggestions for reducing acquaintance injury incidents and are of great significance for promoting the harmonious development of society.

articleTitle: A Nonlinear Dimensionality Reduction Method for Localized Tangent Space Alignment of High-dimensional Spectra of Tobacco Leaves
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Regarding the problems of distance failure and dimensional disaster of tobacco high-dimensional near-infrared spectral similarity metrics during the cigarette recipe maintenance process, we propose an improved local tangent space alignment algorithm based on adaptive neighborhood preservation and stochastic projection optimization (PAG-LTSA). It significantly improves the computational efficiency of the algorithm through an adaptive neighborhood selection strategy based on distance probability equations and geodesic distances, as well as parallel accelerated computation and stochastic projection techniques. We verify the effectiveness of the PAG-LTSA algorithm on the actual production data of a beer enterprise. The results show that the dimensionality reduction results of PAG-LTSA algorithm have the most obvious discrimination. In the raw material origin classification experiment, the average accuracy of the algorithm is 9.58% higher than the traditional method, while the execution time is only 83.3% of the original one, which proves the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Dimensionality Reduction of Liver Function Indicators based on Factor Analysis (FA)
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Factor analysis (FA) is a statistical method used to reduce dimensionality by condensing a large number of observed variables into a smaller set of latent factors. In this study, FA is employed to reduce dimensionality of liver function indicators. Four test indicators, alanine transaminase (ALT) level, hepatomegaly index, zinc sulfate turbidity, and alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) level, are the observed variables. Datasets from twenty collected samples are exploited. The four observed variables are represented by linear combination of two latent factors. Factor loadings are calculated and illustrated using an arrow graph. These results indicate that the first two indicators correlate strongly with factor 1, the third indicator correlate strongly with factor 2, and the fourth indicator exhibits weak relationships with each factor. The first two indicators are assumed to be primarily influenced by one latent factor and are independent of the other two indicators. The third and fourth indicators are independent variables. These findings help physicians better understand the intrinsic structures of liver function indicators and offer guidance for clinical practice. This study highlights the potential of FA in medical applications.

articleTitle: Study on wildfire detection method for transmission corridor based on multi-scale adaptive feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the global climate change and the frequent occurrence of forest fires, early detection and realtime monitoring of wildfires are crucial. To address the limitations of traditional fire detection methods in complex scenarios, this paper proposes a new method for fire image recognition using a Convolutional Neural Network with Adaptive Feature Fusion (AFF-CNN). This method introduces a multi-scale feature extraction mechanism and incorporates a feature adaptive weight module into the network structure to enhance the recognition capability of key features such as flames and smoke in different scenarios. Experimental results show that the AFF-CNN model significantly improves the recognition accuracy of fire images compared to traditional CNNs, especially in complex environments with lighting changes and smoke obstruction, demonstrating stronger robustness. The experimental results indicate that the recognition accuracy of AFF-CNN in complex environments is significantly higher than that of traditional CNNs, particularly in scenarios with lighting changes and smoke obstruction, with significant improvements in accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-Score.

articleTitle: Analysis of Evaluation Indicators for Regenerative Braking Energy Recovery in Hybrid Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To evaluate the regenerative braking energy recovery performance of hybrid electric vehicles, this paper develops test conditions for two hybrid vehicles with different characteristics and establishes evaluation indicators for regenerative braking energy recovery. The indicators, namely braking energy recovery rate and output energy recovery rate, are used to assess the braking energy recovery performance of the two vehicles. The braking energy recovery rate takes into account the driving resistance encountered by the vehicle, making the evaluation of regenerative braking energy recovery more accurate. The results show that the proposed testing method and evaluation indicators can accurately reflect the regenerative braking energy recovery performance of the vehicles.

articleTitle: Optimization configuration method for new energy and energy storage in incremental distribution network based on adaptive plant cell swarm algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The increasing integration of new energy sources and energy storage systems into incremental distribution networks (IDNs) has posed significant challenges for optimal configuration, balancing economic efficiency, system reliability, and renewable energy utilization. This paper proposes an optimization configuration method based on the Adaptive Plant Cell Swarm Algorithm (APCSA). Inspired by the growth and division mechanisms of plant cells, APCSA incorporates adaptive strategies to enhance its global search and local exploitation capabilities, addressing the dynamic and complex nature of IDNs. The optimization model considers multiple objectives, including cost minimization, voltage stability, and energy storage efficiency, while adhering to power balance and network capacity constraints. A comprehensive case study demonstrates the superior performance of APCSA in identifying optimal configurations compared to conventional algorithms. Results highlight its robustness, computational efficiency, and ability to adapt to varying network conditions. This study provides a practical and scalable solution for enhancing the economic and operational performance of IDNs with integrated renewable energy and storage systems.

articleTitle: Adaptive enhancement of underwater image based on dense residual denoising
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to the particularity of underwater complex environment, the small targets in underwater images cover impulse noise, speckle noise and other causes, resulting in low image resolution, single detail expression, low information entropy and average gradient. Therefore, this paper proposes an adaptive enhancement method for underwater small target images based on dense residual denoising. Combined with dense residual network-denoising technology, the feature extraction structure of underwater small target image is constructed, and the impulse noise part of the image is removed by median filtering, and then the speckle noise part of the image is removed by wavelet filtering to denoise the underwater small target image. Through the method of multi-scale averaging, the features of the enhanced image are in a balanced state, and the Sigmiod function is selected as the objective function of the image. By integrating dense residual network and adaptive enhancement strategy, the underwater small target image is enhanced. The experimental results show that the resolution of the image is significantly improved, the clarity is higher, the details are rich, and the information entropy and average gradient are higher after the image is enhanced by this method, thus achieving a better visual presentation effect of underwater small target images.

articleTitle: Velocity Deambiguation Method for DDMA-MIMO Radar Based on Phase Compensation
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to address the issues of velocity ambiguity and target energy dispersion in DDMA-MIMO radar, an enhanced velocity defuzzification methodology is presented. Firstly, the repeated distribution of the target's spectrum is exploited to compress the range Doppler spectrum in the Doppler dimension. This results in the conversion n of the two-dimensional detection to the detection of a single distance-dimensional vector. Furthermore, the subarea peak search is employed to replace the Doppler-dimensional CFAR detection within the Doppler dimension, thereby significantly enhancing the detection efficiency. In addition, a DDMA waveform free of empty bands is designed to estimate the target angle while achieving velocity deblurring through phase compensation and digital beam forming algorithms. The efficacy and superiority of the proposed method are demonstrated through a verification process using measured data.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Transmission Mechanism for a Robot-Assisted Suturing Device
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper addresses the issue of inadequate piercing performance in a rapid suturing device and proposes a method for optimizing the dimensions of the mechanism. The approach investigates the variation in the interaction forces between the suturing needle and the tissue, considering the specific characteristics of the suturing device. By analyzing the changes in the interaction forces during the suturing process, the optimization of the transmission mechanism is performed using the interior-point method. The optimized device demonstrates an improvement in piercing performance of approximately 17%.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Network State Management Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid growth of the Internet, higher demands are placed on network stability and reliability. Dynamic environments, such as mobile Internet and IoT, often experience fluctuations, high latency, congestion, and unexpected disconnections. Factors like equipment failure, process crashes, and overloads further disrupt connections, impacting service quality and user experience. To address these issues, we propose an innovative network connection state management mechanism based on identity and state identification. Using active detection and passive perception mechanisms, it promptly detects connection states, updates the state, and restore the connection with adaptive reconnection mechanisms using exponential back-off . This approach minimizes service interruptions and enhances data transmission efficiency. Test results demonstrate that the system effectively manages network connections, improving communication reliability and stability.

articleTitle: Identification method of abnormal metering data of transformer under light load operating condition
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Combined with the fact that the A-phase current of the smart electricity meter was reversed during operation, the metering personnel mistakenly believed that the polarity was reversed and then changed the wiring, causing the A-phase current polarity of the smart electricity meter to be reversed, resulting in abnormal operating parameters. This paper analyzes the methods for determining current reversal and proposes preventive measures to ensure the safe, accurate, and reliable operation of the smart electricity meter.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Rugby-shaped Self-balancing Vehicle Based on Body Sensing Interaction
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Somatosensory interaction is another new starting point for the transformation of human-computer interaction mode after mouse and multi-touch. Through the analysis of the sensory characteristics of the human body, the interactive way of human instinct, body movements, body experience and surrounding devices or environment is understood, and how to bring good experience to users in the interactive environment of body sense is analyzed, and the potential design needs of users are explored. On this basis, the function and principle of the product are analyzed, the user's operation behavior is analyzed, and the defects and deficiencies in the human-computer interaction process are summarized according to the human-computer interaction standard. Through the above research, the factors affecting the body sense interaction of the self-balancing car are obtained, the body sense interaction design theory is combined with the investigation and analysis of the self-balancing car, the body sense interaction is applied to the football type self-balancing car, the innovative design objectives and design ideas of the self-balancing car are summarized, and the innovative design is carried out from the comprehensive consideration of the appearance characteristics, control methods, interactive experience and other factors.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimal dispatching of Hydropower - Photovoltaic - Pumped storage multi-energy complementary system considering water ecological environment
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The operation of the hybrid pumping and storage power station leads to the spatio-temporal changes of downstream water quantity and water quality, which have a certain negative impact on the river runoff regime and ecological integrity. In order to balance the goal of power generation and river ecological protection, a multi-energy complementary system is proposed in this study, which takes the discharge volume of the reservoir, the stability of pumping flow of the pumping and storage unit and the minimum change of runoff regime as the objective function. The multi-energy complementary ecological scheduling model is designed to reduce the impact of hydropower station scheduling on river ecology while ensuring the power generation efficiency of the system.

articleTitle: Design of Cloud-Edge-End Collaborative Framework for Power Supply Intelligent Inspection Operation Scenario Based on Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As a new type of tool with powerful perception, monitoring, and emergency response capabilities, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have the characteristics of flexibility, maneuverability, and high-altitude inspection. UAVs can greatly improve the efficiency of power facility maintenance and repairing, reduce personnel risks, and have gradually become an important auxiliary means for power supply operation and management. Currently, research on cloud-edge collaborative computing using UAVs has been applied to power systems, especially in their daily maintenance. However, there is not much discussion on building a systematic UAV-based cloud-edge collaboration system, especially to meet the requirements of power supply companies. Aiming at the problems such as the limited distance of image transmission, the lack of timeliness and visualization of image data processing in the application process of UAVs, in this paper, a "cloud-edge-end" collaborative framework has been proposed to achieve fast data return over the distance under signal coverage, and use the characteristics of local edge computing to quickly solve image preprocessing.

articleTitle: Research on bolt loosening detection method based on PointNet
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the demand for bolt loosening detection in rail defects, this paper proposes a detection method based on PointNet. Firstly, the improved YOLOv5s model is used to accurately locate the bolts in the two-dimensional rail image, and then a bolt point cloud dataset is constructed. The point cloud voxel downsampling technology is used to preprocess the data, which effectively reduces data redundancy and improves processing efficiency. Subsequently, the image information is fused with the point cloud data in combination with the traditional machine vision algorithm to extract the region of interest (ROI), providing reliable feature support for the accurate judgment of the loose state of the bolts. Furthermore, this paper introduces the PointNet model, uses the deep learning method to directly process the bolt point cloud data, realizes the binary classification detection of the bolt loose state through global feature learning, and uses the binary classification accuracy as the main performance evaluation indicator. The accuracy of the training set is finally stabilized at 81.6%, and the accuracy of the validation set is 75.5%. The experimental results show that the PointNet model has excellent adaptability and robustness when dealing with bolt loosening detection tasks, especially in complex scenarios.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Capacity Allocation Method Considering Regional Power Grid Reliability and Distributed Photovoltaic Consumption
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The rapid development of distributed photovoltaic resources has changed the operating mode of traditional power systems, and the introduction of energy storage systems has become a key means to improve the flexibility, stability, and reliability of power grids. Based on the power supply and demand balance of the regional power grid, the absorption capacity of distributed photovoltaic and the power demand of the power grid during the peak-load period are analyzed first. Next, by configuring energy storage to satisfy the distributed photovoltaic surplus power storage, it also satisfies the electricity demand at the peakload times. Then, based on the actual operation of the power grid, considering the N-1 failure of the main transformer of the substation in the regional power grid, the energy storage can meet the power supply demand of the load without causing load-shedding. Finally, the reliability index of the regional power grid is defined to represent the supporting ability to the regional power grid after the substation is configured with energy storage in the case of the main transformer N-1 failure. The effectiveness and adaptability of the proposed method are verified by a practical power grid.

articleTitle: Autonomous underwater vehicle adaptive docking control
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper investigates the AUV docking control method based on linear tracking control and waypoint guidance. According to the principle that the AUV finally enters into the recycling station along a straight line, this method designs an in-place preparatory waypoint for the AUV, combining the advantages of linear tracking control and waypoint guidance to guide the AUV to a waypoint directly in front of the entrance to the docking station. A control algorithm with adaptive lateral tracking is used to enable the AUV to accurately track back to the midline of the docking station and to overcome cross-current interference, ultimately into the recovery station. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the method are verified by simulation studies.

articleTitle: Thread Surface Defect Detection Based on Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to detect thread surface defects, a set of thread surface defect detection system based on image processing is developed. It adopts non-contact, high-precision and real-time image processing technology, and combines image acquisition, preprocessing, defect detection and feature extraction modules. Through continuous debugging and optimizing the image processing algorithm, the accuracy and real-time performance of the detection system are ensured. The experimental results show that the system can effectively identify two major defects, solder joint defects and thread damage defects. In the test of multiple groups of thread samples, the system can accurately identify single solder joint defects, single thread damage defects and both solder joint defects and thread damage defects, which is consistent with the actual thread defect and has high detection accuracy. The thread surface defect detection system based on image processing improves the efficiency of thread detection, provides technical support for quality control and production automation of thread manufacturing industry, and provides a reference for thread surface defect detection.

articleTitle: Improved WAPI framework for electric power mobile terminals
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: WAPI technology effectively improves the security performance of wireless local area network through identity authentication and key negotiation mechanism, but it also brings delay problems. In the electric power system, some electric power mobile terminals are very sensitive to the delay. When these electric power mobile terminals, which use WAPI protocol, are switching from one wireless access point to another wireless access point, the long switching time will cause data failure. In order to solve this problem, a master-slave WAPI architecture is proposed. In this architecture, the Master AP is responsible for managing the key information and modifying the validity of STA’ s time window and the Slave AP is responsible for exchanging data with the STA. When a legal STA will roam, it can continue to use the current key to communicate with the Slave AP, if its time window is valid. This method saves the delay caused by key negotiation after each switch. Simulation results show that the new architecture has lower delay than the original architecture, which effectively solves the problem of high roaming switching delay of power mobile terminal and ensures the reliability of power data transmission.

articleTitle: A Low-Power Ultra-Wideband RMS Power Detector for Power Amplifier Control Loop
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper presents a low-power ultra-wideband RMS power detector fabricated in CMOS 55 nm process. The square-law characteristic of MOS transistor is exploited to convert RF power information into DC voltage. The circuit is composed of an RMS detection module and a closed-loop operational amplifier, which are utilized for power signal conversion and DC voltage amplification, respectively. The closed-loop two-stage operational amplifier features adjustable feedback and pull-up/pull-down resistors, allowing for flexible adjustment of power detection range. According to the measured results, the maximum dynamic range is 20 dB for 2-18 GHz RF input signals. With a supply voltage of 1.2 V, the power consumption is only 0.9 mW, and the differential output exhibits rail-to-rail range.

articleTitle: An Automatic Approach to Virtual Assembly of Spacecraft by Reference Point Coordinate Formulation with Euler Angles
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The virtual assembly of spacecraft faces the problem of high cost and low effiency, which can be alleviated by automatic approaches. In this paper, based on a framework called Reference Point Coordinate Formulation with Euler Angles, we propose an automatic approach to accelerate the virtual assembly design process. Our approach changes positions of mechanical part in a unified way, which can be further used in a variety of domain including equipment layout, harness assembly and coordinate transformation of 3D models. Experiences in the assembly design of high-orbit satellite verify the feasibility of this approach and are applicable to the virtual assembly of other spacecrafts.

articleTitle: Methods for Design, Verification and Evaluation of Cokpit Lighting Environment in Civil Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Vision is the main way for drivers to obtain information in the cockpit, and the quality of visual performance determines the driver's ability to gather information. Lighting is a necessary condition for visual perception, and the quality of lighting conditions directly affects the quality and speed at which drivers receive information. The lighting conditions are closely related to the driver's work efficiency, work quality, safety, comfort, vision, and health, making it an important factor in the work environment. Selecting and designing a reasonable lighting environment in the cockpit creates good and comfortable working conditions for the drivers, minimizing visual fatigue and ensuring the full function of the driver's vision.

articleTitle: A Drowning Detection Model by Integrating Multi-Scale Enhanced Receptive Fields with the YOLOv8 Framework
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To prevent drowning accidents, researchers have developed various deep convolutional networks for drowning action detection. While the YOLOv8 model excels in detection accuracy and speed, it faces challenges such as limited field of view and missed small object detections. This paper introduces a drowning detection model that integrates multi-scale enhanced receptive fields with the YOLOv8 framework. Ghost convolution and partial convolution are embedded into YOLOv8 residual modules, with linear transformations applied to reduce parameters while enriching feature extraction. A lightweight detection head is designed with shared feature extraction modules for decoupled operations. Additionally, separable large kernels are employed for secondary feature fusion after spatial pyramid pooling to broaden the network’s receptive field. The proposed model improves detection accuracy by 1.87% and increases processing speed by 22.4 FPS compared to YOLOv8. Experimental results demonstrate its ability to capture broader spatial information and enhance small object detection.

articleTitle: Optimizing Charging Strategies for Electric Vehicles in Residential Areas Based on Leaped Halton Sequence Initialized Flood Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The rapid growth of electric vehicles (EVs) has led to a surge in charging demand, resulting in power grid overload and insufficient charging facilities, thus, it is urgent to optimize models to solve the problem of supply-demand imbalance. At present, relevant research has focused on proposing valuable strategies to solve the problem of charging overload during peak hours. However, these models are based on static prediction and fail to effectively consider the various factors of real-time changes in EV charging, resulting in inflexible system scheduling, congestion during charging peak hours, and poor performance when charging demand fluctuates. And for many charging optimization problems, they are equivalent to non-smooth and non-convex optimization problems, and traditional subgradient descent (SubGD) and coordinate descent (CD) methods are generally prone to getting stuck in local optimal solutions. In order to overcome the above shortcomings, in this paper, a derivative-free optimization method called leaped Halton sequence initialize flood algorithm (LHSFLA) has been proposed, which can break out of the trap of local optimal solutions and find global optimal solution, so as to balance power load fluctuations and user charging costs, and effectively solve the problems of power grid overload and insufficient charging facilities.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Twin-Based Assembly Workshop Modeling and Simulation Methods
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Faced with the complex production demands of small-batch, multi-variety orders and variable assembly processes in assembly workshops, traditional methods relying on manual calculations can no longer meet the requirements of efficient production. Enhancing production predictability, data utilization, and real-time monitoring has become critical for the digital transformation of production lines. Based on digital twin technology, this paper proposes a data-and model-driven digital twin modeling method. By constructing a system framework composed of physical, twin, data, and service layers, real-time mapping of physical workshops and production process simulation is realized. The introduction of an event scheduling method optimizes simulation logic, enabling precise production process simulation and real-time monitoring. Finally, a digital twin production line simulation platform targeting an aerospace assembly workshop is established, validating the effectiveness of the proposed method in enhancing digital workshop simulation capabilities. This study offers valuable insights into simulation and monitoring challenges in complex production lines.

articleTitle: An Improved EfficientNet-B0 Approach for Brain Tumor MRI Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the task of brain tumor classification in MRI images, this paper proposes a classification model based on an improved EfficientNet-B0 network. Due to the complex pathological features and diversity of medical imaging data, higher requirements are placed on the feature extraction capability and generalization performance of classification models. To address this, we optimized the original EfficientNet-B0 network by introducing the MS-CAM attention mechanism and improving the MBConv module, enabling the model to capture multi-scale feature information more comprehensively, thereby enhancing classification performance and generalization ability. Experimental results show that the improved model achieved a classification accuracy of 99.31% on the validation set, outperforming the original EfficientNet-B0 and other lightweight models. This model can provide clinicians with an efficient and accurate auxiliary diagnostic tool, potentially advancing the development of automated brain tumor diagnosis.

articleTitle: An Exploration of High-Speed Dynamic Online Comprehensive Inspection Schemes for Key Components of Trains
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper discusses a high-speed dynamic online comprehensive inspection scheme for key components such as train wheels and pantographs. The scheme integrates three parts: the vehicle wheelset dynamic inspection unit, the pantograph dynamic inspection and roof foreign object alarm unit, and the vehicle identification management unit. Through the selection and layout of detection elements, communication elements, software, and data analysis components, as well as the expected setting of technical indicators, it provides a reference for the high-speed automated online comprehensive inspection of key train components.

articleTitle: Effectiveness Evaluation of Network Defense Based on Cloud Model
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The effectiveness evaluation of network defense is a multi-level and multi-index decision-making problem. Considering the complexity of the problem, this paper studied it by employing cloud models, and proposed a cloud based network defense effectiveness evaluation model(CNDEEM). The paper also introduced a index system of CNDEEM and described detail of the algorithm that evaluate the effectiveness of network defense by using cloud model.

articleTitle: Research on Abnormal Analysis Method of Monitoring Data for Hydropower Units Based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In response to the problem that the amount of state monitoring data for hydroelectric generating units is gradually increasing while the data quality is poor, a method for abnormal data detection of state monitoring data for hydroelectric generating units based on graph neural networks is proposed. Firstly, a graph topology data is established for the input data and abnormal data is detected by combining with graph neural networks. Taking 1088 pieces of the deflection data of the guide bearing of a hydropower station's state monitoring system as an example, 100 pieces of random data are inserted at the same time interval. Through the comparison of clustering performance and time performance with conventional DBScan, K-means, and OCSVM algorithms, the proposed method has the highest recognition accuracy, the best data cleaning effect, and can significantly reduce the computing time.

articleTitle: Research on multi-specialty collaborative design based on unified modeling of multi-source data
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 8th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aerospace, shipbuilding and other military industry, its product system has shown a high degree of complex function, coupling correlation in various fields, reconfigurable and many other characteristics. The baseline management mode of design document based on PLM system has been difficult to meet the needs of more efficient and real-time collaborative design. There are some problems in this mode, such as discrete data source, discontinuous data flow and low efficiency of inter-specialty collaborative iteration, which restrict the overall efficiency and level of complex equipment development.
